    AgentFly: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Unified Resource System

    AgentFly：通过统一资源系统扩展智能体强化学习

    Renxi Wang, Rifo Ahmad Genadi, Bilal El Bouardi, Yongxin Wang, Fajri Koto, Zhengzhong Liu, Timothy Baldwin, Haonan Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AgentFly contributes a unified resource scheduler and lifecycle design for scaling agentic RL rollouts across tools and environments, with controlled throughput comparisons. Agent loops compose agents, tools, and rewards, but this is architectural organization rather than a contribution to compositional generalization; its direct focus on agent infrastructure makes Systems core, while RL training relevance to reasoning is limited.

    AgentFly 提出了一种统一资源调度器和生命周期设计，用于扩展跨工具和跨环境的智能体强化学习 rollout，并进行了受控吞吐量比较。智能体循环会组合智能体、工具和奖励，但这属于架构组织，而非对组合泛化的贡献；其直接重点是智能体基础设施，对推理的相关性有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Methods to build LLM agents have evolved from prompt engineering and supervised finetuning to agentic reinforcement learning (agentic RL). However, agentic RL remains bottlenecked by its surrounding systems: agents must interact with heterogeneous environments, such as sandboxes, model services, and external APIs. Their allocation, reuse, and lifecycle dominate rollout cost and cap the scale at which training becomes practical. In this work, we present AgentFly, an agentic RL framework built with a unified resource layer that treats each of these environments as a distinct, typed resource scheduled through one engine, with per-tool acquisition for multi-turn reuse, asynchronous backpressure, and rollout versus global-scoped lifecycles. AgentFly adopts a four-layer design: (I) agent layer that abstracts the agent, tool, and reward concepts, decomposing agentic RL into defining agents, tools, and reward functions; (II) rollout layer that composes these into agent loops and computes rewards; (III) context layer that organizes rollouts, injects contextual information, and arranges resources; and (IV) a low-level resource layer that performs resource management. We provide a suite of prebuilt tools and environments, demonstrate successful agent training across multiple tasks and models, and report the first controlled cross-framework throughput comparison against agentic RL frameworks.

    中文

    构建 LLM 智能体的方法已从提示工程和监督微调发展到智能体强化学习（agentic RL）。然而，智能体强化学习仍受其周边系统制约：智能体必须与异构环境交互，例如沙箱、模型服务和外部 API。这些环境的分配、复用和生命周期决定了大部分 rollout 成本，并限制了训练达到实用规模的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出 AgentFly，这是一种智能体强化学习框架，采用统一资源层，将上述每种环境视为独立的类型化资源，并通过单一引擎进行调度；它支持按工具获取资源以供多轮复用、异步背压，以及 rollout 级与全局级生命周期。AgentFly 采用四层设计：（I）智能体层，对智能体、工具和奖励概念进行抽象，将智能体强化学习拆解为智能体、工具和奖励函数的定义；（II）rollout 层，将这些要素组合成智能体循环并计算奖励；（III）上下文层，组织 rollout、注入上下文信息并安排资源；（IV）底层资源层，负责资源管理。我们提供了一套预构建工具和环境，展示了在多个任务和模型上成功训练智能体的结果，并报告了首次针对智能体强化学习框架开展的受控跨框架吞吐量比较。

    An Investigation of Robustness of LLMs in Mathematical Reasoning: Benchmarking with Mathematically-Equivalent Transformation of Advanced Mathematical Problems

    大型语言模型数学推理鲁棒性研究：通过高等数学问题的数学等价变换进行基准评测

    Yuren Hao, Xiang Wan, ChengXiang Zhai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GAP builds a benchmark of mathematically equivalent problem variants to diagnose robustness, finding that models especially struggle to transfer proof plans across changed mathematical settings. This directly advances reasoning evaluation and provides strong evidence about structural transfer, while the identifier-binding probe alone does not establish a mechanistic interpretability contribution.

    GAP 构建了数学等价题目变体基准，用于诊断鲁棒性；研究发现，模型尤其难以将证明计划迁移到变化后的数学背景中。这项工作直接推进了推理评估，并提供了有关结构迁移的有力证据；但仅凭标识符绑定探测不足以构成机制可解释性方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier large language models (LLMs) now reach near-ceiling accuracy on standard mathematical-reasoning benchmarks and gold-medal-level performance at the International Mathematical Olympiad. As these benchmarks saturate and their items leak into training data, a high score no longer shows whether a model reasons robustly or which component of its reasoning fails. To evaluate reasoning while keeping results informative and failures diagnosable, we propose GAP (Generalisation-and-Perturbation), a methodology that automatically generates mathematically equivalent variants of existing mathematics problems at scale using two disjoint, interpretable transformations: (1) surface renames, probing the binding between identifiers and latent variable roles, and (2) kernel rewrites, probing whether a high-level proof plan survives a change of mathematical setting. Compared with existing benchmarks, GAP has two key benefits: (1) novel, likely unseen variants mitigate data leakage, and (2) performance across transformation families enables failure diagnosis, each transformation testing a hypothesis about the cause of failure. We instantiate GAP on all 1,051 William Lowell Putnam Competition problems from 1938 to 2024, adding 5,255 unseen variants to form PutnamGAP, a 6,306-item competition-level mathematics corpus and the first public machine-readable dataset from the full Putnam archive. Using PutnamGAP, we evaluated 18 commercial and open-source models spanning sizes and providers. Accuracy drops across all models and variant families, most severely under kernel rewrites. This gap does not close with model strength, suggesting that even the strongest models' dominant weakness is transferring a proof plan to a changed mathematical setting, rather than handling surface changes. Further analysis provides finer failure diagnoses and potentially useful insights for improving LLM reasoning.

    中文

    前沿大型语言模型（LLM）如今在标准数学推理基准上已接近满分，在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中也达到金牌水平。随着这些基准趋于饱和且题目泄漏到训练数据中，高分已无法说明模型能否稳健推理，也无法揭示其推理的哪个环节会出错。为在评估推理能力的同时确保结果仍有信息价值、失败原因可诊断，我们提出 GAP（Generalisation-and-Perturbation，泛化与扰动），这是一种可大规模自动生成现有数学题目数学等价变体的方法，使用两种互不重叠且可解释的变换：（1）表层重命名，用于探查标识符与潜在变量角色之间的绑定；（2）核心重写，用于探查高层证明计划能否在数学背景改变后继续成立。与现有基准相比，GAP 有两项关键优势：（1）新颖且很可能未曾见过的变体可减轻数据泄漏；（2）不同变换类别上的表现能够用于诊断失败，每种变换都检验一个关于失败原因的假设。我们将 GAP 应用于 1938 至 2024 年全部 1,051 道 William Lowell Putnam 数学竞赛题目，新增 5,255 道未见过的变体，构成 PutnamGAP；这是一个包含 6,306 道竞赛级数学题目的语料库，也是首个来自完整 Putnam 竞赛档案的公开机器可读数据集。我们使用 PutnamGAP 评估了涵盖不同规模和提供方的 18 个商业及开源模型。所有模型在各种变体类别上的准确率均有下降，其中核心重写造成的下降最为严重。这一差距不会随着模型能力增强而缩小，这表明即便是最强模型，其主要弱点也是将证明计划迁移到变化后的数学背景中，而非应对表层变化。进一步分析提供了更细致的失败诊断，并有望为提升 LLM 推理能力带来有用见解。

    Mechanistic Evidence for Spectral Structures in Prior-Data Fitted Networks

    先验数据拟合网络中谱结构的机制性证据

    Kaustubh Sharma, Srijan Tiwari, Ojasva Nema, and Parikshit Pareek

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies spectral information in PFN representations, demonstrates its causal use through subspace patching, and decodes it as an explicit kernel, directly advancing representation geometry and internal mechanisms. The downstream regression result is an application of this finding, with no substantive contribution to composition, reasoning, or model systems.

    本文识别出 PFN 表征中的谱信息，通过子空间修补展示了这些信息在因果层面上的作用，并将其解码为显式核，直接推动了表征几何和内部机制研究。下游回归结果是这一发现的应用，而非对组合、推理或模型系统的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) perform approximate Bayesian inference in a single forward pass, and tabular foundation models (TFMs) built on them are now widely used. To understand what networks infer internally, recent mechanistic studies of TFMs locate where predictions form, but treat these models as tabular predictors rather than as PFNs. It therefore remains unknown whether PFNs represent the spectral content of their context, the quantity that specifies a stationary kernel, and whether this content can be read out as an explicit kernel. We answer both questions. First, across seven PFNs, including four pretrained TFMs and a model trained only on a decision-tree prior, a linear probe on the residual stream recovers the frequency of the context with $R^2 \geq 0.95$. This structure is led by a single principal direction. Second, activation and subspace patching show that the network uses the structure through a low-dimensional subspace, where a few spectral directions move predictions far more than random ones. This holds even for the decision-tree model, so a spectral training prior is not required. On real datasets with up to 499 features, 64 of the 192 directions of TabPFN, chosen without labels, carry 85 to 95\% of the causal effect of the context in all but one pair. Third, we introduce a Filter Bank Decoder that turns frozen PFN representations into an explicit stationary kernel through Bochner's theorem. Without any test-time optimization, the decoded kernel supports Gaussian process regression competitive with deep kernel learning and random Fourier features at about $200\times$ lower cost. PFN latents therefore hold spectral structure that is causally used and recoverable as a portable kernel.

    中文

    先验数据拟合网络（PFN）通过一次前向传播执行近似贝叶斯推断，而基于它们构建的表格基础模型（TFM）如今已得到广泛应用。为了理解网络内部推断了什么，近期针对 TFM 的机制研究定位了预测形成的位置，但将这些模型视作表格预测器，而非 PFN。因此，PFN 是否表征其上下文的谱内容（即决定平稳核的量），以及能否将这种内容读出为显式核，仍是未知问题。我们回答了这两个问题。首先，在七个 PFN 中，包括四个预训练 TFM 和一个仅在决策树先验上训练的模型，残差流上的线性探针能够恢复上下文的频率，精度为 $R^2 \geq 0.95$。这一结构由一个主方向主导。其次，激活和子空间修补实验表明，网络通过一个低维子空间使用这一结构，其中少数谱方向对预测的影响远大于随机方向。即使在决策树模型中也是如此，因此并不需要谱训练先验。在最多包含 499 个特征的真实数据集上，TabPFN 的 192 个方向中有 64 个（这些方向是在不使用标签的情况下选出的），在除一对数据集外的所有情况中承载了上下文因果效应的 85% 至 95%。第三，我们提出滤波器组解码器，通过 Bochner 定理将冻结的 PFN 表征转化为显式平稳核。无需任何测试时优化，解码出的核就能支持高斯过程回归，其性能可与深度核学习和随机傅里叶特征相当，成本约低 $200\times$。因此，PFN 潜在表征中包含谱结构；这些结构既在因果层面被使用，也能被恢复为可移植的核。

    Test-Time Scaling with Diffusion Language Models via Reward-Guided Stitching

    通过奖励引导的拼接实现扩散语言模型的测试时扩展

    Roy Miles, Aysim Toker, Andreea-Maria Oncescu, Jiankang Deng, Ismail Elezi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces reward-guided stitching that recombines intermediate steps from diffusion-sampled trajectories, improving math and coding performance while reducing latency. This directly advances multi-step reasoning and offers a substantive search and synthesis pipeline, with step recombination providing a secondary compositional contribution.

    本文提出奖励引导的拼接方法，将扩散采样轨迹中的中间步骤重新组合，在提升数学和代码表现的同时降低延迟。这直接推动了多步推理的发展，并提供了重要的搜索与合成流程；步骤重组也带来次要的组合性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning with large language models often benefits from generating multiple chains-of-thought, but existing aggregation strategies are typically trajectory-level (e.g., selecting the best trace or voting on the final answer), discarding useful intermediate work from partial or "nearly correct" attempts. We propose Stitching Noisy Diffusion Thoughts, a self-consistency framework that turns cheap diffusion-sampled reasoning into a reusable pool of step-level candidates. Given a problem, we (i) sample many diverse, low-cost reasoning trajectories using a masked diffusion language model, (ii) score every intermediate step with an off-the-shelf process reward model (PRM), and (iii) stitch these highest-quality steps across trajectories into a composite rationale. This rationale is then used to recompute only the final answer. This modular pipeline separates exploration (diffusion) from evaluation and solution synthesis, avoiding monolithic unified hybrids while preserving broad search. Across math reasoning benchmarks, we find that step-level recombination is most beneficial on harder problems, and ablations highlight the importance of the final solver in converting stitched but imperfect rationales into accurate answers. Using low-confidence diffusion sampling with parallel, independent rollouts, our training-free framework improves average accuracy by up to 23.8% across six math and coding tasks. At the same time, it achieves up to a 1.8x latency reduction relative to both traditional diffusion models (e.g., Dream, LLaDA) and unified architectures (e.g., TiDAR). The code is available https://github.com/roymiles/diffusion-stitching

    中文

    使用大语言模型进行推理通常受益于生成多条思维链，但现有聚合策略通常以轨迹为单位（例如选择最佳轨迹或对最终答案投票），会丢弃部分正确或“几乎正确”尝试中的有用中间成果。我们提出 Stitching Noisy Diffusion Thoughts，这是一种自洽框架，可将低成本的扩散采样推理转化为可复用的步骤级候选池。给定一个问题，我们会：（i）使用掩码扩散语言模型采样许多多样且低成本的推理轨迹；（ii）使用现成的过程奖励模型（PRM）为每个中间步骤打分；（iii）将不同轨迹中质量最高的步骤拼接成一份组合式推理过程。随后利用这份推理过程重新计算最终答案即可。该模块化流程将探索（扩散）与评估和解题合成分离开来，避免构建庞大的一体化混合模型，同时保留广泛搜索能力。在数学推理基准上的实验显示，步骤级重组对更难的问题最有帮助；消融实验突出表明，最终求解器对于将拼接后但并不完美的推理过程转化为准确答案至关重要。采用低置信度扩散采样和并行独立的多次生成后，我们的免训练框架在六项数学和代码任务上的平均准确率最高提升 23.8%。与此同时，相较于传统扩散模型（如 Dream、LLaDA）和统一架构（如 TiDAR），其延迟最高降低 1.8 倍。代码见 https://github.com/roymiles/diffusion-stitching

    Stop Probing, Start Coding: Why Linear Probes and Sparse Autoencoders Fail at Compositional Generalisation

    停止探测，开始编码：线性探针与稀疏自编码器为何无法实现组合泛化

    Vit\'oria Barin-Pacela and Shruti Joshi, Isabela Camacho, Simon Lacoste-Julien, David Klindt

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses controlled experiments on synthetic settings and real LLM activations to show that SAE-learned dictionaries, rather than inference procedures, limit recovery under superposition and OOD compositional shifts. This directly advances representation-mechanism understanding and compositional generalization; its sparse inference setting has only an incidental connection to reasoning or system organization.

    论文在合成设置和真实 LLM 激活上开展受控实验，表明在叠加和 OOD 组合变化下，限制恢复能力的是 SAE 学得的字典，而非推断过程。这直接推进了对表征机制和组合泛化的理解；其稀疏推断设置与推理或系统组织只有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The linear representation hypothesis states that neural network activations encode high-level concepts as linear mixtures. However, under superposition, this encoding is a projection from a higher-dimensional concept space into a lower-dimensional activation space, and a linear decision boundary in the concept space need not remain linear after projection. In this setting, classical sparse coding methods with per-sample iterative inference leverage compressed sensing guarantees to recover latent factors. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs), on the other hand, amortise sparse inference into a fixed encoder, introducing a systematic gap. We show this amortisation gap persists across training set sizes, latent dimensions, and sparsity levels, causing SAEs to fail under out-of-distribution (OOD) compositional shifts. Through controlled experiments that decompose the failure, we identify dictionary learning as the limiting factor (not the inference procedure): SAE-learned dictionaries point in substantially wrong directions, and replacing the encoder with per-sample FISTA on the same dictionary does not close the gap. An oracle baseline proves the problem is solvable with a good dictionary at all scales tested. Our results, including experiments with real LLM activations (Pythia-70M, Gemma-2-2B) reframe the SAE failure as a dictionary learning challenge, not an inference problem, and point to scalable dictionary learning as the key open problem for sparse inference under superposition.

    中文

    线性表征假说认为，神经网络激活以线性混合的形式编码高层概念。然而，在叠加情况下，这种编码是从高维概念空间到低维激活空间的投影，而概念空间中的线性决策边界经过投影后未必仍然是线性的。在这种情形下，采用逐样本迭代推断的经典稀疏编码方法可利用压缩感知保证来恢复潜在因子。另一方面，稀疏自编码器（SAE）将稀疏推断摊销到固定编码器中，从而引入系统性差距。我们表明，这一摊销差距会在不同训练集规模、潜在维度和稀疏度下持续存在，导致 SAE 在分布外（OOD）组合变化下失效。通过分解失效原因的受控实验，我们发现瓶颈在于字典学习（而非推断过程）：SAE 学得的字典方向存在显著偏差，在同一字典上用逐样本 FISTA 替换编码器也无法弥合差距。一个 oracle 基线证明，在所有测试规模下，只要字典良好，这个问题就可以解决。我们的结果（包括使用真实 LLM 激活的实验，模型为 Pythia-70M 和 Gemma-2-2B）将 SAE 的失效重新界定为字典学习挑战，而非推断问题，并指出可扩展的字典学习是叠加情况下稀疏推断亟待解决的关键问题。

    State Stream Transformer (SST) V2: Parallel Training of Nonlinear Recurrence for Latent Space Reasoning

    State Stream Transformer（SST）V2：用于潜在空间推理的非线性递归并行训练

    Thea Aviss

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SST V2 introduces a trainable nonlinear latent recurrence for deliberation and reports reasoning gains, while hidden-state analyses support a mechanistic account of how latent beliefs are carried forward, making reasoning central and representation mechanisms a substantial contribution. Its learned blending composes state information across positions, but the abstract gives limited evidence of systematic compositional generalization; adaptive depth and recurrence are relevant to systems, though secondary to the reasoning contribution.

    SST V2 引入可训练的非线性潜在递归用于推演，并报告了推理能力提升；对隐藏状态的分析还支持一种机制解释，说明潜在信念如何向前传递。因此，推理是其核心主题，对表征机制也有重要贡献。它通过学习混合来组合不同位置的状态信息，但摘要对系统性组合泛化的证据有限；自适应深度和递归与系统领域相关，不过其重要性次于推理贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Current transformers discard their rich latent residual stream between positions, reconstructing latent reasoning context at each new position and leaving potential reasoning capacity untapped. The State Stream Transformer (SST) V2 enables parameter-efficient reasoning in continuous latent space through an FFN-driven nonlinear recurrence at each decoder layer, where latent states are streamed horizontally across the full sequence via a learned blend. This same mechanism supports continuous latent deliberation per position at inference time, dedicating additional FLOPs to exploring abstract reasoning before committing to a token. A two-pass parallel training procedure approximates the sequential recurrence, making co-training computationally practical. Hidden state analysis shows that the state stream facilitates reasoning through sharp, content-dependent reorganisations in continuous latent space; the LM head exposes the resulting latent belief states through the output distribution, while the state stream carries them forward to influence future positions. A learned probe shows that at the first generated token, the latent state already predicts whether the eventual answer will survive or break under additional latent computation for every subsequent position. Co-trained into an existing 27B backbone using only a small dataset of GSM8K examples and evaluated using an oracle to route each question to a depth of one to four recurrent forward passes per token, the SST achieves an architectural capacity bound of 61.11% on out-of-distribution GPQA-Diamond, a +15.15 point gain over a fine-tuning-matched baseline, and cuts that same baseline's remaining GSM8K errors by 46%. Together, these results provide a method for efficiently training a nonlinear recurrence and show that the state stream provides additional reasoning capacity beyond that of an otherwise training-matched transformer.

    中文

    当前 Transformer 会丢弃位置之间丰富的潜在残差流，在每个新位置重新构建潜在推理上下文，因此未能充分利用潜在推理能力。State Stream Transformer（SST）V2 通过每个解码器层中由 FFN 驱动的非线性递归，实现连续潜在空间中的参数高效推理；潜在状态通过一种学习得到的混合方式，沿水平方向流经整个序列。相同机制也支持推理时在每个位置进行连续潜在推演，为抽象推理投入额外 FLOPs，再决定输出 token。两遍并行训练过程近似了顺序递归，使联合训练在计算上切实可行。隐藏状态分析表明，状态流通过连续潜在空间中依赖内容的显著重组来促进推理；LM 头通过输出分布呈现由此产生的潜在信念状态，而状态流则将这些状态向前传递，以影响后续位置。一个学习得到的探针表明，在首个生成 token 处，潜在状态已经能够预测：在后续每个位置增加潜在计算后，最终答案会保持成立还是失效。将 SST 联合训练到现有的 27B 骨干模型中时只使用了一小份 GSM8K 示例数据集；评估时使用 oracle 将每个问题路由到每个 token 进行一至四次递归前向传递的深度。SST 在分布外 GPQA-Diamond 上达到 61.11% 的架构容量上限，较微调匹配基线提升 15.15 个百分点，并将该基线在 GSM8K 上剩余的错误减少了 46%。总体而言，这些结果提供了一种高效训练非线性递归的方法，并表明状态流能在其他方面训练匹配的 Transformer 之外提供额外的推理能力。

    Michael Li and Nishant Subramani

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures whether identified model circuits consistently and specifically explain behavior, finding a tradeoff between component- and neuron-level circuits. This directly advances mechanistic interpretability; task comparisons do not substantively address compositional generalization, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文衡量已识别的模型电路能否始终如一且有针对性地解释行为，并发现组件级电路与神经元级电路之间存在权衡。这项工作直接推动了机制可解释性；任务间比较并未实质性涉及组合泛化、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The circuits framework in mechanistic interpretability aims to identify sparse subgraphs of model components that are causally responsible for a behavior, typically evaluated by measuring necessity and sufficiency. But these criteria say little about whether a circuit consistently captures how a model performs a task, or if it is specific to that task. We study these two properties, consistency and specificity, across six tasks and five models, extracting circuits at the component level (attention heads and MLP blocks) and at the level of individual MLP neurons. We find that component-level circuits are highly consistent and causally important for most tasks, but they are not specific: for a given task, ablating its own circuit drops accuracy by about as much as ablating another task's circuit. Neuron-level circuits, on the other hand, exhibit higher specificity across tasks, but far less consistency within tasks. This is explained by circuit overlap: component-level circuits share most of their components across tasks, related or not, while neuron-level circuits overlap only between closely related tasks. In a case study of the components shared by the task circuits of Llama-3.2-3B, we show that they consist mostly of MLP blocks, while the few attention heads within turn out to have general-purpose roles. Overall, our findings raise questions about the degree to which circuits can support targeted understanding of, and intervention on, model behavior.

    中文

    机制可解释性中的电路框架旨在识别对某种行为负有因果责任的模型组件稀疏子图，通常通过衡量必要性和充分性来评估。然而，这些标准很难说明电路是否始终如一地捕捉模型执行某项任务的方式，或它是否专门对应这项任务。我们在六项任务和五个模型上研究这两种属性——一致性和特异性；提取组件级别（注意力头和 MLP 块）以及单个 MLP 神经元级别的电路。我们发现，对于大多数任务，组件级电路具有很高的一致性且因果作用显著，但缺乏特异性：对于给定任务，消融其自身电路造成的准确率下降，与消融另一项任务的电路造成的下降大致相当。另一方面，神经元级电路在不同任务间表现出更高的特异性，但在同一任务内的一致性要低得多。这可以由电路重叠解释：组件级电路在不同任务间共享大多数组件，无论任务是否相关；而神经元级电路只在密切相关的任务间重叠。在一项针对 Llama-3.2-3B 各任务电路所共享组件的案例研究中，我们发现这些组件主要由 MLP 块组成，其中少数注意力头则发挥通用作用。总体而言，我们的发现促使人们思考，电路在多大程度上能够支持对模型行为进行有针对性的理解和干预。

    The work builds memory evolution graphs and an attribution method to locate failures in LLM memory pipelines, then uses those signals for prompt optimization. This directly advances memory tracing and debugging in model systems; tracing operational information flow offers partial mechanistic insight, but the abstract does not study internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug. Tracing memory's dynamic evolution is crucial to understand how information is synthesized, propagated, or corrupted over time. In this work, we study the new problem of error tracing and attribution in LLM memory systems. We propose a novel framework that transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, enabling fine-grained tracing of operational information flow. We then construct MemTraceBench, a benchmark collected from representative memory systems such as Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS, to systematically study memory failure modes. We further introduce an automatic attribution method that iteratively traces operation subgraphs to pinpoint the root cause of any failed case. Our analysis reveals that memory failures are systematic, stemming from operation-level issues like information loss and retrieval misalignment. Crucially, we leverage these fine-grained attribution signals to guide downstream prompt optimization, establishing a closed-loop system that automatically corrects faults and boosts end-task performance by up to 7.62 percentage points. Code has ben released at https://github.com/zjunlp/MemTrace.

    Memory by Design: Probabilistic Sequence Layers

    设计即记忆：概率序列层

    Matthew Dowling, Hyungju Jeon, Cristina Savin, Il Memming Park

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives recurrent sequence layers from explicit Bayesian memory assumptions and shows that covariance-aware memory improves retrieval robustness, making model memory and computation central contributions. Its discussion of internal representations and associative recall is incidental to this systems design, with no direct interpretability or reasoning-mechanism contribution.

    本文基于显式贝叶斯记忆假设推导循环序列层，并表明具备协方差感知能力的记忆能够提升检索鲁棒性，因此模型记忆与计算是其核心贡献。对内部表征和联想回忆的讨论服务于这一系统设计，并非直接的可解释性或推理机制贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce the \emph{design-model framework}: a way to derive efficient recurrent sequence maps from explicit assumptions about memory. A design model writes evidence into memory by exact Bayesian filtering; a query- dependent readout produces a predictive distribution whose mean is the layer output. In our linear-Gaussian instantiation, the \emph{Bayesian Layer} propagates both a mean and a covariance: the covariance tracks uncertainty over stored associations, steering writes toward uncertain directions, attenuating gains as evidence accumulates, and preserving confident memories. The same framework unifies several sub-quadratic recurrences: linear attention, GLA, and Mamba-2/SSD are exact filters under a latent-input design model, whereas DeltaNet and related Delta-rule models are covariance-reset reductions of the Bayesian Layer's design model. Restoring covariance propagation yields closed-form predictions for retrieval dynamics, which we verify empirically, and improves robustness beyond the training regime in controlled collision studies, learned associative recall, and the Zoology MQAR benchmark. Training from scratch on WikiText-103 under matched state budgets lowers perplexity on associative-recall hits. Distilling Bayesian Layers into a pretrained 340M Gated DeltaNet improves RULER long-context retrieval over a matched-compute control, at a 2.5--2.7\% held-out perplexity cost.

    中文

    我们提出“设计模型框架”：一种根据关于记忆的显式假设推导高效循环序列映射的方法。设计模型通过精确贝叶斯滤波将证据写入记忆；依赖查询的读出会产生预测分布，其均值即为层的输出。在我们的线性高斯实例中，“贝叶斯层”同时传播均值和协方差：协方差跟踪已存关联的不确定性，引导写入指向不确定方向，随着证据累积而降低增益，并保留置信度高的记忆。同一框架统一了若干次二次方复杂度的递归结构：在线性注意力、GLA 和 Mamba-2/SSD 中，潜在输入设计模型下的递归是精确滤波器；而 DeltaNet 及相关 Delta-rule 模型则是贝叶斯层设计模型中重置协方差的简化形式。恢复协方差传播后，可得到检索动态的闭式预测；我们通过实证对其进行了验证，并发现它在受控碰撞研究、学习式联想回忆和 Zoology MQAR 基准测试中提升了超出训练范围的鲁棒性。在状态预算匹配的条件下从头开始于 WikiText-103 上训练，可降低联想回忆命中时的困惑度。将贝叶斯层蒸馏到预训练的 340M Gated DeltaNet 中，相比计算量匹配的对照组，提升了 RULER 长上下文检索能力，但留出集困惑度增加 2.5--2.7%。

    Yingyu Shan, Yuhang Guo, Zihao Cheng, Zeming Liu, Xiangrong Zhu, Xinyi Wang, Jiashu Yao, Wei Lin, Hongru Wang, Heyan Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes self-conditioned token-level credit assignment for RLVR and reports improved reasoning-task performance, directly advancing methods for training reasoning capabilities. Its use of token KL weights is not an interpretability contribution, and the agentic benchmarks do not establish a broader systems advance.

    本文提出用于 RLVR 的自条件 token 级信用分配方法，并报告了推理任务性能提升，直接推进了推理能力训练方法的发展。其对 token KL 权重的使用并非可解释性贡献，而智能体基准测试也不足以证明更广泛的系统进步。

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in training LLMs for reasoning tasks, but representative methods such as GRPO assign uniform credit across all tokens, wasting gradient on routine tokens while under-crediting pivotal reasoning steps. Existing token-level credit assignment methods require resources beyond the model's own rollouts. GRPO variants rely on process reward models or ground-truth answers. Knowledge distillation assigns credit through per-token divergence but requires external teachers (On-Policy Distillation) or privileged information (On-Policy Self Distillation). However, these dependencies limit applicability in the pure RLVR setting. We observe that conditioning the model on its own verified trajectories induces a measurable per-token KL divergence between the original and conditioned distributions, and prove that distilling from a self-teacher constructed by verified trajectories leads to infeasible weighted-average solutions when multiple verified trajectories exist. We propose SC-GRPO (Self-Conditioned GRPO), which uses KL divergence mentioned before as a multiplicative weight on GRPO gradients. Across five benchmarks spanning math, code, and agentic tasks, SC-GRPO consistently outperforms 8.1% over GRPO and 5.9% over DAPO with stronger OOD performance. Moreover, SC-GRPO achieves higher performance than OPD.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）推动了 LLM 在推理任务训练方面的显著进展，但 GRPO 等代表性方法会在所有 token 间均匀分配信用，导致梯度浪费在常规 token 上，而关键推理步骤得到的信用不足。现有的 token 级信用分配方法需要模型自身轨迹之外的资源。GRPO 变体依赖过程奖励模型或真实答案。知识蒸馏通过逐 token 散度分配信用，但需要外部教师（On-Policy Distillation）或特权信息（On-Policy Self Distillation）。然而，这些依赖限制了其在纯 RLVR 场景中的适用性。我们观察到，以模型自身经验证的轨迹为条件，会在原始分布与条件分布之间产生可测量的逐 token KL 散度；并证明，当存在多个经验证轨迹时，从由这些轨迹构造的自教师进行蒸馏，会导致不可行的加权平均解。我们提出 SC-GRPO（自条件 GRPO），将前述 KL 散度用作 GRPO 梯度的乘法权重。在涵盖数学、代码和智能体任务的五个基准测试中，SC-GRPO 的表现持续优于 GRPO 8.1%，优于 DAPO 5.9%，且 OOD 性能更强。此外，SC-GRPO 的表现也优于 OPD。

    Compute Globally, Materialize Locally: The Memory Contract of Sparse Event-KV

    Zefeng Cai, Zerui Cai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper experimentally characterizes semantic materialization in KV-cache rows and derives a memory contract for sparse serving, including what survives omission of source observations and how phrasing affects recovery. This directly advances memory design and use in long-horizon agents; its findings about cached information offer limited insight into stored knowledge, but do not investigate internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文通过实验刻画 KV 缓存行中的语义物化，并由此推导稀疏服务的内存契约，包括省略源观察后哪些信息能够保留，以及措辞如何影响恢复。这直接推进了长时程智能体的记忆设计与使用；关于缓存信息的发现对存储知识提供了有限见解，但没有研究内部表征或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agents increasingly reuse their KV cache as memory: a serving system keeps a subset of cached entries and drops the rest. Eviction and episodic-memory schemes therefore rest on a premise rarely tested directly, that a retained event is still informative once the observations that produced it are gone. We test it by omitting one earlier observation from what is served, across otherwise identical agent histories. Among items sensitive to that observation, the answer overwhelmingly follows the omitted value, though no served span says which value is correct. We call this semantic materialization: a downstream event's cached rows act as an independently servable view of computation whose inputs are gone. It can also be written on purpose. A deliberately phrased, answer-free event raises donor-aligned recovery from 6% to 51% on Qwen3-8B without ever naming the value, whereas passively harvesting natural mentions from long-term dialog yields no detected advantage. What such a row carries is specific and bounded. Compact state survives, larger payloads decay toward chance, and whether a construction writes at all turns on phrasing rather than on meaning alone, so two phrasings the model comprehends equally well can diverge sharply. The result is a memory contract for sparse event-KV serving: what to write, where it lands, and what survives once the source is gone. For anyone who evicts the corollary is that dropping a source event and observing no accuracy loss does not show the source was unnecessary.

    中文

    长时程智能体越来越多地将 KV 缓存用作记忆：服务系统保留一部分缓存条目，并丢弃其余部分。因此，淘汰和情景记忆方案依赖一个很少被直接检验的前提：产生某个事件的观察已被移除后，保留下来的事件仍然包含有用信息。我们在其他条件相同的智能体历史中，省略服务内容中的一条早期观察来检验这一点。对于受该观察影响的项目，答案绝大多数会跟随被省略观察中的值，尽管服务内容中没有任何片段指出哪个值才正确。我们将此称为语义物化：下游事件的缓存行充当一种可独立服务的计算视图，而它的输入已经不存在。这种内容也可以有意写入。一个刻意措辞、不给出答案的事件，在 Qwen3-8B 上将与来源值一致的恢复率从 6% 提高到 51%，同时从未直接提及该值；而从长期对话中被动提取自然提及，则没有带来可检测的优势。这类缓存行承载的信息具有特定范围和边界。紧凑状态能够保留，较大载荷则会衰减至接近随机猜测水平；而某种构造能否写入信息，取决于措辞而不只是含义，因此模型同样能够理解的两种说法，效果可能截然不同。研究由此为稀疏事件 KV 服务提出了一份内存契约：写入什么、写入何处，以及源信息消失后能保留什么。对于进行淘汰的系统而言，其推论是：移除一个源事件后观察到准确率没有下降，并不能说明该源事件并无必要。

    Ruike Cao, Fanyu Zhao, Fugen Yao, Liang Dong, Jian Xu, Yifei Zhao, Han Zhang, Li Xiao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemCalib benchmarks whether LLM agents use contextual memories with appropriate influence, and MemCalib-RL uses bidirectional counterfactual credit assignment with token-level ablation to improve that behavior. Memory use and its optimization are a core agent-systems contribution; token-level credit localization gives partial insight into behavior, while the abstract does not address compositional generalization or broader reasoning mechanisms.

    MemCalib 对 LLM 智能体是否恰当地利用上下文记忆的影响力进行基准评测；MemCalib-RL 则使用双向反事实信用分配和 token 级消融来改善这种行为。记忆使用及其优化是智能体系统的核心贡献；token 级信用定位对行为提供了一定洞见，但摘要没有涉及组合泛化或更广泛的推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The effectiveness of agent memory ultimately depends on whether the underlying LLM gives each memory in context an appropriate degree of influence over its response. Yet this capability has remained largely overlooked. To assess this capability, we introduce MemCalib, a benchmark grounded in realistic memory-system scenarios for evaluating memory use and advancing optimization algorithms. Results on the MemCalib test set reveal that frontier open- and closed-source models struggle to use memory appropriately. They frequently over-use or under-use memory rather than matching each proposition's actual use to its target level, leading to biased, low-quality responses. Experiments with common post-training algorithms, including group relative policy optimization and on-policy self-distillation, further reveal a clear directional skew: trained models improve in one direction while deteriorating in the other. We therefore propose MemCalib-RL, an ordered bidirectional counterfactual credit-assignment algorithm that separates over- and under-use signals and localizes their credit to response tokens through exact atom ablation. Results across model families and scales (Qwen3-8B, Ministral-3-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) show that MemCalib-RL achieves the best overall performance while better balancing over-use and under-use, with gains generalizing beyond MemCalib in external benchmark evaluation. Further experiments support its design choices and robustness and provide insight into its training dynamics.

    中文

    智能体记忆的效果最终取决于底层 LLM 是否给予上下文中的每条记忆适当的影响力。然而，这项能力在很大程度上一直被忽视。为了评估这项能力，我们推出 MemCalib：一个基于真实记忆系统场景构建的基准，用于评估记忆使用情况并推进优化算法的发展。MemCalib 测试集的结果显示，前沿开源和闭源模型都难以恰当使用记忆。它们经常过度使用或使用不足，而非让每条命题的实际使用程度与目标水平相匹配，因而生成有偏差、质量较低的回答。对常见后训练算法的实验（包括组相对策略优化和在线策略自蒸馏）进一步揭示了明显的方向性偏差：模型经过训练后会在一个方向上改进，却在另一方向上退化。因此，我们提出 MemCalib-RL，这是一种有序的双向反事实信用分配算法，通过精确的原子消融区分过度使用和使用不足的信号，并将其信用定位到回答 token。跨模型系列和规模的结果（Qwen3-8B、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）显示，MemCalib-RL 的总体表现最佳，同时更好地平衡了过度使用和使用不足；其收益也能泛化到 MemCalib 之外的外部基准评测。更多实验支持其设计选择和稳健性，并帮助揭示其训练动态。

    When to Evict, Not What to Keep: Draft-Guided Eviction for Training-Free KV-Cache Compression

    何时驱逐，而非保留什么：面向免训练 KV 缓存压缩的草稿引导驱逐

    Haeyong Kang, Chang D. Yoo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes delaying KV-cache eviction until draft answer tokens provide trajectory information, showing quality gains and identifying trajectory anchoring as the mechanism. This is a core contribution to model memory and computation organization; its connection to reasoning is partial because the method uses answer-prefix signals but does not primarily study reasoning capability.

    本文提出延迟 KV 缓存驱逐，直到草拟的答案 token 提供轨迹信息，并展示了质量提升，同时指出轨迹锚定是其作用机制。这是对模型记忆和计算组织的核心贡献；它与推理能力的联系较为间接，因为该方法利用答案前缀信号，但并未主要研究推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training-free KV-cache compression methods such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evict tokens at the end of prefill, aiming to preserve the attention mass that future queries are expected to use -optimizing what to keep. We show that this objective fails in two distinct ways. (1) Compensation: restoring the evicted attention mass can recover the attention-level target without recovering task quality. (2) Selection: covering more of the true decode-query mass can hurt quality when the recovered mass is fragmented rather than concentrated in coherent spans. These failures share a common cause: eviction occurs before the queries that determine the answer trajectory exist. We propose Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE), which defers eviction until after drafting the first k=2 answer tokens using the full cache - just one decode step beyond prefill. Because the draft is generated from the answer's own prefix, no cache entries are discarded before this trajectory signal becomes available. The per-head cache budget remains unchanged, and DGE can be applied directly to SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM without modifying their eviction scores. Unlike extra-pass methods, DGE changes when eviction occurs rather than what cache entries are selected. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGE outperforms prior methods at every evaluated budget on five of six instruct-tuned backbones, achieving 44.2 on LongBench, nearly matching FullKV at 44.3. The timing-only control DGE-W achieves the same score, demonstrating that the gain comes from when eviction occurs rather than what is selected - an effect we term trajectory anchoring.

    中文

    SnapKV、H2O 和 PyramidKV 等免训练 KV 缓存压缩方法会在预填充结束时驱逐 token，目标是保留未来查询预计会用到的注意力质量——优化保留什么。我们指出，这一目标在两个方面存在缺陷。（1）补偿：恢复被驱逐的注意力质量可以达到注意力层面的目标，却无法恢复任务质量。（2）选择：当恢复的质量是零散分布而非集中于连贯片段时，覆盖更多真实解码查询质量反而可能损害质量。这些缺陷有一个共同原因：驱逐发生时，决定答案轨迹的查询还不存在。我们提出 Draft-Guided Eviction（DGE），先使用完整缓存草拟答案的前 k=2 个 token，然后再延后执行驱逐——这只比预填充多一个解码步骤。由于草稿是根据答案自身的前缀生成的，在这一轨迹信号可用之前，不会丢弃任何缓存条目。每个头的缓存预算保持不变，DGE 可直接应用于 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O 和 StreamingLLM，且无需修改它们的驱逐评分。与需要额外遍历的方法不同，DGE 改变的是驱逐发生的时间，而非选中的缓存条目。大量实验表明，在六个经过指令微调的骨干模型中，有五个模型上，DGE 在每个评估预算下都优于先前方法；它在 LongBench 上取得 44.2，几乎达到 FullKV 的 44.3。仅改变时机的对照方法 DGE-W 取得了相同分数，这表明收益来自驱逐发生的时机，而非所选内容——我们将这一效应称为轨迹锚定。

    Zhinan Hou, Xingchen Li and Keyou You

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses latent-state geometry to identify concise reasoning states and constrains hidden states with a quadratic program, directly advancing reasoning efficiency and offering a mechanistic view of reasoning representations. Its use of latent space is not evidence of composition, and token savings alone provide only an incidental systems connection.

    本文利用潜在状态几何特征识别简洁的推理状态，并通过二次规划约束隐藏状态，直接提升了推理效率，也为推理表征提供了机制层面的视角。使用潜在空间并不构成组合能力的证据，而节省 token 仅与系统方面存在附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}.

    中文

    大型推理模型（LRM）展现出了卓越的推理能力，但仍会陷入过度思考，生成冗余的推理步骤，消耗大量 token。抑制反思性关键词或强制缩短推理长度等现有方法试图缓解这一问题，但不可避免地会截断必要步骤并导致思考不足，从而损害性能。为解决这一难题，我们研究潜在表征并观察到，高效的推理步骤自然聚集在潜在空间的一个集中区域，而偏离该区域的步骤往往会产生冗长序列。为利用这一现象，我们通过一个二次规划将偏离区域的隐藏状态投影回该区域，使推理保持聚焦。随后，我们提出一种全新的免训练框架，以实现高效推理，在不牺牲性能的情况下降低 token 生成成本。我们在四种规模从 1.5B 到 14B 的模型上，以及涵盖数学推理、编码和科学问答的六个基准上进行了大量实验，验证了该方法的有效性：准确率最高提升 12.1\%，生成 token 数减少 11.8\% 至 52.8\%。代码见 \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}。

    FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

    FlowState：作为长时程 LLM 智能体记忆的执行状态

    Minghao Li, Bangyan Li, Zifan Wang, Yulong Li, Hu Xu, Gan Zhang, Jingtong Wu, Wenqiang Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FlowState contributes an agent memory architecture that updates typed execution states and progressively retrieves prior states and evidence for long-horizon tasks. It supports later reasoning, but the abstract focuses on memory and agent organization rather than reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization; stored relations alone do not establish a composition contribution.

    FlowState 提出了一种智能体记忆架构，可更新类型化的执行状态，并为长时程任务渐进式检索先前状态及证据。它支持后续推理，但摘要侧重于记忆和智能体组织，而非推理机制或组合泛化；仅有存储的关系并不能证明其对组合能力有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs and feedback, while Progressive State Access (PSA) progressively reveals historical states and supporting evidence as needed during reasoning. Together, these mechanisms enable agents to reassess prior decisions in light of new information and guide subsequent actions. Compared with a full-context baseline using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, FlowState improves the average success rate on MemoryArena and the average pass rate on $\tau^3$-Bench by 4.55 and 13.95 percentage points, respectively, while reducing total token consumption by 43.2% and 40.6%. These results demonstrate the performance and efficiency advantages of FlowState on long-horizon tasks.

    中文

    长时程任务要求 LLM 智能体持续利用先前交互中的信息。然而，保留完整历史会增加上下文成本，而对其进行压缩又可能导致丢失之后所需的细节；并且历史信息的相关性往往要随着任务推进才会显现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 FlowState，它将执行状态视为可在不同请求间保留和重新访问的记忆，从而将当前决策与历史信息的复用统一起来。FlowState 保留语义类型化的状态节点、节点间的关系以及对原始工具观察结果的引用，将持久化保留与按需访问分离。在单个执行循环中，增量状态更新（ISU）根据新输入和反馈维护当前状态；渐进式状态访问（PSA）则在推理过程中根据需要逐步展示历史状态及其支持证据。这些机制共同使智能体能够结合新信息重新评估先前的决策，并指导后续行动。与使用相同 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模型的完整上下文基线相比，FlowState 在 MemoryArena 上的平均成功率和在 $\tau^3$-Bench 上的平均通过率分别提高了 4.55 和 13.95 个百分点，同时将 token 总消耗分别降低了 43.2% 和 40.6%。这些结果表明，FlowState 在长时程任务上兼具性能和效率优势。

    Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval

    因果记忆策略：通过干预检索使记忆效用可识别

    Arman Behnam, Binghui Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CMP makes memory utility identifiable by randomizing retrieval and provides estimators, guarantees, and evidence that identified utility does not predict value on unseen queries. This directly advances memory policy in model systems; task-performance evaluation is only incidental to reasoning, with no substantive interpretability or compositional contribution.

    CMP 通过随机化检索使记忆效用可识别，并提供估计量、理论保证，以及已识别的效用无法预测未见查询价值的证据。这直接推动了模型系统中的记忆策略；任务表现评估与推理的联系只是附带的，本文没有实质性的可解释性或组合性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

    中文

    增强记忆的大型语言模型必须决定保留哪些记忆，近期系统通过估计每条记忆对任务表现的影响来做出决定。然而，这些估计完全依赖于被检索到的记忆。如果一条记忆从未被检索，存储层面的干预就会产生相同结果，使其效用无法识别。这是一种检索层面的正值性违反，仅检查记忆操作的诊断无法发现。我们提出因果记忆策略（CMP），通过直接干预检索来恢复可识别性：为以已知倾向概率抽取的记忆预留固定数量的上下文槽位。CMP 在平衡分配设计下，使用自归一化逆倾向加权来估计记忆效用。我们证明了记忆效用经由检索的因果分解、该估计量的无偏性和精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。实证结果显示，在 LongMemEval 上，54% 的必要记忆无法识别，在 LoCoMo 上这一比例为 67%，而且该问题在已部署的记忆系统中仍然存在。CMP 将区分必要与非必要记忆的能力从 0.54 AUC 提高到 0.66 AUC。最后，我们表明，仅凭已识别的记忆效用仍不足以做出保留决策：针对某次查询估计的逐查询效用，在该查询上达到 0.78 AUC，但保留策略可用的任何聚合方式都无法预测记忆在未见查询上的价值。代码见：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/。

    When Should an In-Context Learner Expand Its Hypothesis Space?

    上下文学习者何时应扩展其假设空间？

    Weihan Li, Xinlei Chen, Junhao Wu, Tianshi Zheng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a normative account of when an in-context learner should revise its model family, then tests whether trained learners and language models make that decision. It strongly advances reasoning about sequential structural decisions; hypothesis expansion has a substantive compositional generalization connection, while representation mechanisms and system design are secondary.

    论文提出何时应修订上下文学习者的模型族的规范性解释，并测试训练出的学习者和语言模型是否会作出这项决策。它有力推进了对序贯结构性决策的研究；假设扩展与组合泛化有实质联系，而表征机制和系统设计则居次要地位。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learning systems adapt quickly inside a familiar family of models. The harder step comes earlier: deciding, from observations that could be noise, an exception, a change within the family or structure outside it, whether opening a richer family is worth its cost. We treat this as a costly sequential decision: prediction failure must be turned into structural evidence, evidence into a value of expansion, and value into action. The Structural Revision Environment produces matched failures from each source, varies the price of expansion and the remaining horizon independently of the evidence, and admits exact Bayesian calculations and an exact normative solution of the one-shot decision. Its solution shows that revision is a value boundary and not an evidence threshold: one history has different optimal actions under different prices, horizons and announced queries, the boundary between local repair and expansion is set by the inputs a rule predicts and a repair cannot cover, and belief in the richer family crosses long before the decision does. Transformers trained in the environment reproduce this boundary from utility alone. Language models of three post-training lineages carry a failure-sensitive signal in their predictions that is not reflected in their revision decisions, and given the gain of expanding they read it without weighing it against price and horizon. Three models allowed to reason weigh the stated gain in the reference's proportions and still do not turn the history into an estimate of what expansion would buy. Controlled post-training of the meta-trained learners moves the prior and the sharpness of predictions, and neither moves the criterion.

    中文

    学习系统能在熟悉的模型族内部迅速适应。更困难的一步发生在更早阶段：面对可能是噪声、例外、族内变化或族外结构的观测，判断是否值得付出代价来开启一个更丰富的模型族。我们将其视为一个有成本的序贯决策：必须把预测失败转化为结构性证据，再把证据转化为扩展价值，最后将价值转化为行动。结构修订环境会生成来自每种来源的匹配失败，在保持证据不变的情况下独立改变扩展代价和剩余时间范围，并且支持精确的贝叶斯计算和一次性决策的精确规范性解。其解表明，修订的依据是价值边界，而不是证据阈值：同一段历史在不同代价、时间范围和已公布查询下会对应不同的最优行动；局部修补与扩展之间的边界由规则能够预测的输入，以及修补无法覆盖的输入决定；而对更丰富模型族的信念会远早于决策本身越过阈值。在这一环境中训练的 Transformer 仅凭效用就能复现这条边界。来自三种后训练路线的语言模型，其预测中带有对失败敏感的信号，但这一信号并未反映在它们的修订决策中；给出扩展收益后，它们会读取该信号，却不会权衡代价和时间范围。允许进行推理的三个模型会按参考模型中的比例权衡给定的收益，但仍无法把历史信息转化为对扩展实际收益的估计。对元训练学习者进行受控后训练会改变其先验和预测的尖锐程度，但这两者都不会改变决策准则。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by (1) suppressing retrieval of the original answer (e.g., "Madrid") while (2) promoting a favored candidate within the answer category (e.g., "Paris"). This contrasts with accounts of human negation processing, in which information about the original answer helps to determine what should be excluded. Furthermore, we find that this difference from human processing is a key source of negation failures: the model's mechanism relies on suppressing the original answer rather than using it to determine what to exclude, so the model can repeat the original answer when suppression is too weak or when a bias toward particular answers prevents it from selecting an alternative. To address this weakness in the model's negation mechanism, we propose a training objective that requires larger shifts in answer preference for more confident original predictions, and show that it reduces negation failures with less degradation of general capabilities than standard fine-tuning baselines. Together, our results demonstrate how mechanistic analysis can reveal why a linguistic capability fails and guide training that targets the underlying limitation.

    中文

    否定是人类语言的一项基本特征，但大型语言模型（LLM）处理否定时仍不可靠。我们使用否定基准评估了近期的开源和闭源 LLM，发现 37%–71% 的情况下，它们在否定语境下仍重复相同答案（例如，对“西班牙的首都不是哪里？”回答“马德里”）。为了理解并解决这种脆弱性，我们对模型处理否定的方式进行了机制层面的检查。我们的主要发现是，专门化的注意力头和 MLP 神经元共同实现否定，具体方式是：(1) 抑制对原始答案（例如“马德里”）的提取，同时 (2) 在答案类别中提升一个更受偏好的候选项（例如“巴黎”）。这不同于对人类否定处理的解释；根据后者，有关原始答案的信息有助于确定应排除什么。此外，我们发现，与人类处理方式的这一差异是模型否定失败的关键来源：模型机制依赖抑制原始答案，而非利用原始答案来确定应排除什么，因此当抑制力度不足，或对特定答案的偏好使模型无法选择其他答案时，模型就可能重复原始答案。为弥补模型否定机制的这一弱点，我们提出一种训练目标：原始预测越有把握，答案偏好就必须发生越大的变化。我们证明，与标准微调基线相比，该方法减少了否定失败，同时对一般能力的损害更小。总之，我们的结果表明，机制分析能够揭示语言能力为何失效，并指导针对底层局限性的训练。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SLVR 训练具有类型的潜在阶段，用于规划、定位、证据选择和整合，从而在推理时不使用文本 CoT 的情况下提升视觉推理能力。推理是其核心贡献；分阶段组合和推理效率具有相关性，但属于次要方面，且该工作并未分析内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration. SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.

    中文

    多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）回答视觉推理问题时，往往依赖语言先验，而非与任务相关的视觉证据。文本思维链推理可以通过鼓励模型将视觉问题分解为寻找中间证据的步骤，在一定程度上缓解这一问题，但自回归生成这些步骤会增加推理成本。潜在推理无需显式生成理由，但现有方法对中间状态所编码内容的控制有限，因此难以分别对规划、定位和证据选择施加监督。我们提出结构化潜在视觉推理（SLVR），这是一种连接显式思维链与潜在推理的训练框架，它将多模态推理组织为具有类型的潜在阶段，分别用于规划、定位、证据选择和推理整合。 SLVR 首先通过屏蔽揭示答案的文本，并将正确答案与视觉上似是而非的干扰项进行对比，训练模型依赖图像。随后，它将推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择和整合等潜在阶段，并使用相应信号监督各阶段：计划、框、视觉证据和最终理由。这样一来，潜在推理具有明确的功能结构，同时避免在推理时生成文本链。 基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 构建的 SLVR 在多模态推理基准上均取得稳定提升，在 MMVP 上绝对提升 +9.4，在 BLINK Relation 上绝对提升 +14.2，并且在 V*、MathVista 和 ChartQA 上也有所提升。这些结果表明，结构化潜在监督能够改善细粒度视觉推理，同时避免文本 CoT 的解码开销。项目页面见 \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{此处}。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term agents face growing storage demands as they accumulate experience. World models capture reusable regularities that can reduce the information stored for each experience. We formulate the problem of memory allocation conditioned on a world model and introduce MemoWM, a framework that uses shared predictions to compress retained information and reconstruct omitted content. Its task-aware allocation rule balances the expected impact of reconstruction errors against storage cost, retaining information with downstream value beyond the predictive prior. Across five long-term agent-memory benchmarks, MemoWM achieves 42.42\% average answer accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.62 percentage points, while reducing average experience-specific storage by 53.9\% relative to MIRIX, the most storage-efficient baseline. Further analysis shows that stronger world models reduce per-experience storage at comparable task quality. Accounting for model parameters reveals a trade-off between shared model capacity and recurring storage costs, with the capacity that minimizes total storage increasing as more interactions are retained. Our code is available at https://github.com/Feld-maxiu/MemoWM.

    Gengze Zhou, Yicong Hong, Jiazhao Zhang, Xunyi Zhao, Jian Zhou, Zixing Lei, Zun Wang, Chongyang Zhao, Xionghui Chen, Stephen Gould, Anton van den Hengel, Qi Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NavGPT-3 contributes a hierarchical runtime that schedules reasoning, action, and monitoring threads, integrating a language model with a fast control policy for embodied navigation. It reports reasoning-related behavior but centers on agent architecture and coordination; token allocation and model ablations do not investigate internal representations.

    NavGPT-3 提出了一种分层运行时，用于调度推理、行动和监控线程，并将语言模型与快速控制策略集成起来，以实现具身导航。论文报告了与推理相关的行为，但核心在于智能体架构和协调；token 分配和模型消融并未研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.

    中文

    通过长时程智能体强化学习训练的语言模型，能够通过推理泛化知识、表达精确行动，并跨许多步骤追求目标，从而提高具身智能体理解和决策能力的上限。然而，物理交互仍属于行动策略的范畴，因为行动策略能提供密集、低延迟的控制。我们提出 NavGPT-3，这是一个连接这两种模型的支撑框架，并在其上构建了类似操作系统的运行时：推理、行动和监控以线程形式运行，各自拥有上下文、工具和权限；运行时负责调度这些线程，并决定由哪个线程控制机器人的运动，使机器人能够通过中断和线程切换应对突发的现实事件。在其下层，我们的行动策略 NavGPT VLA 使用 19.28M 个样例进行训练，并按照场景变化的比例，通过 codec allocation 分配视觉 token；仅该 8B 模型在 R2R-CE 上就达到 74.51 SR，并以 78.19 SR 在 RxR-CE 上领先。使用完整支撑框架后，NavGPT-3 在 R2R-CE 上达到最先进水平（81.51 SR），并首次使自主智能体达到人类水平：在 RxR-CE 上，其成功率（90.43 对 90.4 SR）和路径保真度（78.47 对 77.7 nDTW）与人类跟随者相当，每个回合耗时 1 分 22 秒，而人类约需 3 分钟。我们全面消融了支撑框架设计以及两个模型之间的交互，展示工具和行动策略如何塑造从语言模型推理到物理控制的路径：当 NavGPT VLA 执行路线时，推理循环会缩短，系统的最短反应时间从每次语言模型决策的 3-19 秒降至每个行动策略步骤的 0.5-1 秒（1-2 Hz）。这些结果表明，设计这一具身接口对于连接前沿语言模型的智能与低层物理控制至关重要。我们将发布所有模型、代码和评测记录。

    Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes invariant-measure prediction for recurrent latent reasoning, using the long-run distribution of latent states to stabilize predictions, and evaluates it on maze and Sudoku tasks. Its focus is directly on reasoning mechanisms; stable latent representations alone do not establish a contribution to mechanistic interpretability, compositional generalization, or model systems.

    该论文提出一种用于循环潜在推理的不变测度预测方法，利用潜在状态的长期分布来稳定预测，并在迷宫和数独任务上进行评估。其研究重点直接针对推理机制；稳定的潜在表征本身并不能证明论文对机制可解释性、组合泛化或模型系统作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent reasoning models repeatedly update a latent state using the same recurrent block. As the recurrent depth increases, the sequence of latent states may converge to a compact subset of the state space without necessarily converging to a fixed point. Existing models typically predict by applying a prediction head to a single latent state. However, the latent state can continue to change even after many updates, potentially making predictions unstable across recurrent depths. To address this instability, we introduce invariant-measure reasoners (ImR), a framework that uses an invariant measure as a stable representation. This measure describes the long-run distribution of latent states on the compact subset and is invariant under updates by the recurrent block. ImR predicts from the expectation of the prediction head's output under this measure. We use ImR in two ways: fine-tuning only the prediction head of existing models and training models from scratch. Both approaches reduce prediction instability and improve accuracy in many settings on maze and Sudoku tasks. In some settings, models trained with ImR exhibit non-fixed-point behavior more frequently than existing models yet achieve high accuracy even with such behavior, unlike existing models. These results suggest that ImR can leverage otherwise destabilizing dynamics for latent reasoning.

    潜在推理模型使用同一个循环模块反复更新潜在状态。随着循环深度增加，潜在状态序列可能收敛到状态空间的一个紧子集，却不一定收敛到一个固定点。现有模型通常将预测头应用于单个潜在状态来进行预测。然而，即使经过许多次更新，潜在状态仍可能持续变化，从而导致预测随循环深度变化而不稳定。为解决这种不稳定性，我们提出不变测度推理器（ImR），这是一个将不变测度作为稳定表征的框架。该测度描述了紧子集上潜在状态的长期分布，并且在循环模块的更新下保持不变。ImR 根据预测头输出在该测度下的期望进行预测。我们以两种方式使用 ImR：仅微调现有模型的预测头，以及从头开始训练模型。这两种方法都能降低预测不稳定性，并在迷宫和数独任务的许多设置中提高准确率。在某些设置下，使用 ImR 训练的模型比现有模型更频繁地表现出非固定点行为，却仍能在这种行为下取得高准确率，而现有模型则无法做到。这些结果表明，ImR 能够利用原本会造成不稳定的动态来进行潜在推理。

    Lapras: Latent Reasoning for Time Series Language Models

    Lapras：时间序列语言模型的潜在推理

    Yuliang Chen, Yu Yvonne Wu, Patrick Langer, Arvind Pillai, Sudarshan Regmi, Martin Maritsch, Juncheng Liu, Robert Jakob, Thomas Kaar, Tess Z. Griffin, Lisa Marsch, Michael V. Heinz, Nicholas C. Jacobson, Andrew Campbell

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Lapras trains time-series language models to perform continuous latent reasoning, transferring reasoning ability from a CoT teacher through hidden-state alignment. This directly advances reasoning mechanisms and training; interpretability is only an incidental benefit of decoding latent thoughts.

    Lapras 训练时间序列语言模型执行连续的潜在推理，并通过隐藏状态对齐从 CoT 教师迁移推理能力。这直接推进了推理机制和训练；可解释性只是将潜在思维解码后的附带收益。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) offer a promising path toward time series understanding by reasoning over temporal signals and producing natural language answers and explanations. A common approach is Chain-of-Thought (CoT), which generates step-by-step rationales linking relevant signal patterns to final answers. Although these models learn from reference CoT traces during post-training, generating faithful descriptions of input time series at inference remains challenging. Expressing high-dimensional, continuous temporal representations in discrete language tokens may cause the model to neglect task-relevant patterns or describe them inaccurately. Because later reasoning steps build on these descriptions, early errors propagate, leading to incorrect answers with plausible explanations that are inconsistent with the input signal. We propose Lapras (Latent Post-trained Reasoning Across Series), a post-training framework that equips TSLMs with latent reasoning. A model trained with Lapras reasons through a sequence of continuous thoughts in the joint time series-language space, producing text only for the final answer. It learns this through teacher-student self-distillation, where a teacher trained on CoT reference traces reasons explicitly through text. The student aligns its hidden states with the teacher's at the answer stage, transferring the teacher's reasoning ability into its latent computation. We evaluate Lapras across four TSLM backbones on five time series question answering benchmarks. Lapras improves average F1 by up to 10.79% over explicit CoT while generating 23.9x fewer tokens. Lapras's continuous thoughts can also be decoded into readable reasoning traces via standard language decoding, preserving textual explanations. Together, these results highlight Lapras as a promising post-training paradigm for efficient, effective, and interpretable TSLM reasoning.

    中文

    时间序列语言模型（TSLM）通过对时间信号进行推理，并生成自然语言答案和解释，为理解时间序列提供了有前景的途径。一种常见方法是思维链（CoT），它生成逐步推理，将相关信号模式与最终答案联系起来。尽管这些模型在后训练期间会从参考 CoT 轨迹中学习，但在推理阶段生成忠实描述输入时间序列的内容仍然具有挑战性。将高维、连续的时间表示表达为离散语言词元，可能导致模型忽略与任务相关的模式或对其描述不准确。由于后续推理步骤建立在这些描述之上，早期错误会传播，导致答案错误，且解释虽然看似合理，却与输入信号不一致。我们提出 Lapras（跨序列的潜在后训练推理），这是一种为 TSLM 配备潜在推理能力的后训练框架。使用 Lapras 训练的模型会在时间序列与语言的联合空间中，通过连续思维序列进行推理，并仅为最终答案生成文本。它通过师生自蒸馏进行学习：教师模型在 CoT 参考轨迹上训练，并以文本显式推理。学生模型在答案阶段将其隐藏状态与教师的隐藏状态对齐，从而把教师的推理能力迁移到自身的潜在计算中。我们在四种 TSLM 骨干模型和五个时间序列问答基准上评估 Lapras。与显式 CoT 相比，Lapras 将平均 F1 提高至多 10.79%，同时生成的词元减少 23.9 倍。Lapras 的连续思维也可以通过标准语言解码转换为可读的推理轨迹，并保留文本解释。总体而言，这些结果表明，Lapras 是一种有前景的后训练范式，可实现高效、有效且可解释的 TSLM 推理。

    在推理强化学习的轨迹展开中平衡参考引导与自由生成

    Hanyu Wang, Nakul Agarwal, Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub, Ehsan Moradi Pari, Makoto Fukushima, Jinghui Chen, Vaishnav Tadiparthi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes reference-guided trajectory generation and introduces an adaptive prefix selector for training reasoning models, supported by a KL derivation and mathematical reasoning benchmark results. Generation-budget allocation has a limited systems connection, but the main contribution directly advances reasoning training.

    本文分析了参考引导的轨迹生成，并提出一种自适应前缀选择器来训练推理模型，以 KL 推导和数学推理基准结果作为支持。生成预算分配与系统有一定关联，但主要贡献直接推动了推理训练。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A verified reference solution provides a correct trajectory for training a reasoning model. Alternatively, a prefix of the reference can guide the model in generating a trajectory of its own. How much reference guidance should we provide? We study this question through prefix continuation, where the model continues from a reference prefix and keeps the resulting trajectory if it passes verification, falling back to the reference otherwise. Since both procedures produce correct trajectories, we compare their distributions with the ideal distribution, the model's own distribution conditioned on successful verification. For one continuation, we derive the KL divergence in closed form, which, up to a bounded term, decreases with the product of the probability of generating a different correct trajectory and the reference surprisal, the negative log probability of the reference suffix given the prefix. Since a longer prefix tends to raise the former but lowers the latter, continuation success alone does not determine the preferred amount of guidance. From this analysis, we learn a prefix selector shared across training questions from continuation outcomes, without estimating success probabilities or additional generation. The resulting Adaptive Reference Guidance (ARG) constructs correct trajectories within a fixed generation budget, and we apply it to all-failure groups in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ARG achieves the highest aggregate pass@12 among the evaluated methods with competitive average sampled accuracy.

    中文

    经验证的参考解为推理模型训练提供了一条正确轨迹。或者，也可以用参考解的一个前缀来引导模型生成自己的轨迹。我们应该提供多少参考引导？我们通过前缀续写研究这一问题：模型从参考前缀继续生成，并在结果轨迹通过验证时予以保留，否则回退到参考轨迹。由于这两种过程都会产生正确轨迹，我们将它们的分布与理想分布进行比较；理想分布是模型自身在验证成功条件下的分布。对于一次续写，我们推导出 KL 散度的闭式表达。忽略一个有界项后，该散度随以下两者乘积增大而减小：生成另一条不同正确轨迹的概率，以及参考解的惊讶度，即给定前缀时参考后缀的负对数概率。较长的前缀通常会提高前者，却降低后者，因此续写成功率本身并不能决定最佳引导量。基于这一分析，我们根据续写结果，为不同训练问题共同学习一个前缀选择器，无需估计成功概率或额外生成。由此得到的自适应参考引导（ARG）在固定生成预算内构造正确轨迹；我们将其应用于组相对策略优化（GRPO）中的全失败组。在五个数学推理基准上对 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 进行的实验表明，在所评估的方法中，ARG 的 pass@12 汇总指标最高，同时平均采样准确率也具有竞争力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VAMR 开发了共享的多问题视频推理、分层记忆和问题级策略优化，以协调持久工具使用轨迹中的证据收集。它显著推动了智能体记忆与组织方式的发展，并直接促进推理；跨问题复用上下文与组合能力的联系则只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-form video understanding often involves multiple questions about different aspects of the same recording. Yet existing video agents typically process each question through an isolated tool-use trajectory. This repeatedly restarts video exploration and memory construction, missing opportunities to acquire evidence jointly and progressively build a shared understanding that supports the complete question set. We introduce \textbf{VAMR} (\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{A}gent for \textbf{M}ulti-Question \textbf{R}easoning), which coordinates all questions about a video through one shared tool-use trajectory. At each round, a persistent policy model can invoke tools for one or more unresolved questions and submit answers for questions with sufficient evidence. Question-conditioned visual perception retrieves fine-grained clues for several questions in one call, while layered multi-question memory integrates reusable context into a shared video story and preserves separate evidence for individual questions. After supervised fine-tuning initializes this interaction protocol, we propose question-horizon policy optimization (\qhpo) to optimize shared trajectories in which questions progress and finish at different rounds. Specifically, a question-level critic estimates the value of each active question, while round alignment maps each question advantage to the rounds that directly serve it before the aligned advantages are aggregated to optimize the shared actor. Across LVBench, Video-Holmes, and LongVideoBench, VAMR achieves the highest accuracy overall and the fewest reasoning rounds among iterative methods. On LVBench, it reaches 62.1\% accuracy, exceeding VideoARM by \textbf{4.3} points while reducing reasoning rounds and processed frames by \textbf{85.9\%} and \textbf{61.4\%}.

    长视频理解通常涉及关于同一段录制内容不同方面的多个问题。然而，现有视频智能体通常通过彼此独立的工具使用轨迹处理每个问题。这会反复重新开始视频探索和记忆构建，错失联合获取证据并逐步形成共享理解的机会，而这种共享理解本可支持完整的问题集。我们提出 \textbf{VAMR}（\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{A}gent for \textbf{M}ulti-Question \textbf{R}easoning，多问题推理视频智能体），通过一条共享的工具使用轨迹协调关于同一视频的所有问题。在每一轮中，持久化策略模型可以调用工具处理一个或多个尚未解决的问题，也可以为证据充分的问题提交答案。问题条件化视觉感知通过一次调用检索多个问题的细粒度线索，而分层多问题记忆则将可复用上下文整合为共享的视频叙事，并为各个问题保留独立证据。通过监督微调初始化这一交互协议后，我们提出问题时域策略优化（\qhpo），用于优化共享轨迹，其中各个问题的推进和完成轮次各不相同。具体而言，问题级评论家估计每个活跃问题的价值，而轮次对齐则将每个问题的优势映射到直接服务于该问题的轮次上，然后聚合对齐后的优势，以优化共享策略。在 LVBench、Video-Holmes 和 LongVideoBench 上，VAMR 的总体准确率最高，在迭代方法中推理轮数最少。在 LVBench 上，其准确率达到 62.1\%，比 VideoARM 高 \textbf{4.3} 个百分点，同时推理轮数和处理帧数分别减少 \textbf{85.9\%} 和 \textbf{61.4\%}。

    Siddharth Bhandari, Lucas Gretta, Krishna Balasubramanian, Shiva Kasiviswanathan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReadKV develops query-adaptive KV-cache reads, proves budgeted allocation properties, relates distortion objectives to attention-output error, and demonstrates lower memory traffic and latency. This directly advances model computation and memory use; its attention analysis concerns output error, not internal representations or reasoning capabilities.

    ReadKV 提出了查询自适应的 KV 缓存读取方法，证明了预算分配性质，将失真目标与注意力输出误差联系起来，并展示了较低的内存流量和延迟。这直接推进了模型计算与内存使用；其注意力分析关注的是输出误差，而非内部表征或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders. Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.

    中文

    KV 缓存条目在未来查询尚未知晓时就已存储，但每个解码查询对不同位置的精度需求各不相同。我们通过分别设置保留位数预算和每次查询获取的位数预算来研究这种不匹配。ReadKV 将每个键和值存储为渐进式编码，其前缀支持不同的重建精度。对于每个查询，它利用查询来分配键通道前缀，根据重建后的键计算注意力，再利用该注意力分配值 token 前缀。已存储的条目保持不变。每个阶段都在固定预算下优化经过校准的失真目标；我们证明，当细化收益递减时可实现精确分配，并将这些目标与注意力输出误差联系起来。我们还展示了一类有限维注意力情形：在相同读取预算下，依赖查询的访问严格优于所有不依赖查询的读取方式，即使竞争对手可以不受限制地选择编码器和解码器也是如此。在六个基础模型上，对于八位缓存，平均读取四位会使 C4 困惑度最多增加 0.66%，同时逻辑读取量约为原来的四分之一，保留容量则为 16 位缓存的一半。与在相同有效载荷读取预算下存储并完整读取四位相比，该方法的准确率始终更高。保留位数高于每个查询获取的位数，是面向长上下文解码的设计；在这种场景中，每步传输的缓存字节数而非权重会成为主要成本。两个经过指令微调的模型在长上下文问答与检索任务上的结果进一步证明了其质量。在 NVIDIA A10G 上测试的 8K token、批量为 1、单层工作负载中，受限的八位 ReadKV 读取器在平均有效载荷读取预算为两位时，比测试的 TurboQuant 编码方案延迟低 39%。

    多语言语音模型中的音系干扰

    Moran Yanuka, Raja Giryes, Moris Alper

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies phonological interference, probes internal language estimates, traces them to a low-dimensional activation subspace, and causally steers that subspace to alter phoneme behavior. Windowed language estimation is a targeted inference-time repair; any connection to composition or broader system design is incidental.

    本文识别出音系干扰，探查了模型内部的语言估计，将其追溯到一个低维激活子空间，并通过因果引导该子空间改变音素行为。窗口化语言估计是一种针对性的推理时修复方法；它与组合性或更广泛系统设计的联系只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Phoneme-level models transcribe or generate speech as a sequence of phonemes, the smallest sound units that distinguish words. These models enable fine-grained pronunciation control and understanding, yet often fail on input that does not match any single training language, such as speech alternating between two languages, known as code-switching, or low-resource languages absent from training. We identify a systematic failure mode behind this, phonological interference: models assume the input is in a single language and impose its phonology, overriding local phoneme-level decisions that conflict with the assumed language. We measure interference by how often a model retains phonemes that one language has but the other lacks. On code-switched input, two phone recognizers (speech-to-phoneme models) and a phoneme-conditioned text-to-speech model lose 32% to 79% of these phonemes, but lose far fewer of the phonemes both languages share. On unseen languages, we find that phone recognizers impose the phonology of the training language they assign to the speech, and the more confident the assignment, the more they lose phonemes the unseen language has but the assigned language lacks. We probe the models' language estimate from their internal activations, and trace interference to a low dimensional subspace. On monolingual speech, steering this subspace toward another language makes the model lose the phonemes that only the original language uses and produce phonemes that only the target language has. We introduce windowed language estimation (WLE), an inference time repair that replaces the model's language estimate in this subspace with one computed from a short window around each position. On code-switched input, WLE removes 34% to 69% of the interference in all three models, and in the recognizers it leaves monolingual performance essentially unchanged.

    中文

Its adaptive execution is a core model-systems contribution; the decoding context alone does not establish a contribution to interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    DynaTE 的主要贡献是一种软硬件架构，通过动态跳过或细化令牌计算来加速扩散式 LLM 解码。其自适应执行是核心的模型系统贡献；仅凭解码背景并不能证明其对可解释性、组合泛化或推理有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs by enabling bidirectional parallel refinement, alleviating the sequential decoding bottleneck of AR generation. However, their parallel iterative refinement mismatches AR accelerators optimized for sequential decoding and their discrete token generation differs from DiT accelerators designed for continuous denoising. Recent dLLM accelerators have explored workload-specific optimizations to reduce vocabulary processing overhead and redundant computation across denoising iterations. However, these approaches retain all tokens in parallel execution, despite varying token refinement utility and execution requirements. This paper presents DynaTE, a hardware--software co-design architecture that dynamically adapts accelerator execution to evolving token states during dLLM decoding. DynaTE first enables adaptive token execution by skipping low-utility token computation, while a dimension-reconfigurable PE array maintains high utilization under varying active-token patterns. Second, DynaTE exploits dynamic token dependencies through FLDD to refine a small number of locally dependent tokens within the current iteration, reducing the overall number of denoising iterations, while a Merge--Split--Merge dataflow hides the resulting serial overhead. Third, a streaming vocabulary engine interleaves multiple token streams from the LM head to accommodate irregular output variations caused by selective token computation and uneven vocabulary-selection demands. Evaluated on two representative dLLMs, DynaTE achieves 2.05--2.78$\times$ speedup and 2.99--3.93$\times$ higher energy efficiency over state-of-the-art dLLM accelerators, while delivering 2.55$\times$ speedup and 6.07$\times$ higher energy efficiency over Jetson AGX Orin.

    中文

    基于扩散的 LLM（dLLM）近来已成为自回归（AR）LLM 的一种有前景的替代方案，它们通过支持双向并行细化，缓解了 AR 生成中的顺序解码瓶颈。然而，它们的并行迭代细化与针对顺序解码优化的 AR 加速器并不匹配，其离散令牌生成也不同于为连续去噪设计的 DiT 加速器。近期的 dLLM 加速器探索了面向特定工作负载的优化，以减少词表处理开销和去噪迭代中的冗余计算。然而，尽管令牌细化效用和执行需求各不相同，这些方法仍在并行执行中保留所有令牌。本文提出 DynaTE，这是一种软硬件协同设计架构，可在 dLLM 解码期间根据不断变化的令牌状态动态调整加速器执行。首先，DynaTE 通过跳过效用较低的令牌计算来实现自适应令牌执行，同时采用维度可重构 PE 阵列，在活动令牌模式变化时维持较高利用率。其次，DynaTE 通过 FLDD 利用动态令牌依赖关系，在当前迭代内细化少量局部依赖令牌，从而减少去噪迭代总数；与此同时，Merge--Split--Merge 数据流隐藏由此产生的串行开销。第三，流式词表引擎交错处理来自 LM 头部的多个令牌流，以适应选择性令牌计算和不均衡词表选择需求所造成的不规则输出变化。在两个具有代表性的 dLLM 上进行评估时，与最先进的 dLLM 加速器相比，DynaTE 实现了 2.05--2.78$\times$ 倍加速和 2.99--3.93$\times$ 倍能效提升；与 Jetson AGX Orin 相比，则实现了 2.55$\times$ 倍加速和 6.07$\times$ 倍能效提升。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REMORY learns bounded soft memory tokens that let a frozen LLM approximate full-history continuation, improving context compaction and agent benchmark outcomes. Memory design for long-horizon agents is central to Systems; improved continuation and fewer tool errors are outcomes, not evidence of a reasoning mechanism or interpretability contribution.

    REMORY 学习有界的软记忆令牌，使冻结的 LLM 能够近似完整历史记录下的后续生成，从而改进上下文压缩和智能体基准表现。长时程智能体的记忆设计是系统领域的核心内容；后续生成的改善和工具错误的减少是结果，并非推理机制或可解释性贡献的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.

    中文

    长时程智能体会压缩其历史记录，以便在有限的上下文窗口内继续运行，但仅有文本摘要可能无法支持后续的每一个决策。我们提出 REMORY，这是一种神经记忆网络，用有界序列的软记忆令牌补充摘要。给定历史记录和摘要，该网络学习生成令牌，帮助冻结的 LLM 近似其在拥有完整历史记录时会生成的后续内容。这些令牌以摘要为条件并附加在摘要之后，构成沿序列维度的残差连接类比。在 SummHay 上，REMORY 几乎不改变洞见覆盖率，却提升了来源归属表现；仅使用 5.2% 的输入位置，就接近完整上下文下的联合得分。在长时程智能体基准测试中，Qwen3.8-27B 和 GLM-5.3-Flash 使用残差记忆后均取得稳定提升。在 BrowseComp 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，这两个模型重复输出工具结果和工具错误的次数也大幅减少。
