    Zuyao Lin, Jianhui Zhang, Peidong Jia, Xiaoguang Zhao, Shanghang Zhang, Jingdong Wang, Xingyu Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WEM separates world and robot behavior in long-horizon embodied video generation, using role-conditioned attention and a semantic-routed mixture-of-experts generator, and contributes a benchmark. The separation and routing offer substantive system-design insight, while instruction following and task sequences connect only partially to reasoning and compositional generalization; no internal-representation analysis is described.

    WEM 将长时程具身视频生成中的世界与机器人行为分离，采用角色条件注意力和语义路由混合专家生成器，并提供了一个基准。这种分离和路由为系统设计提供了实质性启示；遵循指令和任务序列则与推理及组合泛化仅有部分关联；文中没有分析内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Embodied video world models typically capture both scene evolution and the robot's behavior, which we refer to as the \emph{world} and the \emph{ego}, respectively. The world and the ego exhibit different underlying dynamics: world prediction relies primarily on visual history and emphasizes scene stability, whereas ego prediction relies more strongly on the current instruction and emphasizes accurate instruction following. Modeling both components within a single generation stream can entangle these different dependencies, making it difficult to specialize the prediction of either component. Consequently, it becomes difficult to simultaneously maintain scene consistency and accurate instruction following, particularly in long-horizon navigation-manipulation tasks. In this paper, we propose to decompose an embodied video into the world and the ego and disentangle their generation processes. Specifically, we define the world as the background and currently unmanipulated objects, and the ego as the robot and currently manipulated objects. Based on this definition, we develop the \emph{World-Ego Model} (WEM), which combines a vision-language state predictor using role-conditioned attention (RCA) and asymmetric query budgets with a semantic-routed mixture-of-experts (SR-MoE) diffusion generator. To enable rigorous evaluation, we further construct HTEWorld, a dataset and benchmark for long-horizon embodied video generation with hybrid navigation-manipulation tasks, providing 125K training video clips comprising over 4.5M frames with fine-grained instructions, together with 300 multi-turn evaluation trajectories covering over 2K instructions. Extensive experiments show that WEM achieves state-of-the-art performance on HTEWorld while remaining competitive on existing manipulation-oriented evaluations.

    具身视频世界模型通常同时捕捉场景演变和机器人行为，我们分别称之为\emph{世界}和\emph{自我}。世界与自我呈现不同的底层动态：世界预测主要依赖视觉历史并强调场景稳定性，而自我预测则更依赖当前指令并强调准确遵循指令。在单一生成流中对这两个部分建模，可能会使这些不同的依赖关系相互纠缠，难以分别对任一部分的预测进行专门优化。因此，尤其是在长时程导航与操作任务中，同时维持场景一致性和准确遵循指令会变得困难。本文提出将具身视频分解为世界与自我，并解耦二者的生成过程。具体而言，我们将世界定义为背景和当前未被操作的物体，将自我定义为机器人和当前被操作的物体。基于这一定义，我们开发了\emph{World-Ego Model}（WEM），它将采用角色条件注意力（RCA）和非对称查询预算的视觉语言状态预测器，与语义路由混合专家（SR-MoE）扩散生成器相结合。为实现严格评估，我们进一步构建了 HTEWorld，这是一个面向长时程具身视频生成的混合导航—操作任务数据集和基准，提供 125K 个训练视频片段，共计超过 4.5M 帧，并配有细粒度指令；另包含 300 条多轮评估轨迹，覆盖超过 2K 条指令。大量实验表明，WEM 在 HTEWorld 上达到最先进的性能，同时在现有面向操作的评估中也保持竞争力。

    Joss Armstrong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MARGIN contributes a runtime method for calibrating model-specific confidence and coordinating answer selection across foundation models under workload shifts. The math and code tasks are evaluation settings rather than advances in reasoning, and the multi-agent coordination method supports a strong Systems score without addressing model internals.

    MARGIN 提出一种运行时方法，用于校准针对各模型的置信度，并在工作负载变化时协调基础模型之间的答案选择。数学和代码任务只是评估场景，并非推理方面的进展；多智能体协同方法支持较高的系统贡献评价，但未涉及模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a coordinator compares answers from heterogeneous foundation models, self-reported confidence may have different meanings across responders and changing workloads. This paper presents MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation), a runtime calibration method that learns model-specific confidence corrections from observed answer outcomes without retraining the models or requiring a held-out calibration set. MARGIN tracks recent accuracy and stated confidence within confidence bands, uses their ratio to correct reported confidence, and blends sparse-band corrections toward a model-level estimate. The corrected scores weight candidate answers in a collective decision. Evaluation covers code generation, question answering, and mathematics, using an 18-model pool and a nine-model subset for distribution-shift experiments. On BigCodeBench, model-mean confidence is negatively related to accuracy; among correct/incorrect response pairs, choosing the more confident responder performs below chance. Against five online calibration baselines receiving identical feedback and retaining their learned state across each transition, MARGIN achieves lower post-shift expected calibration error than all five in two code-generation transitions and than four in a question-answering transition; the remaining question-answering comparison is inconclusive. In separate code-generation coordination experiments, calibration improves the ranking of correct responses and increases answer-selection accuracy by 4.3 and 14.0 percentage points on two of three benchmarks relative to uncalibrated confidence weighting. These results support model-specific runtime calibration for coordination under changing workloads when correctness feedback is available for the participating responders.

    中文

    当协调器比较异构基础模型给出的答案时，不同回答模型报告的置信度可能含义不同，而且这种含义会随工作负载变化。本文介绍 MARGIN（Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation，多智能体运行时增量归一化评分），这是一种运行时校准方法，它根据观察到的答案结果学习针对各模型的置信度修正，无需重新训练模型，也不需要留出的校准集。MARGIN 在置信度区间内追踪近期准确率和报告的置信度，利用二者的比值修正报告的置信度，并将样本稀疏区间的修正值向模型级估计收缩。修正后的分数用于对候选答案加权，以作出集体决策。评估涵盖代码生成、问答和数学，使用一个由 18 个模型组成的模型池，并使用其中九个模型的子集进行分布偏移实验。在 BigCodeBench 上，模型平均置信度与准确率呈负相关；在正确与错误回答配对的情况下，选择置信度较高的回答模型，其表现低于随机水平。与五种在线校准基线相比，MARGIN 在两次代码生成分布转换后的预期校准误差低于全部五种基线，在一次问答分布转换后低于其中四种；这些基线均接收相同反馈，并在每次转换过程中保留学习到的状态；另一项问答比较的结果则无法得出明确结论。在单独的代码生成协同实验中，与未经校准的置信度加权相比，校准改进了正确回答的排序，并在三个基准中的两个上将答案选择准确率分别提高了 4.3 和 14.0 个百分点。这些结果表明，当参与协同的回答模型有正确性反馈可用时，针对模型的运行时校准有助于应对工作负载变化。

    Manh Nguyen, Sunil Gupta, Hung Le

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UAB uses answer disagreement to allocate a fixed inference-sampling budget, with a greedy method that optimizes a concave coverage surrogate and improves reasoning benchmark accuracy. This is a substantial test-time reasoning and compute-allocation contribution, while it offers no insight into internal representations or composition.

    UAB 利用答案分歧分配固定的推理采样预算，并采用贪心方法优化凹覆盖替代目标，从而提高推理基准上的准确率。这是对测试时推理和计算资源分配的重要贡献，但未提供有关内部表征或组合方式的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sampling multiple responses improves language model reasoning, but uniform compute allocation is inefficient because easy questions are over-sampled while hard questions remain under-explored. We propose \textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation (UAB)}, a concave integer optimization framework that reallocates a fixed sampling budget using uncertainty estimated from the initial samples themselves. In Phase-1, every question receives a small fixed number of generations. Their answer disagreement, measured by vote entropy, provides a difficulty signal while these generations contribute to the final vote. In Phase-2, the remaining budget is allocated by a marginal-greedy algorithm that optimally solves a concave coverage-maximization surrogate, concentrating samples on questions whose initial answers disagree. Across five open-weight models (1.5B--27B parameters) and five reasoning benchmarks of varying difficulty, UAB improves average accuracy by $+2.3\%$ over uniform allocation, and achieves gains of up to $+5.5\%$ on individual benchmarks, with the largest gains in low-resource settings. Moreover, UAB meets the target budget exactly and requires no auxiliary model or additional LLM calls. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/manhitv/UAB.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper gives a computability framework for self-improving agents and a constructive protocol for acquiring Boolean rules, including limits on query-based learning and verified teacher removal.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agents increasingly modify the procedures by which they solve tasks and improve themselves. Autonomy over improvement, gains in practical capability, and enlargement of computational reach are distinct properties. We develop an oracle-relative model with mutable solvers, evaluators, and improvers. Uniform simulation keeps every total decision procedure produced by effective self-revision over $A$ within $\mathcal{C}(A)=\{D:D\leq_T A\}$; oracle joins account for additional access, while the relativized limit lemma separates limiting answers from effective completion. A worked model of Boolean rule acquisition makes the distinction constructive. For a known finite-dimensional feature language, we characterize exactly which answers a query history determines, obtain a sharp teacher-query bound, and give a terminating protocol that permits revisions to the query proposer. The learned solver can dispense with the teacher on every input while remaining in the same computability layer. However, uniformly constructing the required feature-span specification from arbitrary effective feature programs is already as hard as the relative halting problem. We also give a conditional criterion for strict ascent and distinguish it from finite behavioral evidence. The framework thus separates acquisition, certification, and computability ascent, identifying both a positive route to verified support removal and the assumptions on which it depends.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper distills implicit chain-of-thought into lightweight models and uses counterfactual preference training to improve context-sensitive planning for spatiotemporal recommendations.     本文将隐式思维链蒸馏到轻量级模型中，并使用反事实偏好训练，提升时空推荐中对上下文敏感的规划能力。这项工作实质性推动了推理迁移和能力发展；生成受约束的意图序列及压缩推理过程也与组合能力和系统设计有一定关联，但应用场景限制了这些贡献的范围。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-world user behavior rarely consists of isolated actions; instead, it often forms intent flows governed by spatiotemporal dependencies. To provide integrated service recommendations, we focus on the task of Generative Spatiotemporal Intent Sequence Recommendation (GSISR), which aims to generate intent sequences that are logically coherent and physically executable within complex spatiotemporal contexts. While LLMs offer strong reasoning potential for GSISR, direct industrial deployment is limited by high inference latency and context-mismatched or physically infeasible plans. To address these challenges, we propose a generative framework, GPlan, that internalizes LLM reasoning into lightweight models through two components. First, to enable reasoning under strict latency constraints, we introduce Progressive Implicit CoT Distillation, which compresses explicit reasoning processes into reserved latent tokens, allowing small models to inherit complex planning logic without generating long reasoning text. Second, to address the disconnect between general knowledge and real-world constraints, we design Spatiotemporal Counterfactual DPO. By aligning the model with counterfactual context-plan pairs, we improve sensitivity to spatiotemporal context and reduce context-mismatched plans. Offline experiments and online A/B testing demonstrate that our approach improves sequence coherence and context responsiveness. Our implementation and the anonymized GSISR dataset are available at https://github.com/alibaba/GPlan.

    现实世界中的用户行为很少由彼此孤立的动作构成，而通常形成受时空依赖关系支配的意图流。为提供一体化服务推荐，我们聚焦于生成式时空意图序列推荐（GSISR）任务，其目标是在复杂的时空情境中生成逻辑连贯且物理上可执行的意图序列。尽管 LLM 在 GSISR 上展现出强大的推理潜力，但推理延迟高，以及计划与上下文不匹配或在物理上不可行，限制了其直接用于工业部署。为应对这些挑战，我们提出生成式框架 GPlan，通过两个组件将 LLM 的推理内化到轻量级模型中。首先，为在严格的延迟约束下实现推理，我们提出渐进式隐式 CoT 蒸馏，将显式推理过程压缩到预留的潜在 token 中，使小模型无需生成冗长的推理文本，也能继承复杂的规划逻辑。其次，为解决通用知识与现实约束之间的脱节，我们设计了时空反事实 DPO。通过利用反事实上下文—计划对对齐模型，我们提升模型对时空上下文的敏感性，并减少与上下文不匹配的计划。离线实验和线上 A/B 测试表明，我们的方法提升了序列连贯性和上下文响应能力。我们的实现和匿名化 GSISR 数据集见 https://github.com/alibaba/GPlan。

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning (RL) has advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in verifiable domains, while open-ended generation remains challenging due to the absence of definitive rewards. Rubric-based RL provides explicit evaluation criteria, but learning to construct these criteria remains challenging when final-answer correctness is not verifiable. We propose EvoRubric, a co-evolutionary RL framework that combines criterion-validity feedback, response discrimination, and peer agreement to learn rubrics for open-ended generation. A shared policy acts as both a Reasoner and a Rubric Generator, using its current responses and historical rubrics to discover new evaluation dimensions. To combine adaptive rubric discovery with a stable validity check, a frozen copy of the initial policy serves as the Meta-Verifier, while a frozen Grader scores responses against the retained criteria. Discriminative feedback, Leave-One-Out peer consensus, and a persistent memory pool transform this feedback into complementary rewards that jointly optimize both policy roles, closing the loop between response improvement and rubric discovery. EvoRubric improves over matched static and external evolving-rubric baselines across five benchmarks in Medical, Writing, and Science. Across three training seeds, it achieves five-benchmark averages of 56.28 at 8B and 61.13 at 14B, exceeding the strongest matched baselines by 3.09 and 2.06 points, respectively. Human audits assess criterion validity and response quality, and experiments with expert-initialized rubrics demonstrate compatibility with human priors.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PearlVLA iteratively refines latent action plans using predicted visual consequences and trains those revisions with a process-reward RL method, advancing embodied planning and deliberation. Its latent representations and iterative system design are relevant to MechInterp and Systems, but the abstract does not describe interpretability or a broader systems contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas textual reasoning, pixel-level subgoals, or world-model evaluation of decoded actions can improve planning but incur substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that progressively refines a VLM-derived latent plan using feedback from the predicted consequence of each intermediate plan. PearlVLA uses a frozen latent world model (LaWM) pretrained on action-free video. At each refinement round, the current plan produces a continuous latent action code, and the LaWM predicts the corresponding latent visual subgoal. A future-guided plan refiner uses this subgoal to update the plan, so each revision reshapes the next LaWM query. After K rounds, the refined plan is passed once to the host policy's action interface to produce an action chunk. We further introduce Causal Refinement-Grouped Process-Reward RL to optimize latent refinement by comparing rewards from the longer-horizon imagined futures of plan edits made at the same refinement state. Experiments on the LIBERO and RoboCasa benchmarks show that PearlVLA performs competitively against strong existing methods.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Structured State Space Models (SSMs), including the S4 and S4D architectures, have recently emerged as powerful alternatives to attention-based models for capturing long-range dependencies in sequential data. Despite their strong empirical performance, deploying these models in time- and resource-constrained settings remains challenging due to their computational and memory demands. In this paper, we propose a novel incremental, operator-level pruning approach for S4- and S4D-based models that significantly reduces inference cost while preserving predictive performance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically investigate structured operator pruning for SSMs. Our method progressively prunes model operators by interleaving structured masking with fine-tuning, while jointly monitoring accuracy and inference latency. We implement this approach within a unified training and evaluation framework that enables systematic exploration of efficiency-accuracy trade-offs. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that pruning up to 70% of the model operators preserves the performance of the original models in most cases, while substantially reducing inference latency. These results demonstrate that structured operator pruning is an effective and previously unexplored strategy for improving the efficiency of SSMs and facilitate their deployment in practical, resource-constrained scenarios.

    红皇后哥德尔机：协同进化的智能体及其评估器

    Alex Iacob, Andrej Jovanovi\'c, William F. Shen, Daniel Burkhardt, Meghdad Kurmanji, Nurbek Tastan, Lorenzo Sani, Niccol\`o Alberto Elia Venanzi, Jiayi Nie, Ambroise Odonnat, Zeyu Cao, Bill Marino, Xinchi Qiu, Rika Antonova, and Nicholas D. Lane

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces co-evolving agents and learned evaluators for recursive self-improvement, with evidence across coding, reviewing, and proof tasks. Its main contribution is an agent-system design; proof writing and evaluation connect to reasoning, but the abstract does not describe a reasoning mechanism or advance compositional generalization or interpretability.

    本文提出用于递归自我改进的智能体与学习型评估器协同进化方法，并在编程、评审和证明任务上提供了证据。其主要贡献是智能体系统设计；证明撰写与评估和推理相关，但摘要并未描述推理机制，也未推进组合泛化或可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-improving agents are state-of-the-art on agentic coding benchmarks, yet their search methods assume a stationary evaluation criterion. This ignores a central feature of evolution: species adapt as their environments change with them. We introduce the Red Queen G\"odel Machine (RQGM), an evolutionary framework for recursive self-improvement under non-stationary utilities. This allows learned evaluators to improve alongside the agents they guide. On DeepSWE, the RQGM improves over its fixed-evaluator baseline by adding a complementary agent-as-a-judge code-review signal: a co-evolved reviewer grades coder patches to guide search. At low reasoning effort, the RQGM coder passes 82.1% of held-out tasks against the baseline's 75.0%, and nearly matches the GPT-6 Astra model at high effort. In scientific paper writing and reviewing, and Olympiad-level proof writing and grading, co-evolved evaluators provide an evaluation criterion. Anchored to human IMO grades, a co-evolved grader writes its own milestone rubric and exceeds static baselines at a 3x lower search cost, driving the prover to the best mean score. Since the RQGM can modify the search objective across epochs, it can regularize the search. For example, the RQGM reduces self-preference bias via an additional adversarial objective to discover reviewers equally stringent on AI and human work. Guided by these calibrated reviewers, co-evolved writers reach 1.78x-1.86x higher acceptance rates than the baseline under an agent-as-a-judge panel. The RQGM enables self-improving systems where agents and evaluators recursively bootstrap each other beyond static evaluation.

    自我改进智能体在智能体编程基准测试上达到了最先进水平，但其搜索方法假设评估标准是静态的。这忽略了进化的一个核心特征：物种会随着环境变化而适应。我们提出红皇后哥德尔机（RQGM），这是一种面向非平稳效用的递归自我改进进化框架。它使学习得到的评估器能够与其所引导的智能体共同改进。在 DeepSWE 上，RQGM 通过加入互补的“智能体充当评审者”代码审查信号，优于使用固定评估器的基线：协同进化的评审者为编码器的补丁评分，以引导搜索。在低推理投入下，RQGM 编码器通过了 82.1% 的留出任务，而基线为 75.0%；在高投入下，其表现接近 GPT-6 Astra 模型。在科学论文写作与评审以及奥林匹克级证明写作与评分任务中，协同进化评估器提供了评估标准。以人类 IMO 评分为锚点，协同进化评分器会撰写自己的阶段性量规；其搜索成本仅为静态基线的三分之一，表现仍超过静态基线，并推动证明器取得最高的平均分。由于 RQGM 能够跨轮次修改搜索目标，因此可以对搜索进行正则化。例如，RQGM 通过增加一个对抗目标来减少自我偏好偏差，以发现对 AI 作品和人类作品同样严格的评审者。在这些经过校准的评审者指导下，协同进化的写作者在“智能体充当评审者”评审组下的接收率达到基线的 1.78 至 1.86 倍。RQGM 实现了自我改进系统，使智能体和评估器能够递归地相互提升，超越静态评估。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The corrected study measures how system prompts affect hidden-state geometry across open-weight language models, finding reliable separation between prompt conditions while revising earlier claims about curvature and direction-to-magnitude shifts.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Versions 1 and 2 of this preprint reported that an identity-specifying system prompt leaves a geometric fingerprint in the final-layer hidden-state trajectories of four open-weight language models, and that instruction tuning moves this fingerprint from the direction to the magnitude of the hidden-state vector. An audit of their code and data found the following. The curvature statistic described as Ollivier-Ricci curvature on Euclidean k-NN graphs was a non-standard Forman-type edge statistic on graphs built from temporal and cosine k-NN edges. Its released test permuted pooled edges instead of trajectories, and the published p-values came from unreleased code. The quantity reported as the norm of the first generated state is the state at the last prompt position, from which the first output token is predicted. The generic control prompt was matched to the identity prompt in characters, not in tokens. This version corrects the methods, withdraws the regime-specific claims (one model per regime) and the direction-to-magnitude claim, and re-analyzes the data with added controls. What survives is narrower. Centroid distance, maximum mean discrepancy and a linear probe separate every pair of prompt conditions in every model, while the curvature statistic exceeds its split-half noise floor in only four of twelve comparisons. In Gemma-4-E4B-it this state has a lower norm under the identity prompt than under a token-length-matched generic prompt (138.1 vs. 216.5; Cohen's d = -5.45; n = 20). Its direction also separates the conditions, and the effect fits the state's role in planning the output: the identity prompt instructs a pause before every answer, and the model opens 98 of 100 responses with a pause marker. When the first token is fixed, the norm ordering reverses. The base model continues the prompt template instead of answering. A redesigned follow-up study is in preparation.

    中文

    该预印本的第 1 版和第 2 版报告称，指定身份的系统提示会在四种开放权重语言模型的最后一层隐藏状态轨迹中留下几何指纹，并且指令微调会使这一指纹从隐藏状态向量的方向转移到其模长上。对其代码和数据的审计发现了以下问题。被描述为欧几里得 k-NN 图上 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率的曲率统计量，实际上是基于时间邻边和余弦 k-NN 边构建的图上非标准的 Forman 类型边统计量。发布的检验对合并后的边进行了置换，而不是对轨迹进行置换；已发表的 p 值则来自未发布的代码。被报告为第一个生成状态模长的量，实际上是最后一个提示位置的状态，模型根据该状态预测第一个输出 token。通用对照提示与身份提示在字符数上匹配，而非 token 数。此版本修正了方法，撤回了按模型区分实验条件的主张（每种实验条件仅有一个模型）以及方向到模长的主张，并在加入控制变量后重新分析数据。剩下的结论范围更窄。在每个模型中，质心距离、最大均值差异和线性探针都能区分每一对提示条件；而曲率统计量仅在十二组比较中的四组超过了分半噪声底限。在 Gemma-4-E4B-it 中，与 token 长度匹配的通用提示相比，身份提示下该状态的模长较低（138.1 对 216.5；Cohen's d = -5.45；n = 20）。其方向也能区分这些条件；这一效应符合该状态在输出规划中的作用：身份提示要求模型在每个回答前暂停，模型在 100 个回答中有 98 个以暂停标记开头。固定第一个 token 后，模长的排序反转。基础模型会继续补全提示模板，而非作答。目前正在筹备一项重新设计的后续研究。

    Beyond Euclidean Clipping: Overcoming Exploration Collapse in LLM RL via Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization

    超越欧几里得裁剪：通过黎曼等距策略优化克服 LLM 强化学习中的探索坍塌

    Zhicheng Cai, Xinyuan Guo, Hanlin Wu, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Hao Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a geometric cause of exploration collapse in PPO-Clip and proposes RIPO, an optimization method with isometric policy updates that improves LLM reasoning training. This offers substantial insight into reasoning capability development, while policy geometry is not evidence about internal representations and the systems connection is incidental.

    本文找出了 PPO-Clip 中探索坍塌的几何成因，并提出 RIPO，一种通过等距策略更新改善 LLM 推理训练的优化方法。这为推理能力的发展提供了重要见解；策略几何并非内部表征的证据，其与系统的关联也只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. However, RL algorithms with PPO-Clip are inherently limited by exploration collapse. Subsequent works remain primarily heuristic and fail to identify the essential cause of PPO-Clip's failure. This work reveals the fundamental flaw of PPO-Clip: it implicitly measures policy discrepancy using Euclidean metric, which is theoretically inconsistent with the intrinsic geometry on the policy Riemannian manifold. This geometric mismatch results in overly conservative updates in low-probability regions while aggressive in high-probability regions, ultimately collapsing exploration. To correct this geometric flaw, we propose Riemannian Isometric Policy Optimization (RIPO), which guarantees isometric policy updates on the Riemannian manifold, effectively balancing exploration and exploitation. We further show that RIPO achieves a favorable bias-variance trade-off, which stabilizes optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RIPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across seven competition-level benchmarks (up to 60% improvement over GRPO on AIME24).

    中文

    强化学习（RL）已成为增强 LLM 推理能力的主流范式。然而，采用 PPO-Clip 的 RL 算法本质上受到探索坍塌的限制。后续工作主要仍依赖启发式方法，未能找出 PPO-Clip 失效的根本原因。本文揭示了 PPO-Clip 的基本缺陷：它隐式地使用欧几里得度量衡量策略差异，这在理论上与策略黎曼流形的内在几何不一致。这种几何失配会导致低概率区域中的更新过于保守，而高概率区域中的更新过于激进，最终造成探索坍塌。为纠正这一几何缺陷，我们提出黎曼等距策略优化（RIPO），它能够保证策略在黎曼流形上进行等距更新，从而有效平衡探索与利用。我们进一步表明，RIPO 实现了有利的偏差-方差权衡，使优化过程更加稳定。大量实验表明，在七个竞赛级基准测试上，RIPO 显著优于现有 LLM RL 算法（在 AIME24 上相较 GRPO 的提升最高达 60%）。

    ENGLISH

    Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance on diverse embodied tasks. However, deploying VLA models on low-power onboard devices, such as the Jetson Orin, remains challenging due to their high computational complexity, which leads to substantial inference latency and low control frequency. Asynchronous inference can partially mask this latency by parallelizing action execution and subsequent inference, but it introduces two critical issues: perception-execution misalignment and long reaction time. In this paper, we propose EagleVLA, a method for efficient VLA deployment on onboard devices via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Correction. To address misalignment, we train a lightweight future correction module that predicts future environment representations, allowing the action expert to predict actions from the future time step. To reduce reaction time, we introduce confidence-based scheduling optimization that adaptively balances VLM and action expert invocations. We also build a llama.cpp-based inference engine tailored for onboard VLA deployment, with system-level optimizations including CUDA graph reuse, GPU-resident intermediate buffering, and flow unrolling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EagleVLA achieves 9.85x and 6.19x improvements in control frequency compared with naive PyTorch and vla.cpp on Jetson Orin, while outperforming VLASH by 14.8% in success rate on LIBERO benchmark. The code of our asynchronous algorithm is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA, and our efficient llama.cpp-based inference engine is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA-Edge.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a context-aware EXECUTE/ASK/REFUSE routing guard for tool-using agents, with a threshold that adjusts risk tolerance without retraining.     ENGLISH

    LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode autonomy and train users to wave through the most consequential alerts. We reframe the problem as a per-instance three-way routing decision over {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE} and instantiate it with Safety Sentry, a lightweight guard model whose inference reduces to a single decoding call. A single decoding-time threshold lets one fixed checkpoint be re-positioned across deployments of differing risk tolerance without retraining. Safety Sentry outperforms a broad set of open-weight and frontier closed-source baselines on overall accuracy and safety-related recall, while controlling both directional error rates simultaneously.Code and data are available at https://github.com/safesentry/SAFETY-SENTRY

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a steerable masked-diffusion world model and training framework for agentic RL, with grounded trajectory data and transfer results. Its focus on agent environments supports Systems; reasoning and composition are incidental to the rollout tasks, and it offers no mechanistic analysis of internal representations.

    本文的主要贡献是面向智能体 RL 的可控掩码扩散世界模型和训练框架，并提供有依据的轨迹数据及迁移结果。其对智能体环境的关注支持 Systems；推理和组合只是 rollout 任务中的附带内容，也没有对内部表征进行机制分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. World models that simulate environment states have matched pure rollout performance, making them promising for scaling diversity on-demand. However, autoregressive (AR) world models suffer from a left-to-right bias preventing conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors such as tool schemas, prior turns, and expected outcomes. We (i) formalize text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives, and (ii) curate 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning nine open-source environments and twelve frontier model families. We compare AR LMs and masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), showing MDLMs, via bidirectional anchor-aware denoising, achieve better coherence, groundedness, and empirically validated rollout diversity than LLMs over 4x their parameter size, at comparable inference latency. We introduce a plug-and-play GRPO training framework with deterministic state checks, and perform zero-shot transfer ablations on three OOD environments (ScienceWorld, ALFWorld, AppWorld) across three 1.2B-7B agent backbones (LFM2.5, Qwen3, Mistral), achieving up to 47% absolute gains over baselines without environment-specific fine-tuning. We further conduct behavioral analysis of failure modes under adversarial scenarios and human evaluation on realism, outcome correctness, and training utility. We open-source our work to encourage research in this direction.

    强化学习（RL）近期的发展凸显了对多样化、专业化训练环境的需求。随着模型性能提升，任务和奖励难度固定的人工策划环境会变得难以提供有效信号；而长时程中的稀疏奖励会导致模型在特定工作流或工具结构上发生模式坍塌。能够模拟环境状态的世界模型，其表现已达到纯 rollout 方法的水平，因此有望按需扩展环境多样性。然而，自回归（AR）世界模型存在从左到右的偏置，无法以工具模式、先前轮次和预期结果等全局相互依赖的状态锚点作为条件。我们（i）将文本世界建模形式化为一个可控的转移动力学问题，将其分解为初始状态、任务上下文、工具模式、领域规则和控制指令；（ii）整理了 239,403 条有依据的状态—动作轨迹，涵盖九个开源环境和十二个前沿模型系列。我们比较 AR LM 与掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM），结果表明，MDLM 通过双向、锚点感知的去噪，在相近推理延迟下，比参数规模超过其 4 倍的 LLM 实现了更好的连贯性、依据性和经实证验证的 rollout 多样性。我们提出了一种即插即用的 GRPO 训练框架，并加入确定性状态检查；还在三个分布外（OOD）环境（ScienceWorld、ALFWorld、AppWorld）中，对三个 1.2B-7B 智能体骨干模型（LFM2.5、Qwen3、Mistral）进行了零样本迁移消融实验，无需针对特定环境微调，便取得了最高 47% 的绝对增益。我们还分析了对抗场景下的行为失效模式，并通过人工评估考察真实性、结果正确性和训练效用。我们将工作开源，以推动这一方向的研究。

    ENGLISH

    We propose ARBITER, a novel LLM guardrail framework that introduces two key ideas: (i) dual-hypothesis reasoning, a reasoning method for LLM guardrails that explicitly considers both safe and unsafe interpretations of a prompt before making a safety decision, and (ii) multi-component supervised fine-tuning (MC-SFT), a structured training loss for reasoning-based guardrails that decomposes LLM outputs into logical components and weights them according to their importance. Existing reasoning-based guardrails often rely on expensive procedures, such as generating reasoning traces using larger or closed-source teacher models and applying full-parameter fine-tuning. In contrast, ARBITER uses a cost-effective self-generation strategy for reasoning traces and LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning while still achieving better performance than these expensive approaches. Additionally, ARBITER provides faithful evidence-phrase explanations for unsafe decisions, enabling a more transparent and interpretable guardrail method. Experiments on three safety moderation benchmarks show that ARBITER outperforms existing reasoning-based and non-reasoning guardrail baselines, with clear gains in out-of-domain evaluations.

    Geometric architectures are often motivated by internal mechanisms, but accuracy alone does not show whether predictions use them. In Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs), edge transports form a connection whose cycle products define holonomy. We use basis-independent loop readouts with identity interventions and shortcut controls. On high-homophily GraphUniverse graphs, triangle counting increases the mean SO(2) triangle rotation in Neural Sheaf Propagation (NSP) from 0.010 to 0.388 radians, while community detection ends at 0.029 radians. With more data, learned SO(2)--NSP outperforms Identity NSP, and replacing its transports after training increases error further. However, ridge regression is more accurate, diagonal maps improve without continuous rotation, and fixed-degree models develop rotation without improved counting. Thus, NSP can learn and rely on a nontrivial connection, but our experiments do not show that triangle holonomy drives its predictions.

    几何架构常以内部机制为设计动机，但仅凭准确率无法说明预测是否利用了这些机制。在鞘神经网络（SNN）中，边传输构成一个联络，其环路乘积定义了整体量。我们探究训练是否会改变三角形整体量、预测是否依赖学习到的联络，以及整体量是否驱动三角形计数。我们采用与基底无关的环路读出，并进行恒等干预和捷径控制。在高同配性的 GraphUniverse 图上，三角形计数使 Neural Sheaf Propagation（NSP）中的平均 SO(2) 三角形旋转从 0.010 弧度升至 0.388 弧度，而社区检测结束时为 0.029 弧度。随着数据增多，学习得到的 SO(2)--NSP 优于 Identity NSP；训练后替换其传输映射会进一步增大误差。然而，岭回归的准确度更高，虽不发生连续旋转，对角映射仍能提升；固定度数模型也会产生旋转，却没有改善计数效果。因此，NSP 能够学习并依赖一个非平凡联络，但我们的实验并未表明三角形整体量驱动了它的预测。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This is a substantial training-method contribution to improving reasoning capabilities; the agent and asynchronous optimization settings provide a secondary systems connection, but the abstract does not describe a new agent architecture or computation design.

    Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) accelerates large language model (LLM) post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but the resulting stale, off-policy data destabilizes optimization and can cause policy collapse. Existing methods gate tokens by ratio magnitude alone, applying one threshold at every position. We show that the ratio's natural scale is set by token entropy, so deviations from mid-trajectory weight updates stay within this scale and carry genuine exploration. We further identify an overlooked low-entropy regime that breaks this scaling, where a near-zero probability amplifies train--inference mismatch into noise far beyond what the local entropy admits. A magnitude threshold admits this noise and discards the exploration. We therefore propose the Entropy-Normalized Trust Region (ENTR). Across long-horizon agentic tasks and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ENTR outperforms existing asynchronous methods. It improves avg@1 on BrowseComp-Plus by $6.9\%$ over the strongest baseline, trains stably up to $30$ policy versions of staleness, and matches synchronous GRPO at a $2.6\times$ speedup.

    中文

    异步强化学习（RL）通过让 rollout 生成与策略优化重叠，加速大语言模型（LLM）的后训练，但由此产生的陈旧离策略数据会使优化不稳定，并可能导致策略坍塌。现有方法仅根据比率大小筛选 token，在每个位置应用同一个阈值。我们表明，比率的自然尺度由 token 熵决定，因此，中途轨迹权重更新所造成的偏差仍处于该尺度范围内，并携带真正的探索信息。我们还发现一个被忽视的低熵区域会破坏这一尺度关系：此时，接近零的概率会将训练与推理之间的不匹配放大为远超局部熵所容许范围的噪声。幅度阈值会接纳这些噪声，同时丢弃探索信息。因此，我们提出熵归一化信赖域（ENTR）。在长时程智能体任务和数学推理基准上，ENTR 优于现有异步方法。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，其 avg@1 比最强基线提高了 $6.9\%$，在最高 $30$ 个策略版本的陈旧程度下仍能稳定训练，并以 $2.6\times$ 的加速比达到与同步 GRPO 相当的表现。

    Agentic AI systems act through multi-step trajectories that combine planning, tool use, memory, interaction, and adaptation. This behavior stretches validation practice beyond component testing and one-shot input-output evaluation, because acceptable system behavior now depends on how decisions unfold over time and under changing environmental conditions. This systematic mapping study synthesizes 262 papers spanning agent evaluation, software assurance, cyber-physical systems, runtime monitoring, and regulatory guidance in order to characterize the validation problem for agentic systems. The review is organized around a five-dimension taxonomy covering behavioral, safety, temporal, regulatory, and multi-agent concerns, and uses that taxonomy to map current approaches and identify dense and sparse pairings of approaches and dimensions. The resulting map shows that the literature concentrates on behavioral evaluation (105 of 262 papers) and is thinnest on temporal validity (14 papers); regulatory work rests mainly on assurance cases and regulatory analysis, largely from IEEE-indexed venues, and multi-agent work mainly on benchmarks. Three cross-domain case studies (medical care, industrial operations, smart-mobility systems) provide operational illustrations of how the five taxonomy dimensions recur in safety-critical settings, motivated by the failure patterns documented in the reviewed literature. The paper concludes with a lifecycle-oriented research agenda centered on bounded-autonomy specifications, adversarial trajectory generation, runtime monitoring, and audit-ready evidence structures. The central claim is that trustworthy deployment of agentic AI depends on validating trajectories in context rather than assessing isolated components alone.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SERL-SQL’s main contribution is execution-grounded reinforcement learning that uses hindsight feedback to localize credit assignment across an agent’s SQL and tool actions, advancing training for multi-step problem solving.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent Text-to-SQL systems increasingly rely on multi-turn interaction, execution feedback, and reinforcement learning. However, most existing methods use execution correctness only as a trajectory-level reward, which provides limited guidance for identifying the SQL decisions responsible for success or failure. We propose SERL-SQL, a selective execution-grounded reinforcement learning framework for multi-turn Text-to-SQL agents. SERL-SQL samples on-policy SQL interaction trajectories and uses a training-only teacher to re-score student actions with execution feedback. The resulting teacher--student likelihood gap is converted into bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens. In this way, task rewards preserve the optimization direction, while execution hindsight provides localized credit assignment. Experiments on BIRD, Spider, and cross-domain benchmarks show that SERL-SQL achieves competitive performance, reaching 76.56% execution accuracy on BIRD-Dev and 89.92% on Spider-Test. Moreover, our reward-based selection strategy closely approaches the oracle Best-of-N upper bound and consistently outperforms consistency-based selection, showing that SERL-SQL produces high-quality candidates that can be reliably identified by lightweight execution-grounded rewards. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Ffunkytao/SERL-SQL.

    近期的文本到 SQL 系统日益依赖多轮交互、执行反馈和强化学习。然而，现有大多数方法仅将执行正确性用作轨迹级奖励，对于识别导致成功或失败的 SQL 决策，提供的指导有限。我们提出 SERL-SQL，这是一种面向多轮文本到 SQL 智能体的选择性、以执行为依据的强化学习框架。SERL-SQL 对策略数据中的 SQL 交互轨迹进行采样，并使用仅用于训练的教师模型结合执行反馈重新评分学生模型的动作。随后，教师与学生之间的似然差距被转换为有界、带掩码的权重，仅对 SQL 和工具动作 token 上的 GRPO 优势进行重加权。如此一来，任务奖励保留优化方向，而执行事后反馈则提供局部信用分配。在 BIRD、Spider 和跨领域基准上的实验表明，SERL-SQL 达到了有竞争力的表现，在 BIRD-Dev 上执行准确率达到 76.56%，在 Spider-Test 上达到 89.92%。此外，我们基于奖励的选择策略接近 oracle Best-of-N 上限，并持续优于基于一致性的选择策略，这表明 SERL-SQL 能生成高质量候选项，并可通过轻量级、以执行为依据的奖励可靠地识别这些候选项。我们的代码将于 https://github.com/Ffunkytao/SERL-SQL 发布。

    Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents

    Puyu Zeng, Mingang Chen, Zheli Liu, Qibing Ren

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies resource hijacking in LLM agents, introduces a benchmark, and proposes a pre-execution authorization defense. Its substantial contribution concerns agent tool and resource use, while attack success and defense results do not establish a reasoning-mechanism contribution.

    本文研究 LLM 智能体中的资源劫持，推出一项基准，并提出执行前授权防御。其主要贡献涉及智能体的工具和资源使用，而攻击成功率及防御结果并不能证明其对推理机制有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources, including external APIs, GPUs and servers, and workflows such as deployment and approval. Existing agent security research mainly focuses on attacks against information and agent behavior, while high-value resources have received less attention as attack targets themselves. To our knowledge, we are the first to identify and systematically study agent resource hijacking, in which attackers induce agents to use high-value resources for their own goals without directly obtaining those resources or their credentials. We introduce ResourceHijackBench, an executable benchmark and automated case-generation pipeline that covers six categories of high-value resources. It contains 300 attack scenarios and 900 attack prompts, and each case runs in an isolated local environment that records actual resource use. Resource hijacking remains effective across four model backends, with average attack success rates of 70.0% to 89.6%, and it also appears across two agent harnesses, with average ASRs of 84.1% on OpenClaw and 72.3% on Codex. In paired comparisons, resource hijacking achieves ASRs 62.4 to 84.0 percentage points higher than direct resource acquisition across the four model backends. Real-world experiments also demonstrate the practical effectiveness of resource hijacking. Among the three existing defenses we evaluate, the lowest average ASR is still 55.1%. We further propose ResGate, a pre-execution resource authorization defense that combines model-based resource-use extraction with deterministic policy enforcement based on trusted requester identity metadata, reducing the average ASR on OpenClaw to 23.6%. These results show that preventing direct access alone is not enough to protect resources that agents can still use on an attacker's behalf, and that explicit resource authorization can help reduce this risk.

    中文

    大语言模型智能体日益连接到高价值资源，包括外部 API、GPU 和服务器，以及部署和审批等工作流。现有智能体安全研究主要关注针对信息和智能体行为的攻击，而较少将高价值资源本身作为攻击目标。据我们所知，我们首次识别并系统研究了智能体资源劫持：攻击者诱使智能体为其自身目标使用高价值资源，却不直接获取这些资源或其凭据。我们推出 ResourceHijackBench，这是一个可执行基准和自动化案例生成流程，涵盖六类高价值资源。它包含 300 个攻击场景和 900 条攻击提示，每个案例都在隔离的本地环境中运行，并记录实际资源使用情况。在四种模型后端上，资源劫持仍然有效，平均攻击成功率为 70.0% 至 89.6%；在两种智能体框架中也观察到了这种攻击，OpenClaw 上的平均 ASR 为 84.1%，Codex 上为 72.3%。在配对比较中，四种模型后端上的资源劫持 ASR 比直接获取资源高出 62.4 至 84.0 个百分点。真实世界实验也表明，资源劫持具有实际效果。在我们评估的三种现有防御中，最低平均 ASR 仍为 55.1%。我们还提出 ResGate，一种执行前资源授权防御，它结合了基于模型的资源使用提取和基于可信请求方身份元数据的确定性策略执行，将 OpenClaw 上的平均 ASR 降至 23.6%。这些结果表明，仅阻止直接访问不足以保护仍可能被智能体代表攻击者使用的资源，而明确的资源授权有助于降低此类风险。

    Jin Lou, Zhiyuan Jing, Xupeng Wang, Andong Chen, Xingdong Zhu, Yuexuan Li, Yuan Xu, Zhijie Zhu, Yingwei Ji, Wenpeng Nie, Renxing Feng, Liangliang Chen, Ying Chu, Jingyi Li, Jinyan Liu, Zhiqi Song, Jingxuan Zhu, Jidong Zhang, Yufei Liu, Boyang Xing, Lei Jiang, Yan Cui, Hongming Li, Yuchen Zhu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LM-X jointly pretrains progress, event, and action-uncertainty signals that condition robot control, offering a substantial algorithmic contribution to VLA model design. The signals support monitoring and long-horizon control, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization; explainability alone is limited evidence for mechanistic interpretability.

    LM-X 将进度、事件和动作不确定性信号与控制共同预训练，并用这些信号为机器人控制提供条件，对 VLA 模型设计作出了实质性算法贡献。这些信号支持监控和长时程控制，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制或组合泛化；仅凭可解释性也不足以证明具备机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large-scale vision--language--action (VLA) policies have advanced generalist robot control, yet most remain stimulus-to-action black boxes: actions are exposed, but their explanatory state is not. They provide no native account of three explanatory signals: task progress, the next semantic transition, or local command reliability. Prior work shows that progress and event structure aid long-horizon control and that uncertainty supports monitoring; however, such capabilities are typically added or extracted only after action pretraining. The field therefore lacks a VLA foundation model whose explanatory state is jointly pretrained with control. Drawing on biological sensorimotor organization, in which outcome-sensitive, event-segmented, and probabilistic predictions structure behavior, we introduce LM-X. LM-X learns three directly supervised online signals: return-to-go (RTG) estimates visible progress and state quality; event-to-go (ETG) predicts the action sequence to the next semantic event; and heteroscedastic action-flow variance reports local command reliability. RTG conditions ETG and both condition action generation; uncertainty is estimated inside the action expert, making explanation part of control rather than a post-hoc description. We pretrain LM-X on more than 20,000 hours of heterogeneous real-robot trajectories, including over 1,000 hours of failed rollouts. LM-X achieves 74.1\% success on 50 randomized-hard RoboTwin2.0 tasks and 73.5\% on seven real-robot tasks, compared with 55.4\% and 50.7\% for GR00T N1.7. Its signals track progress and regression, anticipate event-scale motion, detect high-error actions, and provide advance failure warning. These results establish LM-X as an explainable VLA foundation model that couples transparent predictive state with stronger generalist control. Github: https://github.com/loongOpen/LoongWu-LM-X-VLA

    大规模视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略推动了通用机器人控制的发展，但大多数仍是从刺激到动作的黑箱：动作可以观察到，其解释状态却不可见。它们无法原生提供三种解释性信号：任务进度、下一个语义转变，或局部指令可靠性。先前研究表明，进度和事件结构有助于长时程控制，不确定性则有助于监控；然而，这些能力通常只在动作预训练后才被添加或提取。因此，该领域缺少一种与控制共同预训练其解释状态的 VLA 基础模型。受生物传感运动组织的启发——其中对结果敏感、按事件分段且具概率性的预测构成行为结构——我们提出 LM-X。LM-X 学习三种直接监督的在线信号：到达回报（RTG）估计可见进度和状态质量；到达事件（ETG）预测通往下一个语义事件的动作序列；异方差动作流方差则报告局部指令可靠性。RTG 为 ETG 提供条件，二者都为动作生成提供条件；不确定性在动作专家内部估计，使解释成为控制的一部分，而非事后描述。我们使用超过 20,000 小时的异质真实机器人轨迹对 LM-X 进行预训练，其中包括超过 1,000 小时的失败 rollout。LM-X 在 50 项随机化高难度 RoboTwin2.0 任务上的成功率为 74.1\%，在七项真实机器人任务上的成功率为 73.5\%；GR00T N1.7 对应的成功率为 55.4\% 和 50.7\%。其信号能够追踪进度和退化趋势，预判事件尺度的运动，检测高误差动作，并提前预警失败。这些结果表明，LM-X 是一种可解释的 VLA 基础模型，它将透明的预测状态与更强的通用控制能力相结合。Github：https://github.com/loongOpen/LoongWu-LM-X-VLA

    CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation

    面向 LLM 的 CPR：通过关键点路由应对领域适配中的灾难性遗忘

    Kwangmin Ki, Yunhun Nam, Jongheon Jeong, Jaehyung Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces token-level routing between a base model and a domain expert to reduce forgetting while preserving general capability. This is a substantial contribution to conditional computation and model organization, but the abstract does not describe interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning advances.

    本文提出在基础模型与领域专家模型之间进行 token 级路由，以减少遗忘并保留通用能力。这是对条件计算和模型组织方式的重要贡献，但摘要没有描述可解释性、组合泛化或推理能力方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.

    中文

    监督微调（SFT）是将大型语言模型（LLM）适配到目标领域的事实标准，但它往往会削弱模型的通用能力，这种现象称为灾难性遗忘。现有方法通常通过修改 SFT 损失来缓解遗忘，但不可避免地要在领域能力与通用能力之间权衡。在这项工作中，我们通过在模型层面解耦这两种能力，跳出这种权衡：保留原始基础模型以提供通用能力，并仅在需要领域特定知识时有选择地调用 SFT 专家模型。具体而言，我们提出 CPR（关键点路由），一种在基础模型与其专家派生模型之间进行 token 级路由的框架，依据的是基础模型失败而专家模型成功的关键 token。我们训练了一个轻量级分层路由器，用于估计每个 token 调用专家模型的概率，并配套设计了一种结合动量平滑与阈值门控的推理流程。在多种模型与领域配置下，CPR 在所有设置中都达到最先进水平：领域表现超过 SFT 专家模型 1.4–5.5%，同时将通用能力下降幅度从 3.4–14.5% 恢复到至多 0.5%；仅在三分之一的 token 上调用专家模型，额外开销极小。

    A Score Is Not a Policy: Measuring the Value of Adaptive Revision

    分数并非策略：衡量自适应修订的价值

    Ayushi Chadha

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper experimentally studies when a hierarchical reasoner should revise a commitment, finding that state-dependent learned timing does not beat a strong fixed schedule and separating state dependence from decision value. This advances reasoning control and agent-system design, while the abstract provides no evidence about internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文通过实验研究分层推理器何时应修订承诺，发现依赖状态的学习时机并不胜过强大的固定时序安排，并将状态依赖性与决策价值区分开来。这推进了推理控制和智能体系统设计；摘要没有提供关于内部表征或组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As agentic systems become compound systems, increasingly important decisions move above task execution itself: when should a higher-level controller preserve the strategy guiding another process, and when should it revise it? We study this meta-level control problem in a hierarchical latent reasoner whose manager can retain or replace a commitment governing lower-level computation. Across three precommitted training seeds, learned revision timing produces qualitatively different policies, ranging from an almost deterministic early clock to substantially more state conditioned schedule distributions, yet none outperforms the best forced timing policy evaluated on the same frozen checkpoint. This separates state dependence from decision value: a controller can vary its actions with internal state without turning that variation into a reproducible task-performance benefit. A deeper intervention study on the original checkpoint shows that timing itself is consequential and order-sensitive, while exhaustive enumeration reveals that a strong fixed schedule captures most of the measurable value available from timing at this decision budget. Counterfactual PERSIST/REPLAN diagnostics further show why score-level evidence can be misleading when predictability is dominated by decision position rather than within-position discrimination. Together, these results argue that learned meta-level control should be evaluated along three separate axes: whether its score depends on state, whether that dependence changes realized behavior, and whether those changes capture outcome value beyond a strong non-adaptive policy.

    中文

    随着智能体系统变得日益复合，越来越重要的决策开始超越任务执行本身：更高层的控制器应在何时保留指导另一进程的策略，又应在何时修订它？我们在一个分层潜在推理器中研究这一元层级控制问题，其中管理器可以保留或替换支配低层计算的承诺。在三个预先确定的训练随机种子下，学习到的修订时机会产生性质迥异的策略，从近乎确定性的早期时钟，到对状态有显著条件依赖的时序分布；然而，在同一冻结检查点上评估时，它们都未能胜过最佳的强制时机策略。这一区分了状态依赖性与决策价值：控制器可以根据内部状态改变动作，但这种变化未必能转化为可复现的任务表现收益。针对原始检查点开展的深入干预研究表明，时机本身会产生影响，而且对顺序敏感；穷举枚举则显示，在这一决策预算下，强大的固定时序安排捕获了时机所能带来的大部分可测量价值。反事实 PERSIST/REPLAN 诊断进一步说明，当可预测性主要由决策位置而非同一位置内的区分能力决定时，为什么基于分数的证据可能产生误导。总之，这些结果表明，评估学得的元层级控制应分别考察三个方面：其分数是否依赖状态、这种依赖是否会改变实际行为，以及这些变化所捕获的结果价值是否超越强大的非自适应策略。

    MoEMB: Scaling Universal Multimodal Embeddings with Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Models

    MoEMB：利用高效混合专家模型扩展通用多模态嵌入

    Xuanming Cui, Shlok Kumar Mishra, Wentao Bao, Aashu Singh, Zihao Wang, Xiangjun Fan, Jun Xiao, Ser-Nam Lim, Jianpeng Cheng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MoEMB studies mixture-of-experts scaling and adaptive computation for multimodal embedding, with evidence that expert scaling improves capacity and efficiency. Its compositional and representation connections are incidental; the main contribution concerns model computation and systems efficiency.

    MoEMB 研究了多模态嵌入的混合专家扩展和自适应计算，并提供证据表明专家扩展能够提升容量和效率。它与组合和表征的联系只是附带的；其主要贡献涉及模型计算和系统效率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.

    中文

    通用多模态嵌入（UME）对编码器处理日益复杂的广泛任务和模态的能力提出了更高要求。以往的扩展方法要么增大表征规模、增加检索开销，要么将编码器扩展为庞大的多模态 LLM。近期工作（如 Think-Then-Embed（TTE））探索了通过推理 token 进行扩展。然而，嵌入模型难以扩展：直接增加参数会与对比学习所需的大训练批次相冲突，而且检索服务必须满足严格的延迟要求。此外，UME 任务的复杂度各异，扩大嵌入器规模可能带来大量冗余计算。在这项工作中，我们提出 MOEMB，通过混合专家（MoE）沿专家轴扩展 UME，在提升编码器容量的同时保留单向量、非自回归编码。通过系统研究基于 MoE 的 UME 的设计空间和训练方案，MOEMB 在使用公开 MMEB 系列数据训练的模型中，在 MMEB-V2 和 MRMR 上均取得新的最先进水平：仅使用 3B 个活跃参数，MOEMB 就超过了活跃参数量在其 4 倍以上的 TTE 类方法，同时显著减少计算量。为进一步提升可扩展性和效率，我们首次全面研究了基于 MoE 的嵌入模型自适应计算，涵盖训练式和仅推理式的多种策略。总体而言，这些结果支持将专家扩展作为 UME 的一种有效且高效的发展方向，而自适应计算还能进一步提升基于 MLLM 的嵌入模型的效率，助力大规模检索和推荐系统。

    The Truth Was Never Gone: Perfect Aliasing in Compliant-Context Truth Probes

    真相从未消失：符合情境的真相探针中的完美混叠

    Dylan Jayabahu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that truth-probe scores can reflect label aliasing rather than loss of internal truth information, with mixed-fit probes recovering the bit; this is a substantial, transferable result about interpreting model representations. The secret-bit task and reward-trained policy are experimental context, not contributions to composition, reasoning, or system design.

    本文表明，真相探针的得分可能反映标签混叠，而非内部真相信息的丢失；混合拟合的探针能够恢复该比特。这是关于如何解读模型表征的一项重要且可迁移的结果。秘密比特任务和经奖励训练的策略属于实验背景，并非有关组合、推理或系统设计的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Linear probes that decode the truth from a language model's activations have been proposed as deception monitors, and a truth probe scoring below chance on a model trained to deceive is naturally read as evidence that the model hid or stopped representing the truth. We show that a fitting-label ambiguity can produce the same readout. In a controlled game, a model should report a secret bit to an ally and its complement to a rival. On compliant (ally) contexts the true bit and the answer the task prescribes are identical labels, so a probe fitted there cannot tell which of the two it measures. We call this complete agreement perfect aliasing. The labels are complements on rival contexts, so one ally-fitted probe scored against each has rival AUROCs that sum to one. Mixed fitting, on ally and rival contexts together, makes the two labels differ; randomized output codebooks also decouple the prescribed answer from the output letter. For a reward-trained Gemma-2-9B policy that answers falsely on every evaluated rival trial, the ally-fitted probe scores $0.006 \pm 0.005$ AUROC at the final layer (mean $\pm$ sample SD over three RL training seeds), while mixed-fit probes score 1.000 on the same held-out activations. Mixed fitting also uses more examples and labelled rival data, so this shows the true bit remains linearly recoverable, not that separating the labels alone explains the gain. In instructed Llama-3.1-8B, a probe refitted on one prompt variant and one frozen from a reference variant both have held-out ally accuracy 1.000 but rival truth AUROCs of 0.080 and 0.986 on the same trials. Our main experiments use one single-token game that states the bit in the prompt, so the recovered direction may read a retained copy of it; where the model must infer the bit, no tested arm deceives reliably. We study what a probe measures, not whether the model uses that information.

    中文

    有研究提出，能够从语言模型激活中解码真相的线性探针可用作欺骗监测器；当一个经过欺骗训练的模型上的真相探针得分低于随机水平时，人们很自然会将其解读为模型隐藏了真相或不再表征真相。我们表明，拟合标签的歧义也会产生相同的读数。在一个受控游戏中，模型应向盟友报告一个秘密比特，向对手报告其反值。在符合要求的（盟友）情境中，真实比特与任务规定的答案是相同标签，因此在这些情境上拟合的探针无法判断自己测量的是哪一个。我们称这种完全一致为完美混叠。在对手情境中，这两个标签互为反值，因此同一个在盟友情境上拟合的探针对它们分别评分时，对手情境上的 AUROC 之和为一。在盟友和对手情境上共同拟合，会使两个标签不同；随机化输出码本也能将规定答案与输出字母解耦。对于一个经奖励训练的 Gemma-2-9B 策略，它在每次评估的对手试验中都给出错误答案；盟友拟合探针在最后一层的得分为 $0.006 \pm 0.005$ AUROC（三个 RL 训练随机种子上的均值，$\pm$样本标准差），而混合拟合探针在相同的留出激活上得分为 1.000。混合拟合也使用了更多样本和带标签的对手数据，因此这表明真实比特仍可由线性方式恢复，但并不能说明仅仅分离标签就能解释性能提升。在按指令运行的 Llama-3.1-8B 中，一个在某种提示变体上重新拟合的探针，以及一个从参考变体中冻结的探针，在相同试验中都具有 1.000 的留出盟友准确率，但其对手情境真相 AUROC 分别为 0.080 和 0.986。我们的主要实验采用一种单 token 游戏，在提示中直接给出比特，因此恢复出的方向可能读取的是模型保留的比特副本；而在模型必须推断比特的情况下，所测试的各组都无法可靠地欺骗。我们研究的是探针测量什么，而不是模型是否使用了这些信息。

    Data-Free On-Policy Distillation: How Far Can We Go Without External Data?

    无数据的在线策略蒸馏：没有外部数据时能走多远？

    Gengsheng Li, Mao Zheng, Mingyang Song, Jie Sun, Zeyuan Liu, Ruiqi Liu, Tianyu Yang, Qiyong Zhong, Haiyun Guo, Junfeng Fang, Shiming Xiang, Jinqiao Wang, Tat-Seng Chua

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that on-policy distillation can develop transferable reasoning capabilities from very few or self-generated questions, a substantial contribution to reasoning training. Reusable reasoning transfer is only an incidental connection to compositional generalization, and the abstract gives no internal-mechanism or systems contribution.

    本文表明，仅凭很少的问题或自生成问题，在线策略蒸馏也能培养可迁移的推理能力，这是对推理训练的重要贡献。可复用的推理迁移与组合泛化只有附带关联；摘要没有给出内部机制或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly applied to frontier foundation model post-training. Prior work in this area has largely focused on algorithmic advances, yet it remains unclear how much OPD depends on its training questions and, in particular, how far this dependence can be reduced. Across two representative single-teacher OPD settings, we find that training on 8 real prompts yields performance comparable to training on 17k problems, while datasets differing substantially in measured difficulty and initial distillation gap yield similar outcomes. Our analyses suggest two complementary explanations: repeated sampling could allow even a few prompts to expose substantial teacher supervision, while OPD transfers generalizable reasoning capabilities beyond dataset-specific knowledge. Building on these observations, we next propose a data-free on-policy distillation (DF-OPD) setting to investigate whether the system can supply the training questions itself, eliminating the need for external data. With 64 self-generated questions obtained without seed examples, DF-OPD yields performance comparable to full-data OPD in both single-teacher settings. This finding also holds in multi-teacher OPD: across mathematics, code, and instruction following, 1k generated questions achieve performance comparable to training on approximately 7k real post-training examples. We further explore whether OPD can operate even without explicit training questions. The experiments show that this is effective only in limited cases, where the student unexpectedly generates and answers its own questions, thereby reducing the process to an implicit form of DF-OPD. Together, these findings invite a reassessment of the role of training data in on-policy distillation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ryuki661/DF-OPD

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）正越来越多地用于前沿基础模型的后训练。该领域以往的工作主要关注算法进展，但 OPD 在多大程度上依赖训练问题，尤其是这种依赖能减弱到何种程度，仍不清楚。在两种具有代表性的单教师 OPD 设置中，我们发现，用 8 个真实提示训练的表现与用 17k 道题训练相当；即使数据集在测得的难度和初始蒸馏差距上差异显著，结果也相近。我们的分析提出了两种互补的解释：反复采样或许能让少量提示提供大量教师监督；而 OPD 能迁移超越数据集特定知识的通用推理能力。基于这些观察，我们进一步提出无数据在线策略蒸馏（DF-OPD）设置，以探究系统能否自行提供训练问题，从而消除对外部数据的需求。在无种子示例的情况下，通过 64 个自生成问题进行训练，DF-OPD 在两种单教师设置中的表现均与使用完整数据的 OPD 相当。这一发现也适用于多教师 OPD：在数学、代码和指令遵循任务中，使用 1k 个生成问题训练的表现与使用约 7k 个真实后训练示例相当。我们还进一步探究 OPD 是否能在没有明确训练问题的情况下运行。实验显示，这仅在有限情况下有效，此时学生会出乎意料地自行生成并回答问题，从而使这一过程退化为一种隐式的 DF-OPD。总体而言，这些发现促使我们重新评估训练数据在在线策略蒸馏中的作用。代码见 https://github.com/Ryuki661/DF-OPD

    Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces

    无标签引导：将测试时强化学习压缩到仅偏置子空间

    Naveen Vakada, Mingyuan Li, Shaoxiong Ji

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops label-free, bias-only test-time reinforcement learning for reasoning and analyzes how consensus reliability and accessible gradient energy relate to adaptation. Transfer to held-out problems supports generalization, but the abstract does not study compositional structure or internal representations deeply enough for higher scores.

    本文提出无标签、仅偏置的测试时强化学习方法用于推理，并分析共识可靠性和可访问梯度能量与适配之间的关系。向留出问题迁移的结果支持其泛化能力，但摘要没有深入研究组合结构或内部表征，因此不足以获得更高评价。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudolabels as rewards and optimizes only ~100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy with Qwen2.5-7B, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.

    中文

    测试时强化学习（TTRL）使模型无需依赖带标签训练数据即可提升推理能力，但现有方法通常会优化模型中很大一部分参数。这引出了一个自然问题：当奖励信号和优化空间都受到严格限制时，能否实现有效的测试时适配？我们通过无标签、仅偏置的 TTRL 回答这一问题：该方法将多数投票伪标签用作奖励，仅优化约 100K 个偏置参数，同时冻结预训练骨干网络。在 MATH-500 上，我们的方法使用 Qwen2.5-7B 达到 76.67% 的准确率，略高于我们复现的带标签偏置引导方法，所优化的参数数量则比全参数 TTRL 少 76,000 倍。同一训练流程还能提升视觉语言和音频推理任务的表现，包括 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista 和 MMAU。我们进一步表明，学得的引导向量能够迁移到 4,500 道留出的 MATH 题目，说明这种适配并不限于测试时优化所用的问题。最后，我们分析这种高度受限的适配为何有效：多数投票的可靠性会随多次 rollout 的共识程度提高；而可访问梯度能量更高的偏置子空间表现出更强的下游可训练性。这些结果表明，仅使用完全无标签的奖励来优化极小的仅偏置子空间，也能实现显著的测试时适配。

    EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data

    EconSkills：研究实时经济数据网页智能体的技能迁移与检索

    Yinzhu Quan, Zefang Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EconSkills studies whether parameterized procedures transfer across web tasks and how agents retrieve them from a skill library, with evidence about matching and verification. This advances reusable composition and agent memory/retrieval, while reasoning is incidental to the web-task application and internal mechanisms are not examined.

    EconSkills 研究参数化流程能否在网页任务间迁移，以及智能体如何从技能库中检索流程，并提供了关于匹配和验证的证据。这推进了可复用组合以及智能体记忆与检索；推理只是网页任务应用中的附带因素，且没有考察内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether an agent can retain that benefit when selecting from a library. In controlled transfer, matched skills improve success over no-skill prompting and require fewer steps on paired successes. Under the evaluated prompt formats, the parameterized skill prompt substantially outperforms the corresponding raw-trajectory prompt. With the full 50-skill library, retrieval is competitive with the no-skill baseline overall and performs best on tasks with a direct family match; approximate matches on other tasks offset these gains. Browser trajectories further identify when procedural guidance shortens portal-specific navigation and when semantic verification remains necessary. These results establish that reusable economic web procedures can transfer across task instances and provide a concrete design target for match-aware selection and context delivery.

    中文

    网页智能体往往会反复访问同一网站，但大多数评估会丢弃先前成功交互中学到的操作流程。我们提出 EconSkills，这是一个技能库和评估框架，将经过验证的 EconWebArena 轨迹提炼为参数化的标准操作规程，用于检索实时经济数据。每项技能都记录其适用范围、导航流程、网站特定指引、验证检查和恢复步骤，并将源实例中的具体值替换为占位符。EconSkills 区分两个问题：已知的相关流程能否迁移到留出任务，以及智能体在从技能库中选择技能时能否保留这种收益。在受控迁移实验中，与不提供技能的提示相比，匹配的技能能提高成功率，并在配对成功案例中减少所需步骤。在所评估的提示格式下，参数化技能提示的表现显著优于相应的原始轨迹提示。使用完整的 50 项技能库时，检索的整体表现与无技能基线相当；在存在直接技能族匹配的任务上效果最佳，而其他任务上的近似匹配抵消了这些收益。浏览器轨迹还揭示了程序性指引何时能缩短特定门户网站的导航流程，以及何时仍需进行语义验证。这些结果证明，可复用的经济数据网页操作流程能够在不同任务实例间迁移，并为匹配感知的技能选择和上下文提供方式确立了明确的设计目标。

    DENSE: Distilling Agent Trajectories into Evidence-Grounded Shortcut Trees for Self-Refinement

    DENSE：将智能体轨迹提炼为以证据为依据的捷径树，用于自我改进

    Siyuan Liu (1 and 2), Fan Yu (1 and 2), Dongyu Ru (2), Yizhu Liu (2), Yifan Yang (2), Xuezhi Cao (2), Xunliang Cai (2), Yixin Cao (1) ((1) Fudan University, (2) Meituan Longcat Team)

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DENSE distills agent execution traces into reusable shortcut trees for feedback-guided retries, improving task success while reducing retry tokens. Its structured reuse has a partial connection to composition and problem-solving, while agent trajectory memory and self-refinement are substantial systems contributions.

    DENSE 将智能体执行轨迹提炼成可复用的捷径树，用于反馈引导的重试，从而提高任务成功率并减少重试所需的 token。其结构化复用与组合和问题求解有一定联系，而智能体轨迹记忆和自我改进则是重要的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Online agent deployments accumulate execution trajectories at massive scale and behavioral diversity, for which predefined annotation criteria hardly exist. Extracting useful evidence therefore demands costly manual annotation or verifier signals that fail to scale, leaving valuable evidence buried among redundant, incomplete, and failed executions. This raises a question: without post-execution rewards or correctness labels, how can reusable experience be distilled from the trajectories themselves? To address this challenge, we introduce DENSE (Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions), which organizes trajectory-derived evidence into nested shortcut trees. By consolidating redundant attempts, identifying resolved subtasks, and retaining useful steps alongside outstanding requirements, DENSE transforms noisy execution traces into structured and reusable task-solving feedback. To evaluate whether such feedback helps agents retry the same task, we design REFIT, which measures success-rate changes between the initial attempt and feedback-guided retries. Among feedback methods without external outcome supervision, DENSE achieves the highest strict pass rate across four agent models on Terminal-Bench 2.1, improving over initial attempts by 7.12-21.81 percentage points with 19.0-43.6% fewer agent tokens on retries. In addition, on hard tasks DENSE consistently outperforms self-reflection in cumulative pass rate across multiple feedback iterations on all four models, demonstrating its strong potential for continual agent self-improvement.

    中文

    在线部署的智能体会积累规模庞大且行为多样的执行轨迹，而针对这些轨迹几乎不存在预先定义的标注标准。因此，提取有用证据要么需要耗费大量成本进行人工标注，要么依赖无法规模化的验证器信号，导致宝贵证据被埋没在冗余、不完整和失败的执行记录中。这引出了一个问题：没有执行后的奖励或正确性标签时，如何从轨迹本身提炼可复用经验？为应对这一挑战，我们提出 DENSE（从嵌套子任务执行中提炼证据），将轨迹得出的证据组织为嵌套捷径树。DENSE 整合冗余尝试、识别已解决的子任务，并在保留有用步骤的同时记录尚待满足的要求，从而将嘈杂的执行轨迹转化为结构化、可复用的任务求解反馈。为了评估此类反馈是否有助于智能体重试同一任务，我们设计了 REFIT，用于衡量初始尝试与受反馈引导的重试之间的成功率变化。在无需外部结果监督的反馈方法中，DENSE 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 的四种智能体模型上取得最高的严格通过率；与初始尝试相比，通过率提高了 7.12–21.81 个百分点，重试时使用的智能体 token 减少了 19.0–43.6%。此外，在困难任务上，DENSE 在四种模型的多轮反馈迭代中，累计通过率始终高于自我反思，展现出强大的持续自我改进潜力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ELF-REG trains continuous diffusion language models for math and code reasoning using teacher-supervised intermediate features and joint denoising, with early stopping for low-NFE generation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.

    中文

    全连续扩散语言模型（dLM）对连续表征进行去噪，不经过中间离散化，然后在最后一步并行解码所有回答 token。与自回归（AR）LLM 和掩码 dLM 相比，它们在高难度推理任务上的表现尚未得到充分验证。我们将嵌入语言流（ELF）扩展到 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval 和 MBPP 上的数学推理与代码生成任务。我们提出 ELF-REG，通过表征对齐与纠缠（REPA+REG）改进学习：冻结的 AR 教师模型监督去噪器的中间特征，并提供与回答共同去噪的全局表征。ELF-REG-L 在 64 次网络函数评估（NFE）下，于 GSM8K 上达到 55.96% 的 pass@1；在 128 次 NFE 下，于 MATH-500 和 HumanEval 上分别达到 13.39% 和 22.56%。在 GSM8K 和代码任务的 pass@1 上，它超过了所评估的同等规模 dLM；在 MATH-500 上，它将 pass@1 从 ELF-L 基线的 10.55% 提升至 ELF-REG-L 的 13.39%。无需进行少步训练，同一批特定任务检查点也能通过提前停止实现较强的低 NFE 表现：该方法会解码中间的干净预测，而不完成整个去噪轨迹。在 16 次 NFE 下，ELF-REG-L 的 HumanEval pass@10 达到 41.21%，超过了近期同等规模的连续 dLM。

    Ming Zhang, Zhenghao Xiang, Peizhong Gao, Yujiong Shen, Yuhui Wang, Zhonghan Yue, Shihan Dou, Zhangyue Yin, Junjie Ye, Shichun Liu, Weihuang Zheng, Jiahao Chen, Jiayi Chen, Hongzhang Liu, Jiaqi Shao, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Suncong Zheng, Maxm Pan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ExplorationBench measures whether systems can discover and apply unfamiliar rules through hypothesis testing, experiments, and feedback, making it a substantial contribution to evaluating exploration and problem solving. Reusable composition is not a focus, and tool schemas and sandboxes do not provide enough evidence of a systems-design contribution for a higher Systems score.

    ExplorationBench 衡量系统能否通过假设检验、实验和反馈发现并应用陌生规则，因此对评估探索和问题解决能力作出了重要贡献。可复用组合并非其重点，而工具模式和沙盒不足以证明其在系统设计方面作出了足以获得更高 Systems 评分的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.

    中文

    科学发现始于已知问题的尽头。在那里，AI 系统必须开展探索：提出假设、设计实验并反复检验结果。然而，评估这种能力很困难：（1）如何验证一个真正新颖的假设是否成立；（2）如何判断系统是通过探索发现了它，还是仅仅回忆起预训练数据中的相关知识。为此，我们提出 ExplorationBench，将评估科学探索这一棘手问题转化为一个具体且可处理的框架，该框架建立在可验证的外星世界之上：这些世界的规则可执行，因此每个答案都能得到精确检验；同时这些规则与熟悉的知识相冲突，因此仅靠回忆无法完成任务。该基准包含两个沙盒：AlienCode（31 个发现目标、70 项任务）和 AlienLogic（24 个发现目标、70 项任务）。每个沙盒都提供一份有缺陷的手册、针对具体任务的环境反馈，以及专用的工具调用模式。系统利用这些资源探索沙盒，然后解决保留测试任务。我们评估了 10 个 AI 系统，发现表现最强的系统能够习得并应用陌生规则，但不同探索轨迹之间的表现差异很大，而且持续探索可能停滞，甚至使先前取得的进步倒退。ExplorationBench 是迈向这样一种 AI 系统的一步：它们能够通过在未知环境中探索来习得并应用真正的新知识。

    Brandon Gary Kaplowitz, Osaze James Obahor, and Christian Schroeder de Witt

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MA-JEPA contributes a latent joint-embedding world model and training architecture for multi-agent reinforcement learning, using imagined trajectories for actor-critic learning. Its world modeling and action-conditioned prediction relate to representation learning and planning, but the abstract does not study internal mechanisms or compositional generalization; the primary contribution is a model-based multi-agent system.

    MA-JEPA 为多智能体强化学习提出了一种潜在联合嵌入世界模型和训练架构，并利用想象轨迹进行演员-评论家学习。其世界建模和动作条件预测与表征学习及规划相关，但摘要没有研究内部机制或组合泛化；其主要贡献是一个基于模型的多智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models improve sample efficiency by training policies on imagined trajectories, but their usefulness depends on learning representations that capture the information needed for future control. We study whether self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) can provide this learning signal for multi-agent reinforcement learning. We introduce MA-JEPA, a stochastic world model that replaces observation reconstruction with prediction of target representations, enabling model-based multi-agent reinforcement learning with centralized training and decentralized execution. A categorical latent state and a causal Transformer are trained with posterior and action-conditioned dynamics prediction objectives and are then used for actor-critic learning from latent imagination. A training-only joint predictor conditions on all agents' local states and actions to predict each agent's next local observation embedding. These predictions are passed through the same local posterior used during real interaction with a centralized critic that is used only for value learning, with execution remaining decentralized. Our experiments show that this architecture performs strongly on SMAC, matching or exceeding the strongest reported comparator mean win rate on four of eight evaluated maps.

    Opera develops a persistent verbal critic that diagnoses coding-agent problems, checks feedback against evidence, and tracks whether corrections resolve them; guided rollouts also improve later training.     Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades. Our code is available at: https://github.com/dongyuanjushi/Opera.

    Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds

    超越记忆中的世界：面向演变世界中持续导航的预测性 4D 信念

    Mingjian Gao, Zhaocheng Li, Haoyang Huang, Wenqiao Zhang, Yingjie Niu, Hao Zhou, Chao Li, Juncheng Li, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由
