    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives a target-flow bound and exit law for exact speculative verification, then uses target feedback to improve draft trees and reduce decoding latency. This advances inference-time computation and mathematical reasoning workloads, while compositionality is only a limited connection through assembling draft continuations.

    本文推导了精确推测验证的目标流界限和退出分布，再利用目标模型反馈改进草稿树并降低解码延迟。这项工作推进了推理时计算，并应用于数学推理任务；组合性仅通过组装草稿续写与论文存在有限关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

    基于树的推测解码在一次目标模型前向处理中验证多个草稿续写，但由草稿分数构建的有限树面临草稿分布与目标分布不匹配这一根本问题。我们探讨能否通过改进精确验证来提高固定树上的接受率，以及如何利用目标模型反馈改进树本身。通过目标流视角，我们确定了一种典范退出分布，并证明，对于任何精确路径验证器，目标覆盖率加一能够对预期输出块长度（包括奖励词元）给出严格界限。所有最优验证器共享相同的退出分布和奖励词元分布，代表性的预抽取后跟随验证器和序贯残差验证器已经达到了这一分布。由此，我们提出树退出验证（TEV），一种精确、按层并行的流程，只需进行一次退出节点决策和一次奖励词元决策。退出分布还能指出缺失的目标概率，从而为推理时草稿树提供节点级反馈，用于退出引导的草稿树训练（ExitTrain）。在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验验证了固定树等价性：ExitTrain将平均输出块长度提高13%，而TEV将验证器阶段的延迟降低15%，相较DDTree实现了14%的端到端加速。我们的结果区分了两个改进方向：改进草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证以降低延迟。代码：https://github.com/hsj576/TEV。

    Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To

    思维惯性：即使被告知不要思考，LLM仍会继续思考

    Dianqiao Lei, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Pan Lu, Philip Torr, James Zou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures whether models stop explicit inference under no-thinking instructions and finds persistent reasoning and task-dependent trade-offs. This directly advances reasoning evaluation; prompt controls alone provide only an incidental connection to agent systems.

    本文衡量模型在无思考指令下是否会停止显式推断，并发现推理会持续存在，且不同任务间存在权衡。这直接推进了推理评估；提示控制与智能体系统的关联只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地配备明确的“思考模式”，但与之相对的“无思考”模式受到的关注要少得多。我们从两个方面研究LLM的无思考行为。a. 如何衡量无思考？以往工作通常通过代理指标定义无思考，例如关闭思考模式或没有长推理轨迹。这些代理指标并不可靠：关闭思考模式后仍可能输出推理，而长轨迹中也可能只有填充内容，并无真正推断。我们改为将每个回答规范化为答案前轨迹和最终答案，并从三个层面进行评估：(i) 空思考率，用于衡量是否严格遵循仅回答答案的要求；(ii) 指令感知的问题—答案前轨迹相关性，用于衡量问题与答案前轨迹的相似程度；(iii) 由LLM担任评审的显式推断率，用于衡量可见的显式推断。这些指标共同区分了仅含答案的输出、相关但不包含推断的文本，以及显式推断。b. 无思考行为如何随任务和模型变化？我们在六个LLM上评估了六种提示干预，涵盖布尔题、选择题和开放式问题。我们发现，明确的无思考控制无法可靠地消除可见推断。相反，模型表现出“思维惯性”：即使在严格控制下，显式推断仍会持续存在，并且随着答案空间开放程度增大而更常见。在布尔题和选择题上，准确率保持稳定；而开放式问题则暴露出仅回答答案的遵从性与任务准确率之间的权衡。将相同问题改写为不同答案空间的形式后，我们发现提供候选答案会让模型更容易只输出答案。这些发现表明，无思考是一种不可忽视的能力：不能仅凭模型设置或指令就假定模型会停止显式推理，因此应当像评估推理能力一样，对无思考能力进行系统评估。

    Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to operate industrial energy equipment, and what they get right depends on what they are told about the plant. Established building ontologies name many kinds of points across many sites, whereas an industrial equipment system needs few entities with much knowledge about each. This study proposes the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens in two ways: through quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations, and through lessons from the operating journal incorporated as knowledge nodes. On a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller, agents received a text projected from its tower in a preregistered evaluation of nine tasks replayed from the plant's records, using four open-weight models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. This knowledge raised the rate at which the agents avoided the most plausible misjudgment of each task by about 20 percentage points, and the overall task score of the 9-billion-parameter model as much as that of the largest. In live runs through an invariant safety layer, the agents brought the controlled variable into its target band in 12 of 14 runs. An ontology narrow in entities but deep in what is known about them can thus supply the knowledge that an agent for an industrial equipment system needs.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体开始用于操作工业能源设备，而它们能否正确操作取决于所获知的工厂信息。成熟的建筑本体为许多站点中的多种测点命名，而一个工业设备系统需要的实体较少，但对每个实体都需要了解很多信息。本研究提出“本体塔”：一个针对单一设备系统的窄而深的本体，其知识通过两种方式深化：一是利用物理关系从测量点推导出的量，二是将运行日志中的经验教训作为知识节点纳入其中。在一座真实的低湿度空气处理测试工厂中，设备通过可编程逻辑控制器每日运行。智能体在一项预注册评估中接收由该本体塔转换而来的文本；评估使用了根据工厂记录重放的九项任务，并采用了四个开放权重模型，规模从90亿到约7500亿参数不等。这些知识使智能体避免每项任务中最可能发生的误判的比例提高了约20个百分点，也使90亿参数模型的总体任务得分提高到与最大模型相当。纳入本体塔或作为记录放入提示中的运行经验教训会被使用；若将其留在日志中并通过搜索工具访问，则很少被使用。在经过不变安全层的实时运行中，智能体在14次运行中有12次将受控变量调节到了目标区间。因此，实体数量少、对每个实体的了解却很深入的本体，能够为工业设备系统智能体提供所需知识。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.

    长期个性化要求语言模型利用交互历史，跨会话追踪用户偏好。参数记忆将这些交互历史编码到模型参数或适配器中，从而减少在推理上下文中包含这些历史的需求。然而，独立编译上下文并未明确跨会话整合方式，而循环更新可能会削弱早期证据。为应对这些挑战，我们提出双路径参数记忆（DPPM）。其证据路径直接汇集交互历史的表示，以保留早期证据；其增量路径则按顺序更新关联状态，以捕捉变化。融合两条路径的输出会生成以历史为条件的 LoRA 适配器，将证据累积与有序修订结合起来。在多个骨干模型上，DPPM 优于所评估的基线，在 PersonaMem-v2 上达到 54.22%，在 PrefEval 上达到 86.79%。这些结果表明，DPPM 为跨会话个性化参数记忆提供了一种简单而有效的设计选择。

    Compile the Table: Query-Calibrated Operator Compression for Tabular In-Context Learning

    Xu Zhao, Jiaming Zhao, Bin Zhao, Yong Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    QCOC contributes a query-calibrated method for compressing and reusing in-context KV memory, balancing inference speed and prediction accuracy. This is a substantial model-computation and memory design contribution; the use of prototypes and tabular ICL does not by itself demonstrate representation mechanisms, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    QCOC 提出了一种查询校准方法，用于压缩和复用上下文中的 KV 记忆，在推理速度与预测准确率之间取得平衡。这是对模型计算和记忆设计的一项重要贡献；使用原型和表格 ICL 本身并不能证明其展示了表征机制、组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tabular in-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a training-free and accurate paradigm for tabular prediction, but current approaches to compressing its in-context examples face an accuracy-throughput tradeoff: fixed subsets can sacrifice accuracy, while query-specific retrieval limits cache reuse and batching across queries, reducing throughput. We propose QCOC (Query-Calibrated Operator Compression), which exploits the exchangeability and repeated use of in-context examples by compiling their full KV cache once into compact memory shared across subsequent queries. Instead of retaining raw examples, QCOC clusters their states into joint-KV prototypes, preserves per-cluster multiplicities and the original example count, and calibrates prototype values against attention query vectors produced by the in-context examples through an anchored closed-form solution. Prototype compression drives the speedup, while value fitting helps preserve accuracy. On 64 held-out OpenML-CC18 datasets, QCOC achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared compression and retrieval methods at both retained counts. Across 12 configurations on seven long tables, it ranks first among compressed methods in ten and averages 0.23 percentage points below full context. Compressing 8,192 in-context examples to 512 memory slots yields a 10.5x cache compression ratio; excluding one-time compilation, in a single-core CPU online-serving comparison over 1,000 queries, QCOC is up to 508x faster than dynamic retrieval baselines and 1.98x faster than full-context inference. These results show that QCOC enables compact-memory reuse and efficient inference across queries while retaining accuracy close to full context.

    中文

    表格上下文学习（ICL）已成为一种无需训练且准确的表格预测范式，但当前压缩其上下文示例的方法面临准确率与吞吐量之间的权衡：固定子集可能牺牲准确率，而针对查询的检索会限制跨查询的缓存复用和批处理，从而降低吞吐量。我们提出 QCOC（查询校准算子压缩），利用上下文示例的可交换性和重复使用特性，将其完整 KV 缓存一次性编译为紧凑记忆，供后续查询共享。QCOC 不保留原始示例，而是将其状态聚类为联合 KV 原型，保留每个簇的多重性和原始示例数量，并通过锚定的闭式解，根据上下文示例生成的注意力查询向量校准原型值。原型压缩带来加速，而值拟合有助于保持准确率。在 64 个留出的 OpenML-CC18 数据集上，在两种保留数量下，QCOC 在所比较的压缩和检索方法中都取得最高的平均准确率。在七个长表格上的 12 种配置中，它在压缩方法中有十种排名第一，平均准确率比完整上下文低 0.23 个百分点。将 8,192 个上下文示例压缩到 512 个记忆槽，缓存压缩率达到 10.5 倍；在单核 CPU 在线服务对比中，对 1,000 个查询进行评估并排除一次性编译后，QCOC 比动态检索基线最高快 508 倍，比完整上下文推理快 1.98 倍。这些结果表明，QCOC 能够实现紧凑记忆复用和跨查询高效推理，同时保持接近完整上下文的准确率。

    Easy to anticipate, hard to compute: boundary dependence finds the computed outputs that entropy patching misses

    易于预判，难以计算：边界依赖能找到熵式分块遗漏的计算结果

    Nicol\'as Vera Z\'u\~niga

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that boundary dependence can direct limited patch computation toward values that require calculation, substantially improving mathematical answer accuracy over entropy-based layouts. This advances reasoning and adaptive computation, while composition is only incidental to grouping bytes into patches and the abstract offers no interpretability contribution.

    论文表明，边界依赖可以将有限的分块计算引导至需要计算的值，相较于基于熵的布局，显著提高数学答案的准确率。这推进了推理和自适应计算；组合能力仅与按块分组字节这一点有关，摘要也未提出可解释性方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) group bytes into patches and run their large global model once per patch. BLT starts a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high, so global compute goes where the next byte is hard to predict. We show that this rule has a systematic blind spot: positions whose type is predictable but whose value must be computed, such as the number after "=" in a worked math solution. Under tight patch budgets, entropy-triggered layouts skip these positions, and accuracy on them collapses. In Meta's BLT-1B with patch starts on 10% of bytes, the entropy rule puts a patch start at 16% of the computed results in GSM8K solutions and gets 19.0% of them exactly right; a boundary after each "=" at the same patch count gets 51.8%, and entropy combined with a label-free boundary-dependence signal gets 67.1% (default layout at 26% of bytes: 76.8%). The gap survives adapting BLT-1B to the budget with low-rank fine-tuning (32.9% vs 72.7%, three runs per rule, paired p < 1e-200) and grows with model size in byte models trained from scratch at a 10% budget: at 1M, 12M and 50M parameters, boundary dependence beats entropy on final answers by -1.6, +10.1 and +19.8 points, and at 50M it gets 35.9% of computed results against 13.9% (3 seeds each). BLT's entropy-jump rule helps neither target at 50M. The entropy trigger of Scratchpad Patching is likewise indistinguishable from random scratchpads on final answers (5.6% vs 5.9%, 5 seeds), while answer-start scratchpads give 38.1%. The effect is specific to computed values: copies and lookups gain little, and values the model cannot compute gain nothing. Boundary dependence, the rise in the model's own loss when a patch start is removed, measured per two-byte context, finds these positions without labels: combined with entropy it beats the hand-written rule on computed results.

    中文

    字节级语言模型（如 Byte Latent Transformer（BLT））将字节分组为块，并针对每个块运行一次大型全局模型。BLT 会在小模型的下一个字节熵较高处开始一个块，因此全局计算会用于下一个字节难以预测的位置。我们表明，这条规则存在一个系统性盲点：某些位置的类型容易预测，但其值必须经过计算才能得到，例如一道数学解题过程里“=”之后的数字。在块数量预算紧张时，由熵触发布局会跳过这些位置，导致这些位置上的准确率骤降。在 Meta 的 BLT-1B 中，当块起点占字节的 10% 时，熵规则在 GSM8K 解答中仅将 16% 的计算结果设为块起点，并且其中有 19.0% 完全正确；在相同块数量下，每个“=”之后设置边界的正确率为 51.8%，而将熵与无标签的边界依赖信号结合后，正确率达到 67.1%（默认布局覆盖字节的 26% 时为 76.8%）。通过低秩微调使 BLT-1B 适应预算后，差距依然存在（32.9% 对比 72.7%，每条规则运行三次，配对 p < 1e-200）；在预算为 10%、从头训练的字节模型中，随着模型规模增大，差距也会扩大：在 1M、12M 和 50M 参数规模下，边界依赖在最终答案上分别比熵规则低 1.6 个百分点、高 10.1 个百分点和高 19.8 个百分点；在 50M 参数规模下，它对 35.9% 的计算结果给出了正确答案，而熵规则为 13.9%（每种设置 3 个随机种子）。在 50M 参数规模下，BLT 的熵跃变规则对这两项目标都没有帮助。Scratchpad Patching 的熵触发机制在最终答案上的表现同样无法与随机 scratchpad 区分（5.6% 对比 5.9%，5 个随机种子），而从答案起始处开始的 scratchpad 达到 38.1%。这种效果专属于计算所得的值：复制和查找的提升很小，而模型无法计算的值则没有提升。边界依赖是指移除一个块起点时模型自身损失的上升幅度，按每两个字节的上下文测量；它无需标签即可找到这些位置，与熵结合后，在计算结果上优于手工编写的规则。

    Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks

    Memento 3：通过反思式规则手册实现基于模型的递归自我改进

    Haoyu Zhao, Zhengxu Yu, Zhiyuan He, Meng Fang, Rasul Tutunov, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Weilin Luo, Jun Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Memento 3 studies how a frozen LLM agent learns and revises explicit world models through persistent memory, executable prediction and planning, and verification, with exploration guided by the updated models. This substantially advances agent learning and planning systems, while composition is present in rule-based modeling but not the central contribution; it does not investigate the LLM’s internal representations or mechanisms.

    Memento 3 研究冻结的 LLM 智能体如何通过持久记忆、可执行的预测与规划以及验证来学习和修订显式世界模型，并由更新后的模型引导探索。这实质性地推进了智能体学习与规划系统；组合能力虽体现在基于规则的建模中，但并非核心贡献；该研究没有考察 LLM 的内部表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

    中文

    在陌生环境中学会行动，要求智能体推断世界的运作方式，并随着新证据到来修正这种理解。然而，有限的观察可能支持多个世界模型：它们都能解释过去的交互，却会对未见状态作出不同预测。我们推出 Memento 3，基于 Memento 系列，使冻结的 LLM 智能体能够通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型。智能体将自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录可修订的环境动态假设，同时对未知方面保持未充分规定。它将规则手册编译成用于预测和规划的可执行代码。通过持续进行观察、反思、规则修订、编译和验证，智能体利用预测误差来改进规则手册及其代码。只有当 LLM 判断更新后的代码忠实于规则手册，且逐格精确回放能够重现观察到的状态转移时，才会接受该代码。我们将这一过程作为实现递归自我改进（RSI）的一条基于模型的路径进行研究：智能体自主探索环境、修订其世界模型，并利用经过验证的更新来指导后续交互和学习，同时底层 LLM 保持固定。一个群体扩展版本会并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据，并利用它们的预测来引导探索。在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通过全部 25 款公开游戏的每一个关卡，平均相对人类行动效率（RHAE）为 100.0，所用行动数为人类的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例研究中，学习到的反馈控制器在三个开局不同的评估回合中都以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PRAXIS provides theoretical guarantees for co-evolving data generators, learners, and symbolic archives, with experiments in relational and algorithmic graph reasoning.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.

    Chen Zhao, Xingping Dong, Jiachun Shi, Liang Peng, Chong Wang, Zhen Lei, Ran He, Bo Du

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ResOT directly modifies LVLM hidden representations by identifying hallucinated directions and aligning their distribution with a faithful subspace, providing a mechanistic inference-time intervention.     ResOT 通过识别幻觉方向并将其分布与忠实子空间对齐，直接修改 LVLM 的隐藏表征，从而在推理时提供一种机制性干预。其自适应词元更新只是模型系统中的附带内容，摘要也没有给出与组合能力或推理的实质性联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DADP dynamically prunes network connections using activation–error-gradient products, with entropy and effective-rank measurements indicating that latent feature diversity is preserved.     ENGLISH

    Modern neural networks are heavily over-parameterized. This redundancy incurs substantial compute and memory overhead during training and inference. Existing pruning methods rely on post-hoc magnitude thresholds or static initialization heuristics. Consequently, they often require manual per-layer sparsity targets or expensive retraining cycles. We propose Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning (DADP), a biologically inspired structural plasticity mechanism. During training, DADP measures connection importance via the accumulated product of pre-synaptic activations and post-synaptic error gradients. Using a single global threshold instead of fixed layer budgets, DADP dynamically allocates sparsity across network depth while naturally inducing neuron- and channel-level pruning. Across MLP, VGG-16, ResNet-18, BiLSTM-CRF, and MiniBERT architectures, DADP matches or outperforms Magnitude, SNIP and RigL, retaining 73.67% accuracy (dense baseline: 76.06%) at 99% sparsity on ResNet-18. Finally, matrix-based Shannon entropy and effective rank measurements confirm that DADP preserves latent feature diversity at extreme sparsities without representation collapse.

    现代神经网络存在大量过参数化。这种冗余在训练和推理期间造成显著的计算与内存开销。现有剪枝方法依赖事后幅值阈值或静态初始化启发式。因此，它们通常需要手动设置逐层稀疏度目标，或进行代价高昂的再训练。我们提出动态活动依赖剪枝（DADP），一种受生物学启发的结构可塑性机制。在训练期间，DADP 通过累积突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的乘积来衡量连接的重要性。DADP 使用单一全局阈值，而非固定的逐层预算，动态地在网络深度方向分配稀疏度，同时自然实现神经元级和通道级剪枝。在 MLP、VGG-16、ResNet-18、BiLSTM-CRF 和 MiniBERT 架构上，DADP 的表现与 Magnitude、SNIP 和 RigL 相当或更优；在 ResNet-18 上达到 99% 稀疏度时，准确率仍为 73.67%（稠密基线：76.06%）。最后，基于矩阵的香农熵和有效秩测量证实，在极高稀疏度下，DADP 保留了潜在特征多样性，没有发生表征坍塌。

    Hexuan Deng, Zihao Yan, Xuebo Liu, Shuo Nie, Yue Wang, Chen Wang, Zhaohua Zhang, Tianwen Jiang, Qiuyong Xiao, Jihong Zhang, Min Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GRPODropout uses rollout-level analysis to motivate selectively excluding high-probability, positive-advantage samples during GRPO updates, reporting better accuracy and actor entropy. This directly advances RL training for reasoning, while its selective rollout usage is only incidental to system organization and does not describe a broader agent or memory design.

    GRPODropout 通过轨迹级分析，说明在 GRPO 更新期间选择性排除高概率、正优势样本的动机，并报告了更高的准确率和策略熵。这直接推进了面向推理的 RL 训练；其选择性使用轨迹只是系统组织方面的附带内容，并未描述更广泛的智能体或记忆设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）方法（如 GRPO）能够显著提升大型语言模型的推理能力，但常受策略熵坍塌影响：采样多样性的丧失会削弱探索并限制后续提升。现有方法要么通过奖励修改、熵/KL 正则化等算法级干预来应对这一问题，要么采用词元级重加权。我们探讨一种互补视角：改变哪些生成轨迹会参与策略更新，也可以缓解熵坍塌。在相同采样预算下，并非所有轨迹都能对更新产生正面作用，选择性地排除其中一些轨迹可能改善学习。为此，我们提出 GRPODropout：在标准更新之前，通过一种简单策略选择性移除少量高概率、正优势轨迹，并对保留的优势值重新居中。为说明这一设计的动机，我们开展了轨迹级理论分析，以指导方法设计和阈值选择。该方法只改变轨迹的使用方式，额外计算开销可以忽略不计。实验表明，在更新中使用更少轨迹样本的同时，该方法比原始 GRPO 准确率更高、策略熵更高，体现了“少即是多”。这项工作为 RL 中轨迹的使用方式提供了见解：移除部分轨迹可以提升性能。代码见 https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent skills provide reusable guidance for code agents, but incomplete or unsuitable guidance can impair task execution. To reduce the manual effort of skill refinement, recent approaches use LLMs to generate revisions from execution feedback. However, grounding these revisions in explicit behavioral evidence remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose SkillMorph, a skill-evolution approach based on trajectory-guided fault localization in agent skills. Its core idea is to link execution evidence to specific skill contents before generating revisions. Specifically, SkillMorph compares failure and success evidence in abstracted trajectories across repeated runs and tasks, incorporating changes between evolution loops to identify suspicious actions. It then uses these suspicious actions to localize edit sites in the skills and generate corresponding revisions. Experiments on SWE-Skills-Bench and CannBot show that the skills evolved by SkillMorph consistently achieve higher trial-level accuracy and execution consistency than the original skills and those from four existing skill-evolution methods. We have also applied SkillMorph to automated kernel generation with an AI operator-development team, which has accepted 6 skill-revision pull requests.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The benchmark measures program execution prediction and checkpoint-state prediction, showing that reasoning-enabled settings outperform others and exposing errors hidden by short-output scores.     该基准衡量程序执行预测和检查点状态预测，表明启用推理的设置优于其他设置，并揭示了短输出得分会掩盖的错误。这显著推动了推理评估，但并未识别内部机制；代码和状态跟踪只是任务背景，并非组合性或系统方面的贡献。

    ENGLISH

    We present a benchmark for predicting final output and checkpoint state from source and input alone. It extends CRUXEval-style output prediction with paired shorter- and longer-trace inputs and checkpoints inside and after a loop. The benchmark contains 400 cases from 371 Python and C++ programs, evaluated under seven settings from four model families without tools or code execution. Of 11,200 planned predictions, 11,151 produced gradable responses. Reasoning-enabled settings outperform their off counterparts by 33.1 to 55.2 percentage points on completed responses. The strongest setting scores 93.0% on shorter-trace final output, 77.0% on longer-trace final output, and 65.5% and 63.5% on the two state tasks; these scores also hold when missing responses count as wrong. Across 2,397 matched Python comparisons with identical source, changing to the longer-trace input yields 528 correct-to-wrong changes and 147 reversals. Source-clustered analyses preserve this accuracy gap, while adjusted Python models give no evidence of a positive incremental association between cumulative state load and error. Changed inputs and checkpoint tasks alter several factors together, so the gaps do not isolate trace length or an internal state-tracking mechanism. The benchmark exposes errors hidden by short-output scores alone.

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically. In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper investigates how LVLMs coordinate visual and textual context during decoding, then uses those findings to steer query representations against hallucinations, providing a substantial but focused contribution to internal model behavior. Its adaptive coordination of context sources has a limited connection to composition and computation, while the application to hallucination mitigation alone does not establish broader reasoning or systems advances.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

    幻觉仍是大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）面临的一项重大挑战。现有的免训练方法通常通过对比解码或视觉增强来缓解幻觉，往往会提高生成过程中视觉证据的相对影响力。这引出了一个根本问题：LVLM 能否动态调节不同上下文来源的贡献，以抑制幻觉？在这项工作中，我们研究并量化 LVLM 在解码过程中如何协调多个上下文来源，并考察这种内在行为如何为缓解幻觉提供指导。我们发现，LVLM 表现出一种内在的关注视觉倾向，可用于指导自适应视觉引导，而文本上下文也有助于缓解幻觉。受这些发现启发，我们提出 AIMS（自适应信息多源引导），这是一个轻量级、免训练的框架，可在解码过程中自适应地协调视觉、预填充文本和生成上下文。具体而言，AIMS 为这三个上下文域构建紧凑原型，并估计它们与当前查询的亲和度，以确定逐注意力头的引导权重。随后将得到的多源引导方向应用于查询表示，从而实现自适应上下文整合，而无需额外模型训练或辅助前向传播。在多种 LVLM 和解码策略上的大量实验表明，AIMS 能有效缓解物体幻觉，同时保持具有竞争力的通用多模态能力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops cost-aware gating, training, and revenue allocation for coordinating heterogeneous experts, with theoretical properties and welfare evaluations.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing model marketplaces typically trade and select individual models as indivisible units, limiting their ability to exploit complementarities among heterogeneous experts. This paper proposes an MoE-based model market framework that lifts Mixture-of-Experts from a model-level learning architecture to a market-level coordination mechanism. In this framework, brokers use gating networks to coordinate multiple heterogeneous experts and deliver a composite model service. We formalize the market participants, service workflow, expert cost structure, and a welfare objective that combines predictive utility with heterogeneous execution costs. We then derive a cost-aware gating mechanism and market-aware training objective, and introduce a cost-adjusted revenue allocation rule that distributes residual revenue according to realized expert participation and execution cost. We also establish basic theoretical properties of the allocation rule, including budget balance, participation monotonicity, and cost sensitivity. Experiments over five random seeds on fifteen tabular and image benchmarks use independently trained and frozen neural and tree-based experts together with latency-derived execution costs. MoE Market achieves the highest mean welfare on all fifteen datasets and a lower mean expected cost than Standard MoE in every case, while maintaining competitive predictive performance. The allocation experiments further demonstrate systematic sensitivity to expert participation and cost, together with substantially lower computational overhead than exact Shapley allocation. These results suggest that MoE can serve as a market-level coordination principle for collaborative, cost-aware, and economically grounded model marketplaces.

    中文

    现有模型市场通常将单个模型作为不可分割的单位进行交易和选择，因此难以利用异质专家之间的互补性。本文提出一种基于 MoE 的模型市场框架，将混合专家从模型级学习架构提升为市场级协调机制。在该框架中，经纪方利用门控网络协调多个异质专家，并提供组合式模型服务。我们对市场参与者、服务流程、专家成本结构以及一种结合预测效用与异质执行成本的福利目标进行了形式化。随后，我们推导出一种成本感知门控机制和市场感知训练目标，并提出一种经成本调整的收入分配规则，根据实际专家参与情况和执行成本分配剩余收入。我们还确立了该分配规则的一些基本理论性质，包括预算平衡、参与单调性和成本敏感性。在五个随机种子上的实验涵盖十五个表格与图像基准，使用独立训练并冻结的神经网络专家和基于树的专家，以及从延迟推导出的执行成本。在全部十五个数据集上，MoE Market 都取得了最高的平均福利；在每种情况下，其平均预期成本都低于 Standard MoE，同时保持了有竞争力的预测性能。分配实验还表明，该方法对专家参与度和成本具有系统性的敏感性，且计算开销显著低于精确 Shapley 分配。这些结果表明，MoE 可作为一种市场级协调原则，构建协作式、成本感知且具有经济依据的模型市场。

    From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding

    从表层走向深层：迈向多模态情绪理解中的认知评估推理

    Jia Li, Yichao He, Yangchen Yu, Qiankun Li, Xinyi Li, Baiyi Ye, Zhenzhen Hu, Richang Hong, Erik Cambria

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops appraisal-based multimodal emotion reasoning through a dataset, sparse MoE model, and benchmark, with reported cross-domain generalization. Reasoning is a substantial focus; appraisal dimensions do not by themselves establish compositional generalization, and MoE is an architectural means rather than a systems contribution.

    该论文通过数据集、稀疏 MoE 模型和基准发展基于评估的多模态情绪推理，并报告了跨领域泛化能力。推理是其重要研究重点；评估维度本身并不能证明组合泛化能力，而 MoE 是一种架构手段，并非系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.

    中文

    近期的多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地将可解释推理融入情绪理解。然而，主要依据可观察情感线索进行的推理，可能会将情绪理解简化为表层的线索—标签关联，从而产生“聪明的汉斯效应”。当情感线索隐含不明、不同模态间相互冲突、受到语言误导或被冗余细节遮蔽时，这类捷径就会变得不可靠。相较之下，人类情绪还受到个体如何解读和评估周围事件的影响，而不仅仅取决于可观察线索。受情绪评估理论启发，我们将多模态情绪理解表述为从感知到认知评估的过程，并提出一个数据集、一个模型和一个基准来支持这一新范式。CogEmo-40K 是一个大规模指令微调数据集，通过从感知到评估的流程构建，旨在引导模型围绕情绪背后的六个认知评估维度进行以证据为依据的推理。CogEmo-MoE 是一个紧凑的稀疏 MLLM，通过引入交错的 MoE 模块进行针对评估维度的适配，使其能够以远小于典型情绪 MLLM 的规模有效开展评估推理。CogEmo-Bench 引入评估证据质量分数（AEQS），从六个互补的评估维度衡量认知—情感理解，弥补传统情绪指标只评估预测了何种情绪、却不评估情绪为何产生的局限。大量实验表明，我们的范式不仅在 CogEmo-Bench 上领先，而且还表现出很强的跨领域泛化能力。我们的发现表明，从感知到评估的推理能够超越表层的线索—标签关联，带来更可靠的多模态情绪理解，并使 MLLM 与人类的认知更加接近。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes Bayesian-prior-constrained neural decoding and reports stable semantic representations with consistent geometry across tasks and recording modalities. Its contribution substantially concerns representation geometry, while cross-task consistency is an outcome rather than a compositional-generalization method; it does not study AI reasoning or model systems.

    该论文提出一种受贝叶斯先验约束的神经解码方法，并报告了跨任务和记录模态保持几何关系一致的稳定语义表征。其贡献主要涉及表征几何；跨任务一致性是一种结果，而非组合泛化方法；该论文不研究 AI 推理或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The brain maintains stable cognition despite continuously changing neural activity. How to extract stable cognitive states from variable neural observations remains a central problem in neural decoding. Existing neural decoding methods map neural observations to predefined external labels based on the stimulus-response principle, often capturing recording-specific spurious correlations. Inspired by how the brain infers the world, and specifically by Bayesian brain theory, we recast neural decoding as cognitive inference constrained by brain-intrinsic priors, yielding high-level meta-neural semantic representations. In decoding experiments spanning five neural recording modalities and three cognitive domains (motor, perception and internal mentation), our cognitive inference method reorganized the geometry of neural observation representations, yielding meta-neural semantic representations that exhibited consistent geometric relationships across cognitive tasks and enabled the recovery of stable cognitive states from variable neural observations. Our work provides an account of how the brain maintains relatively stable cognition despite continual changes in the external environment. Cognitive stability is sustained through cognitive inference from changing neural activity, without requiring fixed neural activity patterns.

    The report’s main contribution is scaling RL for multimodal foundation models through larger training runs, diverse agent environments, improved grading, and supporting infrastructure. RL and agentic training substantially advance reasoning capability development and model systems, while the frozen router and multimodal context alone do not establish interpretability or compositional generalization contributions.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This substantially advances an approach to open-ended problem solving, with partial relevance to compositional architecture and agent systems, but the abstract does not establish insights into internal representations or mechanisms.

    MindFlow 将创意生成表示为由模块化思维算子动态采样组合而成的过程，并通过锦标赛排序优化思维流。这推动了一种开放式问题求解方法的发展，与组合式架构和智能体系统有部分关联，但摘要并未证明其对内部表征或机制有所洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) policies assume the embodiment on which they were trained and can fail when a joint fault changes how commanded actions are physically executed. Existing fault-recovery methods often require task-specific retraining, fault labels, explicit diagnosis, or privileged embodiment information. We introduce CAPABLE, a unified capability-aware adaptation framework for frozen VLAs that integrates self-supervised capability inference with residual reinforcement learning. CAPABLE infers capability, how much of the commanded motion each joint actually realizes and how that motion contributes to end-effector behavior, online from command-response history and kinematics using a temporal encoder shared across joints, Jacobian grounding, cross-joint attention, and self-supervised physical prediction. The resulting representation conditions a residual policy that adds bounded corrections to the VLA arm action without fault labels or faulty-joint identifiers. Across 28 LIBERO tasks, CAPABLE raises success on an actuator excluded from fault training from 24.8% to 59.3%, outperforming a parameter-matched global-history baseline by 17.4 points while preserving healthy performance. Leave-one-actuator-out experiments across six joints show that this transfer is not specific to one actuator, and additional evaluations characterize transfer to unseen fault families and demonstrate recovery on a physical Franka Panda. https://capable-vla.github.io/

    MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation

    MetaOPD：用于在线策略蒸馏的元学习令牌加权

    Zipeng Wang, Xinpeng Dong, Yuefan Wang, Pingchen Lu, Xian Wei, Kun Kuang, Fei Wu, Zhongxiang Dai, Min Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MetaOPD learns token weights through their effect on a student’s post-update validation loss, a substantial training-method contribution aimed at improving mathematical reasoning. Token-level supervision and weighting are incidental to composition or model internals, so those directions remain low.

    MetaOPD 根据令牌权重对学生模型更新后验证损失的影响来学习权重，这是旨在提升数学推理能力的一项重要训练方法贡献。令牌级监督和加权与组合能力或模型内部机制只有附带关系，因此这些方向的相关性仍然较低。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using token-level teacher supervision. However, uniform weighting overlooks differences in token learning value, while existing weighting methods rely on predefined mappings from prediction signals to token weights. These mappings are not learned from the effectiveness of the resulting student updates, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving learning needs. In this paper, we propose MetaOPD, a bilevel optimization framework that jointly learns the student model and a lightweight token-weighting network. The inner objective updates the student through weighted OPD, while the outer objective optimizes the weighting network using validation loss on reference solutions after a virtual student update. Differentiating through this update connects weighting decisions to their effects on post-update performance, allowing the mapping from prediction signals to token weights to evolve alongside the student. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets, covering two student scales and seven baselines, demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaOPD, with Avg@8/Pass@8 gains over OPD of 1.99/5.97 percentage points for the 0.6B student and 2.25/6.41 points for the 1.7B student.

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用教师模型在令牌级别的监督，对学生模型自身生成的响应进行训练。然而，统一加权忽视了不同令牌的学习价值差异，而现有加权方法依赖于将预测信号映射到令牌权重的预定义规则。这些映射并非根据学生更新的实际效果学习，因此难以适应不断变化的学习需求。本文提出 MetaOPD，一种双层优化框架，用于联合学习学生模型和轻量级令牌加权网络。内层目标通过加权 OPD 更新学生模型；外层目标则在一次虚拟学生更新之后，利用参考解上的验证损失优化加权网络。通过对这次更新求导，可将加权决策与其对更新后性能的影响联系起来，使预测信号到令牌权重的映射能够随着学生模型共同演进。在六个数学推理数据集和三个分布外数据集上进行的实验，涵盖两种学生模型规模和七个基线，证明了 MetaOPD 的有效性：对于 0.6B 学生模型，相比 OPD，Avg@8/Pass@8 分别提高 1.99/5.97 个百分点；对于 1.7B 学生模型，分别提高 2.25/6.41 个百分点。

    Jiahao Lu, Mohan Kankanhalli

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper learns a policy that selects test-time training methods, reuses skills, and balances utility with compute, with reported generalization to unseen domains. Its focus on agent control and adaptive learning makes Systems strong; skill reuse is incidental to compositional generalization, and no internal representation mechanism is studied.

    本文学习一种策略，用于选择测试时训练方法、复用技能并权衡效用与计算开销，且报告了向未见领域的泛化能力。其重点是智能体控制和自适应学习，因此与系统方向高度相关；技能复用与组合泛化只有附带关系，且本文未研究内部表征机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.

    中文

    测试时训练（TTT）利用从测试输入中提取的信号调整大语言模型（LLM）的参数，并能在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛或指定开放问题等预先设定的场景中带来显著提升。TTT 将部署经验转化为参数更新，为模型层面的自我改进提供了直接机制。然而，TTT 并非在所有情况下都有益：不同 TTT 算法适用于不同场景，使用不合适的方法可能浪费测试时计算资源，甚至损害模型性能。因此，这种参数层面的自我改进需要具备自主决策能力：模型必须判断何时适合进行 TTT、调用哪种算法，以及是否可以复用已有技能。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出 Agentic-TTT，学习一个测试时策略来指导这些决策。Agentic-TTT 将 TTT 流程转化为可调用工具，把积累的技能视为不断演进的部署环境，并依据决策带来的实测效用提升来训练策略。在我们的基准上，Agentic-TTT 的效用几乎达到骨干模型的两倍，学会了在效用与计算开销之间权衡，并能泛化到训练期间未见过的领域。总而言之，这些结果指向自主自我改进：模型能够决定如何从自身的部署经验中学习。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding how deep neural networks process information remains a central challenge. Existing interpretability methods often compromise structural fidelity, rely on prespecified corpora, or explain models post-hoc. We propose Polytopal Neural Networks (PNNs), a framework that extracts distinct layer-wise aspects by enforcing a polytope-based structure that is used directly in subsequent information processing. We scale our approach using learned corpus representations and an amortized simplex inference procedure and highlight how the framework also gives a direct route to vector quantized (VQ) training. In PNNs, observations are explicitly described by their alignment with layer-specific aspects. Empirical results show that imposing polytopal constraints on neural network representations preserves meaningful structures in the latent space with minimal degradation in performance, favorable compressed representations when compared to VQ representations in unsupervised learning, while also providing a performant new approach to VQ deep learning training. Our findings suggest that deep networks can enforce interpretable polytope-based representations, offering a principled path toward more transparent AI systems with minimal performance compromise.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REACT contributes a persistent, rolling action buffer and decoupled sensing, encoding, denoising, and execution to improve reactive robot control with VLA models. This is a substantial agent-control and computation-organization advance; smoother action chunks and responsive behavior are secondary links to composition and reasoning, without direct contributions to either.

    REACT 提出持久的滚动动作缓冲区，并将感知、编码、去噪和执行解耦，以改进基于 VLA 模型的反应式机器人控制。这是对智能体控制和计算组织的一项重要进展；更平滑的动作块和更灵敏的行为与组合能力及推理只有次要联系，本文没有对这两者作出直接贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.

    中文

    基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型会生成动作块，以实现时间上连贯的机器人运动，但分块控制带来了一个根本性的闭环权衡：较长的动作块能实现平滑执行，而频繁重新规划能提升反应能力，却会造成动作不连续。我们提出 REACT，一种滚动去噪框架，使基于流的 VLA 更具反应能力，同时保留长时程上下文。REACT 不会从头重新生成整个动作块，而是维护一个具有交错流时间步的持久动作缓冲区。在每个控制步骤中，系统根据最新观测对整个时间范围进行去噪，执行最干净的动作块，将经过部分细化的未来动作块向前移，并在末端追加新的噪声。因此，每个实际执行的动作块在部署前都会结合多个近期观测进行细化。为支持实时控制，我们进一步提出双重解耦，将感知、VLM 编码、DiT 去噪和动作执行分离，使系统能够在实际计算资源限制下实现高频观测更新和动作流式输出。在 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真基准以及涵盖双臂操作和多个机器人平台上的动态控制的真实任务中，与频繁重新规划和异步基线相比，REACT 提高了任务成功率、降低了反应延迟，并生成了更平滑的轨迹。

    CausalDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models with Latent Disentanglement

    CausalDreamer：通过潜在解耦学习预测性世界模型

    Prince Jha, Nils Lukas, Kun Zhang, Salem Lahlou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CausalDreamer factors world-model latents by controllability and reward relevance, and reports that the representation separates reward-irrelevant changes while improving planning returns on familiar and manipulated tasks. This is a substantial representation-structure contribution, though the abstract does not establish internal causal mechanisms; planning and world modeling offer secondary connections to reasoning and systems.

    CausalDreamer 按可控性和奖励相关性对世界模型潜变量进行因子分解，并报告称该表征能够分离与奖励无关的变化，同时提高了熟悉任务和修改后任务上的规划回报。这是一项重要的表征结构贡献，但摘要并未证实其内部因果机制；规划和世界建模与推理及系统方向有次要关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models for control must capture which aspects of the environment respond to the agent's actions and which are relevant to reward. Generative world models such as Dreamer 4 consist of a video tokenizer, which encodes each frame into a latent, and a dynamics model, which is pretrained to predict future latents from past latents and actions. Yet the tokenizer is trained with a reconstruction objective, without action or reward supervision, so its latent provides no explicit mechanism to separate controllable, uncontrollable, reward-relevant, and reward-irrelevant information. We propose \textit{CausalDreamer}, which keeps the tokenizer frozen and re-encodes its latent into a factored representation of four groups along two axes: controllability, where only the two controllable groups receive the action, and reward relevance, learned by predicting the reward from the two reward-relevant groups. The pretrained dynamics model is then fine-tuned to predict the factored representation. We evaluate \textit{CausalDreamer} and the pretrained world model it starts from with model-predictive planning on 20 MMBench2 tasks: 10 clean tasks seen during training and 10 unseen tasks, of which 6 are manipulated variants of clean tasks with a changed background, object, or maze layout, and 4 are new environments. We normalize returns so that a policy taking uniformly random actions scores 0 and an expert scores 1. \textit{CausalDreamer} achieves a 14\% higher normalized score than the pretrained world model on the clean tasks (0.199 vs.\ 0.175) and a 25\% higher score on the manipulated variants (0.307 vs.\ 0.246), while neither model scores meaningfully above the random policy in the new environments. Additionally, our analysis shows that the factored representation separates reward-irrelevant changes, such as a changed background, from its reward-relevant groups.

    中文

    用于控制的世界模型必须捕捉环境中哪些方面会响应智能体的动作，以及哪些方面与奖励有关。Dreamer 4 等生成式世界模型由视频标记器和动力学模型组成：前者将每一帧编码为潜变量，后者经过预训练，根据过去的潜变量和动作预测未来潜变量。然而，标记器是在没有动作或奖励监督的情况下，通过重建目标训练的，因此其潜变量没有明确机制来区分可控、不可控、与奖励相关及与奖励无关的信息。我们提出 \textit{CausalDreamer}，它保持标记器冻结，并将其潜变量重新编码为沿两个轴划分的四组因子表征：可控性轴上，只有两个可控组接收动作；奖励相关性则通过从两个与奖励相关的组预测奖励来学习。随后，对预训练的动力学模型进行微调，使其预测因子表征。我们在 20 项 MMBench2 任务上使用模型预测规划评估 \textit{CausalDreamer} 及其起始预训练世界模型：其中 10 项干净任务在训练期间见过，另外 10 项未见过；后者包括 6 项经过修改的任务，其背景、物体或迷宫布局发生变化，以及 4 个新环境。我们对回报进行归一化，使采取均匀随机动作的策略得分为 0，专家得分为 1。在干净任务上，\textit{CausalDreamer} 的归一化得分比预训练世界模型高 14\%（0.199 对比 0.175）；在经过修改的任务变体上高 25\%（0.307 对比 0.246）。但在新环境中，两个模型的得分都没有显著高于随机策略。此外，我们的分析表明，因子表征能够将与奖励无关的变化（例如背景变化）与其奖励相关组分离。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）日益广泛地部署在社会技术系统中，社会归因在其中发挥着关键作用。社会归因是指将外部事件归因于社会行为主体的行为原因和动机的推理过程。这类过程涉及对社会原因、责任以及对行为主体的责备或赞扬的判断。尽管归因模型已通过归因理论在社会心理学和认知科学中得到充分研究，AI 领域中的社会归因仍研究不足，尤其是 LLM 的社会推理。本文首次系统地探索了 LLM 的社会归因。我们的工作聚焦于责任归因和责备归因，考察当前 LLM 的判断及其底层内部机制。在归因理论的指导下，我们构建了一个社会归因基准，其中包括基于归因理论研究经典情境的情境子集，以及基于现实社会叙事的现实子集，共有 7,639 个责任/责备判断问题。基于该基准，我们评估了 32 个具有代表性的 LLM 和 5 个基础的非 LLM 基线。为进一步探索 LLM 判断过程的内部机制，我们开发了一种基于探测的方法，用于考察 5 个关键归因维度在潜在空间中的表征，以及这些维度对 LLM 判断的影响是否与人类社会归因中的影响一致。研究结果显示，当前 LLM 对人类责任和责备判断表现出可测量但并不完全的一致性，而且这种一致性与模型规模呈正相关。一些归因维度能够从 LLM 隐状态的特定位置被系统地解码出来，并且它们对最终判断的影响与人类归因理论所指出的影响一致。数据集及相关代码见 https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench。

    Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation

    Yan Yang, Jikun Rong, Minzhao Zhu, Zheyi Zhao, Qirui Hu, Zihan Lan, Weixin Mao, Yinhao Li, Zhen Fu, Hua Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HWAM jointly predicts reference actions and post-execution robot states to address the action–execution gap, with conditional training paths connecting actions, body motion, and visual outcomes. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to embodied control systems; its action generation and dynamics modeling have only incidental connections to general reasoning or compositional generalization.

    HWAM 联合预测参考动作和机器人执行后的状态，以解决动作—执行差距，并通过条件训练路径关联动作、身体运动和视觉结果。这是对具身控制系统的一项重要算法贡献；其动作生成和动力学建模与一般推理或组合泛化只有附带联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

    人形机器人是实现通用操作的一种很有前景的平台。近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略直接从多模态观测中学习动作，而世界动作模型（WAM）还纳入未来视觉预测以改进动作生成。然而，在分层式人形机器人系统中，VLA 和 WAM 策略输出的是参考动作，这些动作随后通过全身控制、机器人动力学、平衡和接触来实现。这一层级结构造成了动作—执行差距：策略生成的参考动作可能不同于机器人实际完成的运动。如果不显式建模实际实现的身体状态，未来视觉预测就必须同时解释场景演变，以及参考动作与执行运动之间的差异，因而难以将动作与其物理结果联系起来。我们提出 HWAM，即具有关节状态—动作联合生成的人形机器人世界动作模型，将机器人执行后的本体感知状态作为明确的预测目标。通过联合生成参考动作及其实际实现的身体状态，HWAM 将对已执行运动的监督直接纳入动作学习。HWAM 通过三种互补的条件生成路径进行训练。策略路径仅以当前观测为条件，对状态—动作轨迹进行联合去噪，以匹配部署条件。前向动力学建模（FDM）以动作和执行后的状态为条件预测未来视觉观测，而逆向动力学建模（IDM）则从视觉变化重建关节轨迹。这些路径共同将策略参考、实际实现的身体运动和视觉结果联系起来。在 LimX OLI 人形机器人的三项真实任务中，HWAM 在受评估的基线中取得了最高成功率。在 Candy Picking 任务上，HWAM 的成功率为 70.6%，Fast-WAM 为 43.3%。

The tax turns out to depend on schema design rather than on structure per se: reasoning-first field ordering matches or exceeds free-form accuracy, while answer-first ordering causes steep drops, particularly in smaller models. Format sensitivity scales inversely with a task's own structural constraints, and schemas that preserve reasoning order also improve calibration with CKA showing greater separability between correct and incorrect representations in middle transformer layers.     LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.

While existing methods learn to generate or refine such states for each policy query, they discard successful reasoning after execution and therefore reconstruct similar computation from scratch. We present Reasoning and Flow Memory (FLOWMEM), a unified VLA model that turns successful latent computation into reusable reasoning experience. Rather than appending a fixed retrieved context, FLOWMEM dynamically retrieves and recomposes compatible latent fragments as the embodied context evolves, forming a reasoning route that follows the temporal structure and progress of successful computation. The route is then refined using current visual and proprioceptive evidence before it conditions action generation. Experiments on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus show that FLOWMEM attains 48.0% and 77.3% success, outperforming memory-free policies by 1.7 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively.     Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.

    Q 形选项利用低层和高层 Q 函数塑造分层动作抽象，从而改进长时程控制和选项空间。这显著推动了用于规划和智能体架构的分层 RL 发展，并通过可复用选项与组合能力有一定关联；摘要没有研究模型的内部表示。

    ENGLISH

    Learning to tackle long-horizon, goal-conditioned tasks requires an agent to reason over extended timescales and act across a broad range of states. In principle, Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) addresses both challenges through the interaction between action (temporal) and state (spatial) abstraction. First, using an action abstraction to represent temporally extended behaviour as options reduces the effective decision horizon. Second, enabling different state abstractions at each level of the decision process permits greater data aggregation for learning. However, realising these two benefits of a hierarchical policy depends on learning an appropriate action abstraction. Current HRL algorithms fail in one of two ways. Some discard distinctions between options needed for optimal control, undermining hierarchy altogether. Others retain unnecessary distinctions, preserving horizon reduction, but forfeiting coarser state abstraction. In this work, we characterise three desiderata for an action abstraction. We introduce Q-Shaped Options (QSO) to address all three. QSO builds on an architecture with distinct state-value functions, Q functions and policies at each level of the hierarchy. It learns the action abstraction between consecutive levels as a shared encoder shaped by their respective Q functions. The low-level Q function uses the option as a goal, encouraging the abstraction to retain distinctions necessary for optimal control. The high-level Q function uses it as an action, encouraging unnecessary distinctions to be discarded. Across offline goal-conditioned locomotion and manipulation environments, QSO learns semantically meaningful option spaces and outperforms baselines, achieving non-zero performance in tasks where all other evaluated algorithms fail.

    要学会处理长时程、目标条件化任务，智能体需要跨较长时间尺度进行推理，并在广泛的状态空间中采取行动。原则上，分层强化学习（HRL）通过动作（时间）抽象与状态（空间）抽象的相互作用来应对这两项挑战。首先，使用动作抽象将时间跨度较长的行为表示为选项，可以缩短有效决策时域。其次，在决策过程的每一层启用不同的状态抽象，能够汇集更多数据用于学习。然而，要实现分层策略的这两项优势，取决于能否学到恰当的动作抽象。当前 HRL 算法会以两种方式之一失败。有些算法抹去了最优控制所需的选项间差异，从而使层级结构失去意义。另一些算法则保留了不必要的差异，虽能缩短决策时域，却无法获得更粗粒度的状态抽象。在本研究中，我们归纳出动作抽象的三项要求。我们提出 Q 形选项（QSO）来满足这三项要求。QSO 基于一种架构，在层级的每一层分别设置状态价值函数、Q 函数和策略。它将相邻层级之间的动作抽象学习为一个由各自 Q 函数塑造的共享编码器。低层 Q 函数将选项用作目标，鼓励抽象保留最优控制所需的差异。高层 Q 函数将选项用作动作，鼓励丢弃不必要的差异。在离线目标条件化运动和操作环境中，QSO 学得了语义上有意义的选项空间，并优于基线方法；在其他所有受评估算法都失败的任务上，它仍取得了非零性能。

    MASS trains a model to optimize and execute structured multi-agent workflows, reporting improved performance and training efficiency on open-ended tasks.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.

    带迁移的验证：精确信息前沿及其调用代价

    Hazar Yueksel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops information and call-complexity bounds for verification with transfer, including exact results for linear source banks and a small-transformer study of using delivered bits. This is a substantial contribution to formal problem-solving and information use, with a limited connection to compositional structure through XOR targets; the transformer evidence does not analyze internal mechanisms, and call budgets alone do not make it a systems contribution.

    本文针对带迁移的验证，推导了信息量和调用复杂度界，其中包括线性源任务库的精确结果，以及一项关于小型 transformer 使用已交付比特的研究。这对形式化问题求解和信息利用作出了重要贡献，并通过 XOR 目标与组合结构有有限关联；关于 transformer 的证据并未分析内部机制，而调用预算本身不足以构成系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A verifier that accepts or rejects whole answers reveals little: under a flat prior over $k$-bit answers, zero error needs $2^k-1$ verifications. The usual remedy is to solve related source tasks, either all first, as a curriculum does, or interleaved with verification. We price this remedy in information and in calls. With an exact verifier, the least causal information that any interleaving of source calls and $n$ verifications needs to succeed with probability $s$ is a list rate-distortion function, attained by one observation before any verification. It lower-bounds the expected number of binary source calls, which designed sources meet within $1+\log_25$ calls for unique answers and within a logarithmic term in general, where no additive constant suffices. With an exact verifier and fixed sources, moving every call before the first verification preserves all hard caps on calls, although interleaving can save unboundedly many expected calls; under a noisy verifier, source-first protocols can lose unbounded factors in information and in error. For linear banks over $\mathbb{F}_2$, optimal accuracy has a closed form, and after a polynomial-time reduction the budget profile is computable in time $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ for $J$ sources and nuisance dimension $h$. In these banks, for zero error under a hard cap, the calls beyond the rounded-up information price are exactly those spent on nuisance. Every numbered result apart from two clauses about the planner is machine-checked in Lean 4, assuming two published results. Used as a ruler, the frontier shows a small transformer using all delivered bits at latent dimension $5$ and none at $11$ within fixed training budgets; in a test with predictions recorded before training, low XOR degree of the target bits did not suffice for their use.

    中文

    只接受或拒绝完整答案的验证器所透露的信息很少：在对 $k$-bit 答案采用平坦先验的情况下，实现零错误需要进行 $2^k-1$ 次验证。通常的补救办法是解决相关源任务，可以像课程学习那样先全部解决，也可以与验证交错进行。我们从信息量和调用次数两方面衡量这种补救办法。使用精确验证器时，任何交错安排的源任务调用与 $n$ 次验证要以概率 $s$ 成功，所需的最少因果信息量是一个列表率失真函数；在进行任何验证之前先观测一次即可达到该值。它给二元源调用的期望次数设定了下界；对于答案唯一的情况，专门设计的源任务可在 $1+\log_25$ 次调用内达到该界；一般情况下则只相差一个对数项，且不存在普适的加法常数界。对于精确验证器和固定源任务，将所有调用移到首次验证之前不会改变任何调用硬上限，尽管交错安排能使期望调用次数减少任意大的幅度；使用噪声验证器时，先调用源任务的协议在信息量和错误率方面都可能遭受任意大的因子损失。对于定义在 $\mathbb{F}_2$ 上的线性任务库，最优准确率有闭式表达式；经过多项式时间归约后，对于 $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ 个源任务和 $J$ 维干扰项，其预算曲线可在 $h$ 时间内计算。在这些任务库中，在硬上限下实现零错误时，超过向上取整后信息代价的调用次数，恰好等于用于处理干扰项的调用次数。除涉及规划器的两个分句外，所有编号结果均已在 Lean 4 中完成机器检验，并以两项已发表结果为前提。将该前沿用作标尺，在固定训练预算下，一个小型 transformer 在潜在维度为 $5$ 时用到了所有交付的比特，而在 $11$ 时一个也没用到；在一项训练前记录预测的测试中，目标比特的 XOR 次数低并不足以使模型使用这些比特。

    DiffuPlex：通过滚动掩码扩散加速全双工语音对话模型

    Heeseung Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DiffuPlex predicts and selectively consumes future dialogue frames to reduce sequential backbone computation while preserving interaction behavior, a substantial algorithmic contribution to computational allocation in a real-time spoken-dialog system. It does not study internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning capabilities.

    DiffuPlex 通过预测并有选择地使用未来对话帧，在保留交互行为的同时减少骨干网络的顺序计算；这是对实时语音对话系统中计算资源分配的一项重要算法贡献。本文没有研究内部表示、组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.

    近期的全双工语音对话模型能够同时聆听和说话，但细粒度模型仍会在每个交互帧以自回归方式推进其骨干网络。我们提出 DiffuPlex，这是一种滚动掩码扩散框架，通过在单次骨干网络唤醒中预测多个未来的用户帧和助手帧，减少这种顺序计算。交互以原有帧率持续进行时，DiffuPlex 只使用每个预测未来中置信度足够高的前缀。随着用户语音到来，它会检查相应的用户预测；若交互出现偏离，则保留已经播放的助手内容，只修订尚未播放的未来内容。我们在同一预测器上考虑两种推理策略：若多个未来帧预测助手保持静默，DiffuPlex-LISTEN 就会使用这些帧；DiffuPlex-SPEAK 还可以使用预测的助手语音。在全双工交互和口语评测中，DiffuPlex 显著减少了骨干网络的顺序计算，同时大体保留了交互行为和通用能力。DiffuPlex-LISTEN 和 DiffuPlex-SPEAK 分别实现了 $1.46\times$ 和 $1.59\times$ 倍部署路径墙钟加速，以及 $1.61\times$ 和 $1.80\times$ 倍 Core LM 加速；所有测得的骨干网络调用均在 80ms 的交互间隔内完成。人工评估显示，LISTEN 保持了语音自然度和对话质量，而 SPEAK 保持了对话质量，但语音自然度有所下降。

    阅读摘要 Abstract
